commits.message:
[Feature][MoE] Fuse the shared expert into the A5 MegaMoe operator for W4A4 MXFP4 (enable_fused_mc2=3) (#18053)

## What

Fuse the shared expert into the A5 CANN MegaMoe operator
(`enable_fused_mc2=3`), extending #17654 with W4A4 MXFP4 support and
fixing activation-enum handling.

## Why

With `enable_fused_mc2=2`, the shared expert runs as a separate
GMM1+activation+GMM2 forward alongside the MegaMoe routed path.
`enable_fused_mc2=3` folds the shared expert into the MegaMoe kernel so
its weights travel with the routed weights and the extra kernels
disappear. #17654 implemented this for W8A8 MXFP checkpoints only; W4A4
MXFP4 models (e.g. GLM-5.3-W4A4C8-MXFP4) silently fell back to the
separate shared-expert forward.

Three additional gaps found while enabling it for W4A4:

1. The routed-activation guard compared the `MoEActivation` enum via
`str(...)`, which renders as `MoEActivation.SILU` and never matches
`"silu"`, so fusion was disabled even for standard SiLU models. Because
the operator applies a single global activation to the shared experts,
the guard was then generalized to a "same activation function" check:
equal activation type plus equal activation params (see How).
2. Packed-FP4 shared weights need the same layout rebuild as the routed
experts: `w1` cast to `FRACTAL_NZ`, `w2` rebuilt as `FRACTAL_NZ_C0_32`
on an fp8 carrier from the packed fp4 buffer, and the byte-stored E8M0
scales viewed as `float8_e8m0fnu`.
3. An unbounded shared `SiluAndMul` was unconditionally accepted even
when the routed swiglu carries a `swiglu_limit` clamp, which would
silently change shared-expert numerics under fusion.

## How

- `shared_experts.py`: accept `QuantType.W4A4MXFP` in the fusion gate;
in the weight collector, branch on the quant type to apply the
packed-FP4 FRACTAL_NZ / FRACTAL_NZ_C0_32 rebuild and E8M0 scale views,
mirroring the routed-expert weight processing in the W4A4 MoE method;
also check `mxfp4_tp_padding` alongside `mxfp8_tp_padding`; replace the
activation guard with a general equality check on (activation type,
activation_params) between the routed activation bound into the MegaMoe
call (mirroring `select_mega_moe_activation_kwargs`) and the shared
expert's activation module. Parameterized activations
(situglu/swigluoai) now fuse when their params match exactly;
same-class-different-params pairings, GELU/swiglustep-style activations
the operator cannot express, and an unbounded shared SiluAndMul under a
clamped routed swiglu all keep the separate shared-expert forward.
- `moe_comm_method.py`: keep passing
`**layer.mega_moe_activation_kwargs` alongside the new shared-expert
kwargs (conflict resolution against #17916).
- `additional_config.md`: document `enable_fused_mc2=3`.

## Test

- GLM-5.3-W4A4C8-MXFP4 on 8 x Ascend950DT, TP=8 + EP,
`enable_fused_mc2=3`, MTP speculative decoding: service starts, no
"keeping the separate shared-expert forward" fallback log, and `curl`
chat completions respond correctly with zero errors.

Signed-off-by: ZT-AIA <1028681969@qq.com>

- vLLM main:
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/24420b7a341af37a9bc3186e6fc6062512e0aa58

---------

Signed-off-by: ZT-AIA <1028681969@qq.com>

+    def _validate_megamoe_shared_expert_fusion(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> None:
+        """Reject ``enable_fused_mc2=3`` on A3 and latent-MoE models.
+
+        The shared expert is fused into the routed A5 MegaMoe operator, so this
+        contract is A5-only (``CANN_MEGAMOE_SHARED_EXPERT_FUSION``) and assumes
+        the shared expert and routed experts share the residual width. Latent-MoE
+        models (e.g. Kimi K3) project the residual stream before the routed FFN and
+        expose ``routed_expert_hidden_size``; the shared expert cannot be fused in
+        that layout. Fail fast instead of silently downgrading, because a silent
+        downgrade would change results without failing the launch.
+        """
+        if not self.megamoe_shared_expert_fusion:
+            return
+
+        hardware_profile = get_current_hardware_profile()
+        if not hardware_profile.supports(HardwareCapability.CANN_MEGAMOE_SHARED_EXPERT_FUSION):
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "enable_fused_mc2=3 (MegaMoe shared-expert fusion) is only supported on A5; "
+                "the current hardware profile does not support it. "
+                "Set additional_config.enable_fused_mc2 to 0, 1, or 2."
+            )
+
+        model_config = getattr(vllm_config, "model_config", None)
+        hf_text_config = getattr(model_config, "hf_text_config", None)
+        if getattr(hf_text_config, "routed_expert_hidden_size", None) is not None:
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "enable_fused_mc2=3 (MegaMoe shared-expert fusion) does not support latent-MoE models "
+                "such as Kimi K3. Set additional_config.enable_fused_mc2 to 0, 1, or 2."
+            )

+    def forward(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        router_logits: torch.Tensor,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        shared_experts_input: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Mirror of upstream ``MoERunner.forward`` (this class is instantiated
+        through the OOT PluggableLayer dispatch of ``MoERunner``).
+
+        Upstream inlines the shared+routed output combine, which is not
+        exposed as an overridable hook. On NPU the combine goes through the
+        fused multi-tensor add kernel (``torch._foreach_add``), whose kernel
+        launch count is independent of the tensor-list length and which is
+        the NPU-validated fast path for the MoE combine. Every other step,
+        including the runtime-aware reduction hooks (#16550), is inherited
+        unchanged.
+
+        Future plan: once the aclnnAdd_AddAiCore_Add kernel is available via
+        the superkernel integration, upstream's plain add becomes the fast
+        path and this override can be dropped.
+        """
+        # Apply transform for routed experts (e.g., latent projection for
+        # latent MoE). When the caller pre-applies the routed input transform
+        # outside the runner (e.g. to overlap it on a separate stream), it
+        # passes the already-transformed routed input as ``hidden_states`` and
+        # the original hidden states as ``shared_experts_input``; skip the
+        # transform in that case so shared experts still see the original input.
+        if shared_experts_input is None:
+            hidden_states, shared_experts_input = self.apply_routed_input_transform(hidden_states)
+
+        if self._megamoe_shared_expert_fused:
+            # The runner owns the effective routed_scaling_factor (with
+            # apply_routed_scale_to_output=True the router and the
+            # routed-experts layer both hold 1.0). MegaMoe combines routed +
+            # shared inside the operator, so the factor must be folded into
+            # the topk weights by the comm implementation; plumb it down

+        shared_activation = self._shared_megamoe_activation_signature()
+        if shared_activation is None or shared_activation != routed_activation:
+            self._disable_megamoe_shared_fusion(
+                f"shared activation {type(self.layer.act_fn).__name__} {shared_activation} "
+                f"does not match the routed activation {routed_activation} executed by the MegaMoe operator"
+            )
+            return
+        # The operator accumulates the shared-expert output into the local
+        # token accumulator with no cross-rank reduction, so fusion is only
+        # correct when every rank holds the full shared weights. That holds
+        # when the physical TP group is trivial (weights are inherently full)
+        # or when enable_shared_expert_dp replicates them; sharded layouts —
+        # plain TP, or SP without SEDP — rely on split/gather reductions that
+        # the fused operator does not reproduce. Fall back to the separate
+        # shared-expert forward.
+        if self.moe_config.tp_group.world_size > 1 and not self.weights_replicated:
+            self._disable_megamoe_shared_fusion(
+                "shared-expert weights are sharded across the TP group; set "
+                "enable_shared_expert_dp=true to enable MegaMoe shared-expert fusion"
+            )
+            return
+
+        for linear, slot in (
+            (self.layer.gate_up_proj, "w1"),
+            (self.layer.down_proj, "w2"),
+        ):
+            self._wrap_linear_for_megamoe_fusion(linear, slot)
+
+    def _routed_megamoe_activation_signature(self) -> tuple[str, dict[str, float]] | None:
+        """Canonical ``(name, params)`` of the activation the operator executes.
+
+        Mirrors :func:`select_mega_moe_activation_kwargs`: whatever kwargs this
+        builds are the ones actually bound into the CANN MegaMoe call, so this
+        — not the raw ``FusedMoEConfig.activation`` tag — is the function the
+        shared experts must equal. ``None`` marks an activation the operator
+        cannot represent (GELU variants, swiglustep, ...), which always keeps
+        the separate shared-expert forward.
+        """
+        moe_config = self.moe_config
+        activation = getattr(moe_config, "activation", "silu")
+        name = str(getattr(activation, "value", activation)).lower()
+        clamp = moe_config.swiglu_limit if (moe_config.swiglu_limit or 0.0) > 0 else None

+            params = {"beta": 1.0 if moe_config.activation_situ_beta is None else moe_config.activation_situ_beta}

+                params["linear_beta"] = moe_config.activation_situ_linear_beta
+            return ("situglu", params)
+        if name in ("swigluoai", "swigluoai_uninterleave"):
+            params = {
+                "alpha": 1.0 if moe_config.swiglu_alpha is None else moe_config.swiglu_alpha,
+                "beta": 0.0 if moe_config.swiglu_beta is None else moe_config.swiglu_beta,
+            }
+            if clamp is not None:
+                params["clamp"] = clamp
+            return ("swigluoai", params)
+        if name == "silu":
+            params = {"alpha": 1.0, "beta": 0.0}
+            if clamp is not None:
+                params["clamp"] = clamp
+            return ("silu", params)
+        return None
+
+    def _shared_megamoe_activation_signature(self) -> tuple[str, dict[str, float]] | None:
+        """Canonical ``(name, params)`` of the shared expert's activation module.
+
+        ``None`` when the activation has no MegaMoe counterpart (GELU variants,
+        unknown custom activations) or its standalone Ascend semantics cannot
+        be reproduced by the operator's single global activation.
+        """

+        if isinstance(act_fn, SituAndMul):
+            params = {"beta": act_fn.beta}

+                params["linear_beta"] = act_fn.linear_beta

+        if isinstance(act_fn, SiluAndMulWithClamp):
+            params = {"alpha": getattr(act_fn, "alpha", 1.0), "beta": getattr(act_fn, "beta", 0.0)}

+            if limit is not None and limit > 0:
+                params["clamp"] = limit
+            return ("silu", params)
+        if isinstance(act_fn, SiluAndMul):
+            return ("silu", {"alpha": 1.0, "beta": 0.0})

+        # classes (e.g. MiniMaxM3SwiGLUOAI) carry alpha/beta/limit as attributes.
+        if isinstance(act_fn, SwigluOAIAndMul) or (hasattr(act_fn, "alpha") and hasattr(act_fn, "limit")):

+                "alpha": act_fn.alpha,
+                "beta": getattr(act_fn, "beta", 1.0),
+            }
+            limit = getattr(act_fn, "limit", None)
+            if limit is not None and limit > 0:
+                params["clamp"] = limit
+            return ("swigluoai", params)
+        return None

+        The wrapper is attached to the linear's own quant-method instance and
+        ignores calls for other layers, so a shared quant-method instance
+        stays safe.
+        """
+        quant_method = getattr(linear, "quant_method", None)
+        original = getattr(quant_method, "process_weights_after_loading", None)

+            self._disable_megamoe_shared_fusion(
+                f"shared linear {type(linear).__name__} has no process_weights_after_loading"
+            )

+        def wrapped_megamoe_collect(*args, **kwargs):

+        self._megamoe_shared_parts.clear()

[Feature][Model] Integrate Kimi K3.1 on main (#20878)

**Targeted A3/A5 Triton operator validation is recorded below.
Full-model and multi-card behavior remain outside this follow-up's
validation.**


## What this PR does / why we need it



Ports the Kimi K3.1 changes from the v0.30.0 development line to the
current main baseline. The changes cover model and runner integration,
KDA/PCP, sparse attention and QLI, DCP communication, paired KV-cache
allocation, Mooncake transfers, attention residual operators and
quantized paths.


This is the integration PR. Twelve review-only slices were prepared by
responsibility, with shared files split by change block. Their
fixed-base reconstruction was verified at regrouping as recorded below.
Subsequent integration amendments, including the 2026-11-09 review
cleanup, are tracked here; the slices remain focused review snapshots
and are not intended to merge independently.


The mainline removal of legacy TP-based DSA-CP is retained. The private
branch's legacy-specific local query-length/leading-zero behavior is not
carried over; equivalence with PCP has not been established. This is an
explicit scope limitation, not a claim that PCP is equivalent.


Follow-up on 2026-11-05: The PROLOG_V3 implementation is selected by the
existing `self.use_rope` execution flag: `False` binds
`cann_ops_transformer.mla_prolog` for NoPE while preserving the learned
tail dimension; `True` retains `torch_npu.npu_mla_prolog_v3`, including
RoPE-enabled K3.1. RoPE-enabled workers do not require the optional CANN
extension for this binding. No new configuration flag is introduced.


Follow-up on 2026-11-05: KDA state-copy now uses the shared Triton JIT
warmup registry. Bound cache layouts are late-registered before
`registry.warmup()`; startup uses compile-only tensor metadata, and
serving uses the same launcher. This removes temporary startup copies
and version-dependent manual compiled-launch argument lists. The A3
byte-copy fallback follows the same mechanism. These changes and the
RMSNorm gate changes are reviewed together in #20887 (Triton operator
updates).


## Does this PR introduce any user-facing change?



Yes. It adds K3.1 execution paths and changes supported attention,
caching and distributed execution configurations.


## How was this patch tested?

### Image normalization deployment documentation (2026-11-10)

`fc31c203d` adds `--no-mm-device-do-normalize` to all 28 image-enabled
engine templates in the Kimi-K3 and Kimi-K3.1-Pro guides: 14 A3 and 14
A5/950DT templates, including mixed deployment, basic PD, long-context
PD, pooled PD, and headless workers. The two A2 templates retain
`--language-model-only` and are unchanged.

Code comparison: vLLM main `db1a63c17812a14f14ec5f21bc0a33eaa5c31a25`
enables device normalization through the Kimi support flag. Ascend main
`6e3299ab492ddbadb4c8e3a00b88c982c9a28131` and this PR's Kimi wrapper
omit `input_norm` when constructing the vision tower. Explicitly
disabling device normalization preserves CPU pixel rescaling and
normalization. This amendment changes documentation only.

Validation:
- Audited all 30 engine command blocks; every image-enabled command
contains the flag exactly once, and both A2 text-only commands remain
identical. The other command arguments are unchanged.
- All 30 extracted engine templates passed `bash -n` after replacing
documentation placeholders. Changed-file Markdown lint and `git diff
--check` passed.
- Full `bash format.sh ci` was attempted and stopped while installing
the actionlint environment; a full repository check pass is not claimed.
- Prior A3 runtime evidence for the same flag, using vLLM `24420b7a` and
Ascend `51ce17e9`: fixed first 50 MMMU_Pro samples scored 45/50; four
complete rounds scored 1453, 1458, 1454, and 1438 out of 1730, with no
final execution errors or empty answers. This is not a new run of this
documentation commit or A5/A2 validation.


### Review cleanup (2026-11-09)



- `cd40491c1`: Select paired cache planning with the outer
`hf_config.model_type == "kimi_k31"` and remove cache-spec inference.
The nested text config retains `kimi_linear`. Update test fixtures and
cover unrelated models with the same hybrid cache geometry.
- `f46551f70`: Move QLI DCP coverage into
`test_quant_lightning_indexer_v2.py` and candidate transport/merge
coverage into `triton/test_dcp_candidates.py`; remove
`test_a5_qli_native_dcp.py`. FP8-only skips are scoped to the relevant
tests.
- `e9e1b05db`: Move KDA INT8 overlap and native INT8 sparse routing into
`HardwareProfile` capabilities, preserving A3-only selection.
- `152dfc90a`: Group the K3/K3.1 model, DSpark, MTP and paired-cache
planner under `vllm_ascend/models/kimi_k3/`; update registry targets,
imports, mocks and source-based test paths. The package initializer does
not load model implementations.


Validation: 76 source-based model/quantization CPU tests, 31
device/profile tests with isolated package bootstrap and mocked
build/device boundaries, 7 standalone sparse-configuration tests, and 30
isolated production planner-dispatch cases passed. The 11 relocated NPU
cases retain their parameters, arithmetic and assertions; the candidate
case uses the existing independent CPU reference. Four migrated modules
preserve their executable AST apart from import paths, and all six Kimi
registry targets resolve to defined classes. Changed-file Ruff 0.14.0
check/format, AST, package-init, import/context-manager/function policy

 # AttnResFwd
 
+## 当前统一 N 轴并行方案
+
+本轮以正式 PR 的 `c730f7177` 为优化前对照。
+BF16、H7168、B1/4/8/16、N1到8的目标混合用例全部使用新 kernel 沿候选行并行打分，
+不再回退到旧 kernel 或单 worker token 打分。核组大小由候选行数、可用核数和 UB 预算计算；
+输出仍由每个 token 的一个核处理完整 H，并保留一次就绪同步。
+
+Token 核组路径中，输出 owner 的自身分数保留在 UB，只读取其他 worker 的分数；prefix 写回与打分重叠，
+在就绪同步前保证写回完成。A2 另在融合加法时重叠读取 addend，省去一次中间 BF16 拷贝。
+未改变计算顺序或两处 BF16 舍入边界。A2 小 N 相对正式 PR 仍有性能退化，继续保留新路径优化。
+历史测量描述其对应冻结版本；最新四轮复测见本文末尾，不混用不同版本的性能数据。
+

 `torch.ops._C_ascend.attn_res_fwd` 将可选的 BF16 加法、残差 bank 混合、
-可选的输出 RMSNorm，以及 bank 写回放在一次调用中。当前算子配置面向
-Ascend 950（A5）推理；A3 运行行为尚未验证。

+A2、A3 和 A5，小 batch 协作路径同时接入三类平台。已在 Ascend910B3 和
+Ascend950PR_9579 上完成本仓库源码的原生构建、安装及完整算子精度验证，
+包含大 H 分段用例。A5 使用独立 RegBase 协作实现；A3 仍需对应硬件验证。

+启用 bank 写回时，`block_residual` 不得与其他只读输入共享存储；Torch 入口会在
+提交 kernel 前拒绝这类别名。关闭写回时仍允许只读输入共享 bank 存储。
+底层 ACLNN 调用方同样需要保证写回 bank 与其他输入不重叠。
+
+## 分核与数据复用
+
+令 token 数为 T、有效历史行数为 N、候选行数为 R=N+1、可用 AIV 核数为 C。
+每次调用只启动一个 kernel。完整 H 能否驻留由 UB 容量决定，不以7168作为硬编码边界。
+
+### 全局行并行（40030）
+
+1. 将 T*R 个完整 H 打分任务按核号步进分发，启动 `min(C,T*R)` 个核。
+   每行计算 RMSNorm 与投影点积，在独占的32字节 workspace 槽写一个 score。
+2. 所有启动核执行一次 `SyncAll<true>()`，等待分数与融合 prefix 就绪。
+3. 启动核数为 U 时，token t 的输出核为 `floor(t*U/T)`，每个 token 有唯一输出核。
+   该核对 R 个 score 做 softmax，读取原始候选行并对完整 H 加权累加。
+4. 混合结果先舍入 BF16，再由该核完成可选的输出 RMSNorm，无第二次核间同步。
+
+打分先处理 prefix，score 存储仍为历史行在前、prefix 在后。无任务循环覆盖时，
+输出 owner 可复用驻留的 BF16 prefix；其余情况重新读取，避免使用已覆盖的中间量。
+
+### Token 核组（40040）
+
+完整行满足 UB 预算且 `T>C/4` 时，Host 按候选行数和可用核数计算均匀 token 核组：
+`Gmax=min(R,C/T)`、`W=ceil(R/Gmax)`、`G=ceil(R/W)`，使用 `T*G` 个打分核。
+它保留最大均匀核组的关键打分波数，并减少没有缩短关键路径的多余 worker。
+低 token 占用保留全局行调度或既有的多 worker 核组；目标矩阵不回退到单核 token 打分。
+核号 `core/groupSize` 确定 token，`core%groupSize` 确定组内位置。
+leader 保留原始 BF16 prefix，并按 UB 余量缓存本核负责的历史候选行。
+
+- 多 worker 组各自打分，leader 的自身分数保留在 UB，其他 worker 写独占 score 槽。
+  全体 AIV 执行一次就绪同步，leader 只读取远端分数，再完成 softmax、完整 H 加权和输出 RMSNorm。
+- 本轮高 token 占用的完整行方案直接采用多 worker 核组，不再使用先前的收益准入门槛。
+  没有具体 B/N 白名单；不满足协作框架条件的其他场景仍保留原路径。
+
+A5 的 UB 预算计入实际分配：直接从 `rowBf16_` 搬出，不分配输出队列；
+核组均分配 GM 分数队列，余量用于缓存更多 BF16 候选行。
+核组 leader 按 UB 余量缓存候选行，输出仍由一个 owner 完成完整 H。
+当前 Host 不发射 `groupSize=1` 的40040，旧单 worker 对照分支及其专用累加 helper 已删除。
+目标矩阵之外的老 kernel 仍采用单核 token 模式，相关历史优化见本文末尾。
+
+完整行结果在 `V_MTE3` 事件后直接 `DataCopyPad` 写 GM，等待 `MTE3_V` 再复用。
+A2/A3 另有 UB 地址 padding、循环外 Counter mask、BF16 多 repeat Copy 和归约尾块初始化；
+这些调优不直接套用到 A5。A5 使用独立 RegBase 算术与归约实现。
+
+### 大 H 与其他路径
+
+协作框架要求 T 不超过 C/2、H 至少512、R 在2到128之间，并由 Host 核对 UB 预算。
+完整行放不下时保留 H 分段：先归并平方和求整行 invRms，再归并分段 score，
+输出按 H 分段；启用输出 RMSNorm 时还要归并输出平方和。这需要额外同步，
+不承诺一次 SyncAll。超过所有支持的分段预算时明确报错。
+不满足协作框架条件的其他 shape、非混合及 prefill 路径保留对应实现。
+当前 B=1/4/8/16、N=1到8、H=7168 的目标选路如下：
+
+| 平台 | B=1/4/8，N=1到8 | B=16，N=1到8 |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| A2 | 新 kernel，N 行并行或多 worker token 核组 | G=2，共32个打分核 |
+| A5 | 新 kernel，N 行并行或多 worker token 核组 | N1/3为G=2，其余为G=3，共32/48个打分核 |
+
+Host 通过 `ShouldUseCooperativeKernel` 控制准入，仅接受非空且 `tokenGroupSize!=1` 的计划。
+生产代码没有 B/N 白名单；上表是该通用规则在目标矩阵中的结果。
+目标矩阵之外的老 kernel 仍根据 UB 容量选择 RESIDENT 或 RELOAD，不强制指定某个旧 tiling key。
+此前 `T*(R-W) > 2*(P-T)` 的保守代理不再控制上述高占用完整行核组。
+完整行不满足 UB 预算时仍走 H 分段。
+
+## 校验与测试
+
+Torch、ACLNN 和 Tiling 检查 BF16 dtype、形状、stride、epsilon、整数溢出和 bank 写槽。
+投影严格为 `[1,H]`，epsilon 须为 FP32 可表示的有限正数；写槽不得覆盖有效历史行。
+空 token 同样先校验元数据与 dtype。Torch 拒绝写回 bank 与只读输入共享存储。
+原生 ACLNN 调用方也须保证可写 bank 不与其他输入重叠。

+## DCP 本地候选入口（Ascend 950 C8）
+
+### Kimi A5 native DCP 框架路径
+
+启用现有 sharded DCP indexer 时，A5 C8 自动使用 `npu_quant_lightning_indexer_v2`
+的 `enable_dcp=True` 路径，无需新增环境变量或服务参数。依赖包含 DCP 接口的
+QLI V2 和 metadata 算子包，以及重新编译的 vllm-ascend C++ 扩展。
+
+- 保持 FP8 E4M3 query/key、FP32 weights/descale、`quant_mode=1`、
+  `mask_mode=3`、`return_value=1`，key/scale 仍可共享非连续物理页。
+- metadata producer 和 QLI consumer 使用同一份全局 `causal_seqlens_kv_global`
+  及实际 DCP group 的 world/rank/interleave；`seqused_k` 仍是各请求本地有效 KV 长度。
+  metadata 在同一 forward 内跨层复用，保留 V2 runner 的提前生成和等待机制。
+- 框架只计算请求级本地 KV 长度，逐 query 因果可见范围由 QLI 内部计算。
+- 每个 rank 返回完整本地 K 个候选；现有候选打包算子将 BF16 score 转为 FP32
+  传输值，再映射全局 ID、交换并合并 TopK。这不提高原始 score 的精度。
+  C++ 绑定初始化图 padding 行为 `(-1, -inf)`，防止未写输出进入候选交换。
+
+非 A5、非 sharded DCP 及非 C8 路由不由本次接入切换。
+原有私有本地候选接口继续保留，其契约如下。
+
+回归入口：`tests/e2e/nightly/single_node/ops/singlecard_ops/test_a5_qli_native_dcp.py`。
+覆盖因果边界、共享页 stride、长 KV、旧路径/CPU 数值对照、图重放和候选合并。
+单卡模拟 owner 合并不等于真实 DCP 通信或整网性能验证。
+
+`torch.ops._C_ascend.npu_quant_lightning_indexer_local_candidates` 使用现有 QLI
+Cube/Vector 计算和 BF16 派生比较键，输出本地 INT32 索引以及 FP32 传输格式的比较值，
+形状均为 `[T, 1, K]`。FP32 转换保留比较值，不将算子的排序精度改称 FP32。
+比较键保留现有 `CAST_ROUND` 中点规则（远离零舍入），与 PyTorch BF16 的 RNE 不同。
+Query `[T, H, 128]` 和 key `[blocks, block_size, 1, 128]` 为 FP8 E4M3；
+weights、query/key descale 为 FP32。每个 rank 必须使用完整相同的 H 个 indexer heads。
+
+`local_visible_lengths[T,1]` 是每个 query 因果可见的本地前缀长度。对于 DCP 大小 R、
+rank r、interleave c 和全局可见长度 n，调用方计算：
+
+```text
+local_visible = (n // (R*c))*c + clamp(n % (R*c) - r*c, 0, c)
+global_id = (local_id // c)*(R*c) + r*c + local_id % c
+```
+
+新入口在 Top-K 前限制 score 前缀，不能先选出未来 token 再过滤。它使用私有
+`return_value=2` 模式，将已有 `output_idx_offset` 输入槽解释为上述本地可见长度；
+该模式要求 `mask_mode=0`、`cmp_ratio=1`、`quant_mode=1`，与旧入口的索引偏移语义隔离。
+长度被裁剪至 `[0, seqused_k]`；零长度、未使用的 TND padding 行返回 `(-1, -inf)`。
+长度参与设备端执行，支持图重放时改变可见范围。
+
+Key 和 scale 的 leading-axis stride 分别显式传入 native tiling，支持 128 个 key
+与 128 个 FP32 scale 共用一个 16896 字节页，不复制历史 KV 为连续张量。
+每个 rank 保留完整本地 K 个候选，框架只交换候选并按比较值和全局 token ID 合并。
+不能将本地 K 除以 R。相同分数采用较小 token ID 优先的边界选择。
+
+单算子精度回归：`tests/e2e/nightly/single_node/ops/singlecard_ops/test_quant_lightning_indexer_v2.py`。

-# quant_lightning_indexer_v2算子测试框架
-
-## 功能说明
-
-基于pytest测试框架，实现quant_lightning_indexer_v2算子的功能验证：
-
-- **CPU侧**：复现算子功能用以生成golden数据
-- **NPU侧**：通过TorchNPU进行算子直调获取实际数据
-- **精度对比**：进行CPU与NPU结果的精度对比验证算子功能
-- **双模式执行隔离**：支持直接pytest多进程执行和shell层进程隔离两种批量模式
-- **PT 复跑模式**：`batch -P <目录>` 直接执行已有 PT；增加 `-E` 才会先生成 PT
-- **可控批跑**：`-P` 统一指定 PT 生成和读取目录，支持结果路径、case 名和 1-based 序号选择
-- **性能采集**：支持挂载msprof采集算子性能数据并汇总输出
-- **运行模式切换**：支持eager直接调用和graph（torch.compile + torchair）两种算子调用模式
-
-## 当前实现范围
-
-### 参数限制
-
-- **数据格式**:
-    - **query_layout**：BSND、TND
-    - **key_layout**: PA_BBND、BSND、TND
-
-- **数据类型**:
-    - **qk_dtype**: FLOAT8_E4M3FN、INT8、HIFLOAT8、FLOAT4_E2M1
-    - **dequant_dtype**: FP32（Ascend950）、FP16（Ascend910_93）、FLOAT8_E8M0（MXFP8/MXFP4）
-    - **actual_seq_dtype**: INT32
-
-### PyTorch MX类型约定
-
-- `quant_mode`为3/5时，`query_dequant_scale`和`key_dequant_scale`必须为`torch.float8_e8m0fnu`。
-- `quant_mode`为5时，`query`和`key`的算子逻辑数据类型为`FLOAT4_E2M1`（文档简写为`float4_e2m1`）：
-    - PyTorch提供`torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2`时，优先使用该原生打包类型；名称中的`x2`表示每个物理字节打包两个E2M1逻辑元素。
-    - PyTorch未提供该类型时，使用`torch.uint8`承载已打包数据，封装层会将其按`ACL_FLOAT4_E2M1`传入算子。
-
-- **运行模式**:
-    - **eager**：直接调用 `torch.ops.cann_ops_transformer.quant_lightning_indexer`
-    - **graph**：通过 `torch.compile` + `torchair` 后端编译执行（需torchair支持）
-
-### 环境配置
-
-#### 前置要求
-
-1、 确认TorchNPU为最新版本
-2、 激活CANN包和自定义算子包
-3、 graph模式需要安装torchair编译器后端
-
-#### custom包调用
-
-支持custom包调用
-
-## 文件结构
-
-### pytest文件结构说明
-
-- test_run.sh                                  # 执行脚本，支持single/batch/batch_exec三种命令
-- batch_isolated_run.sh                        # 批量隔离执行脚本（shell层进程隔离+msprof性能采集）
-- quant_lightning_indexer_v2_golden.py         # cpu侧算子golden实现
-- quant_lightning_indexer_v2_acl_graph.py      # graph模式torchair后端实现
-- result_compare_method.py                     # cpu golden与npu输出精度对比
-- qliv2_test_utils.py                          # case选择、稳定命名和结果表公共逻辑
-- collect_perf_data.py                         # msprof性能数据收集与汇总
-- pytest.ini                                   # 创建测试标记
-
-单用例测试：
-
-- test_quant_lightning_indexer_v2_single.py    # pytest测试单用例运行主程序
-- test_quant_lightning_indexer_v2_paramset.py  # 单用例入参配置，按芯片型号自动选择用例
-
-批量测试：
-
-- test_quant_lightning_indexer_v2_batch.py     # 用例批量测试主程序并生成excel文件保存结果
-- ./batch/quant_lightning_indexer_v2_pt_loadprocess.py   # 读取pt文件并调用算子获取npu输出
-- ./batch/quant_lightning_indexer_v2_pt_save.py          # 读取excel表格批量生成用例pt文件
-- ./batch/list_pt_from_excel.py                           # 从Excel提取Testcase_Name并按名匹配pt文件（batch_exec模式用）
-
-## 架构说明
-
-- **数据生成入口**：`generate_qliv2_test_data` 复用原有 batch 数据链生成输入和 CPU golden，不调用 metadata 或主算子；参数准备仍可查询设备信息
-- **single 模式**：直接执行配置用例；指定 `--save-pt` 时保存并执行同一份实际输入，避免二次随机生成
-- **batch 模式**：`-P` 是唯一 PT 目录；有 `-E` 时先生成再执行，无 `-E` 时直接执行已有 PT
-- **batch_exec 模式**：按 Excel 的 `Testcase_Name` 筛选已有 PT，仅执行 NPU 和精度对比
-- 两路共用 `_qliv2_prepare_tensors_and_metadata` 和 `_qliv2_run_compiled_graph`，统一使用 `fullgraph=False`
-- 结果表会先落盘；index 或 return value 精度结果为 `Failed` 时，pytest 随后以非零状态退出
-
-## 使用方法
-
-在pytest文件夹路径下执行：
-
-### 运行测试用例
-
-#### 单用例调测
-
-1、手动配置test_quant_lightning_indexer_v2_paramset.py的ENABLED_PARAMS参数
-
-2、执行指令：
-
-``` bash
-bash test_run.sh single
-bash test_run.sh single --save-pt ./single_pt -O ./result/single.xlsx
-bash test_run.sh single -M graph --save-pt ./single_pt
-```
-
-#### 用例的批量生成与测试
-
-##### 方式A：test_run.sh 批量执行
-
-1、excel路径下存放用例excel表格
-
-`-P` 同时指定 PT 的保存目录和读取目录，默认是当前 pytest 目录下的 `pt_path`。
-
-##### 直接执行已有 PT
-
-不传 `-E` 时不读取 Excel、不重新生成 PT，只执行 NPU 和 compare：
-
-3、执行指令：
-
-``` bash
-bash test_run.sh batch -P ./pt_path
-bash test_run.sh batch -P ./pt_path -O ./result/rerun.xlsx
-bash test_run.sh batch -P ./pt_path -C case_b,case_a       # 按名称和给定顺序
-bash test_run.sh batch -P ./pt_path -I 3,1,5-7             # 按自然排序后的序号
-bash test_run.sh batch -P ./pt_path -M graph
-```
-
-4、配置区默认值：
-
-| 变量 | 默认值 | 命令行参数 | 说明 |
-|---|---|---|---|
-| DEFAULT_EXCEL | `./excel/test_cases.xlsx` | `-E` | Excel 用例表格路径（**必须指定具体文件名**，不支持通配符如 `./excel/*`） |
-| DEFAULT_PT_PATH | `./pt_path` | `-P` | pt 文件存放目录 |
-| （无） | `Sheet1` | `-S` | Excel Sheet 页名 |
-| （无） | `eager` | `-M` | 运行模式（eager/graph） |
-
-#### 根据 Excel 表格筛选已有 pt 批量执行（batch_exec 模式）
->
-> 仅重新执行 NPU 测试和精度对比，不重新生成 pt 文件。适用于已有 pt 文件、只需更新精度结果的场景。
-
-增加 `-E` 后，脚本先把 Excel 用例生成到 `-P`，再从同一个目录执行：
-
-2、执行指令：
-
-``` bash
-bash test_run.sh batch -E ./excel/test_cases.xlsx -P ./pt_path
-bash test_run.sh batch -E ./excel/test_cases.xlsx -S Sheet1 -P ./pt_path
-bash test_run.sh batch -E ./excel/test_cases.xlsx -P ./pt_path -O ./result/batch.xlsx
-```
-
-3、执行流程：
-
-- 从 Excel 表格读取 `Testcase_Name` 列
-- 按 `<Testcase_Name>.pt` 在 pt_path 下匹配对应的 .pt 文件
-- 仅对匹配到的 .pt 文件执行 NPU 测试和精度对比
-- 生成 `result.xlsx` 测试结果表格
-- 如果 Excel 中某条用例无对应的 .pt 文件，会输出警告并跳过该用例
-
-4、与 `batch` 模式的区别：
-
-|  | `batch` | `batch_exec` |
-|---|---|---|
-| pt 生成 | 每次重新生成 | 跳过 |
-| 执行速度 | 较慢（含 pt 生成） | 较快 |
-| 适用场景 | 首次运行 / 参数变更 | 精度复测 / 仅 NPU 结果更新 |
-
-##### 方式B：手工分步执行
-
-1、生成pt文件：
-
-``` bash
-python3 batch/quant_lightning_indexer_v2_pt_save.py excel/test_cases.xlsx pt_path
-python3 batch/quant_lightning_indexer_v2_pt_save.py excel/test_cases.xlsx pt_path --sheet Sheet1  # 指定 Sheet 页
-```
-
-2、替换测试脚本路径：
-
-``` bash
-QLIV2_TESTCASE_DIR=pt_path QLIV2_RESULT_PATH=result.xlsx \
-python3 -m pytest -rA -s test_quant_lightning_indexer_v2_batch.py -v -m ci
-```
-
-3、执行测试：
-
-``` bash
-python3 -m pytest -rA -s test_quant_lightning_indexer_v2_batch.py -v -m ci -W ignore::UserWarning -W ignore::DeprecationWarning
-```
-
-4、恢复测试脚本：
-
-``` bash
-cp test_quant_lightning_indexer_v2_batch.py.bak test_quant_lightning_indexer_v2_batch.py
-```
-
-##### 方式C：批量隔离执行（推荐用于性能采集）
-
-对每条用例单独拉起一个pytest进程，实现进程间完全隔离，避免单条用例崩溃影响其他用例。
-
-``` bash
-bash batch_isolated_run.sh ./pt_path 0         # 不采集性能
-bash batch_isolated_run.sh ./pt_path 1         # 采集性能（挂载msprof）
-bash batch_isolated_run.sh ./pt_path 0 graph   # graph模式 + 不采集性能
-bash batch_isolated_run.sh ./pt_path 1 graph   # graph模式 + 性能采集
-```
-
-## Excel 用例表格式
-
-`excel/test_cases.xlsx` 需包含以下列（Sheet1）：
-
-| 列名 | 类型 | 示例 |
-|---|---|---|
-| Testcase_Name | str | `test_case_01` |
-| batch_size | int | `8` |
-| q_seq | int | `15` |
-| k_seq | int | `111` |
-| q_t_size | int | `8` |
-| k_t_size | int | `15` |
-| q_head_num | int | `64` |
-| k_head_num | int | `1` |
-| head_dim | int | `128` |
-| block_size | int | `512` |
-| block_num | int | `8` |
-| qk_dtype | str | `FLOAT8_E4M3FN` / `INT8` / `HIFLOAT8` / `FLOAT4_E2M1` |
-| dequant_dtype | str | `FP32` / `FP16` / `FLOAT8_E8M0` |
-| actual_seq_dtype | str | `INT32` |
-| cu_seqlens_q | None/str | `None` 或 `"[0, 1]"` |
-| cu_seqlens_k | None/str | `None` 或 `"[0, 1]"` |
-| seqused_q | None/str | `None` 或 `"[3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3]"` |
-| seqused_k | str | `"[28,24,80,96,47,76,0,111]"` |
-| cmp_residual_k | None/str | `None` 或 `"[0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]"`（cmp_ratio>1时必填）|
-| max_seqlen_q | int | `-1` |
-| quant_mode | int | `1` / `2` / `4` |
-| layout_query | str | `BSND` / `TND` |
-| layout_key | str | `PA_BBND` |
-| sparse_count | int | `512` |
-| sparse_mode | int | `0` / `3` |
-| query_datarange | str | `"[-448,448]"` |
-| key_datarange | str | `"[-20,20]"` |
-| weights_datarange | str | `"[-123,123]"` |
-| q_scale_datarange | str | `"[0,255]"` |
-| k_scale_datarange | str | `"[0,65504]"` |
-| cmp_ratio | int | `1` / `4` |
-| return_value | int | `0` / `1` |
-| output_idx_offset | None/str | `None` 或列表字符串 |
-
-**注意事项**：
-
-- `dequant_dtype`：Ascend950的`quant_mode=3/5`仅支持`FLOAT8_E8M0`，其他量化模式支持`FP32`；Ascend910_93支持`FP16`
-- `cmp_ratio > 1`且`sparse_mode != 0`时，`cmp_residual_k`必填（长度=batch_size的列表）
-- `return_value=1`时，`output_idx_offset`需提供有效值
-- Ascend910_93要求`quant_mode=2`
-
-## 输出文件
-
-| 文件 | 说明 |
-|---|---|
-| `result.xlsx` | 测试结果（精度、参数等） |
-| `result_perf.xlsx` | 测试结果 + 性能数据（仅msprof模式） |
-| `batch_summary.log` | 批量执行详细日志 |
-| `batch_fail_list.log` | 失败用例清单 |
-| `PROF_*/` | msprof性能原始数据目录 |

-    hif8_value_tmp = fraction32_int >> (FP32_FRACTION_BITS - (hif8_bits_num + 1))

+def test_attn_res_fwd_cooperative(
+    tokens, valid, hidden, with_add, with_norm, save_materialized, padded_bank, write_bank, record_property
+):
+    # Cover score-only workers, multiple tasks per core, odd H, and full-row
+    # output ownership. Multi-worker groups join one readiness barrier; local
+    # groups keep scores in UB and skip cross-core synchronization.
+    torch.manual_seed(42 + tokens + valid)
+    prefix = torch.randn(tokens, hidden, device="npu", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    addend = torch.randn_like(prefix) if with_add else None
+    capacity = max(8, valid + 1)
+    storage = torch.randn(tokens, capacity + (2 if padded_bank else 0), hidden, device="npu", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    bank = storage[:, :capacity]
+    bank[:, valid:] = float("nan")
+    projection = (torch.randn(1, hidden, device="npu") / hidden**0.5).bfloat16()
+    gamma = torch.randn(hidden, device="npu", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    output_gamma = torch.randn_like(gamma) if with_norm else None
+    prefix_before = prefix.cpu().clone()
+    addend_before = addend.cpu().clone() if with_add else None
+    bank_before = storage.cpu().clone()
+    norm_eps, output_eps = 1e-5, 1e-4
+
+    # Independent CPU reference, including both BF16 rounding boundaries and
+    # distinct epsilons for residual scoring and output normalization.
+    raw_ref = (prefix_before + addend_before) if with_add else prefix_before
+    values = torch.cat((bank_before[:, :valid], raw_ref[:, None]), dim=1).float()
+    keys = values * torch.rsqrt(values.square().mean(-1, keepdim=True) + norm_eps)
+    logits = (keys * gamma.cpu().float() * projection.cpu().float()).sum(-1)
+    mixture = (logits.softmax(-1)[..., None] * values).sum(1).bfloat16()
+    output_ref = mixture
+    if with_norm:
+        x = mixture.float()
+        output_ref = (
+            x * torch.rsqrt(x.square().mean(-1, keepdim=True) + output_eps) * output_gamma.cpu().float()
+        ).bfloat16()
+
+    write_idx = valid if write_bank else -1
+    output, raw, materialized = torch.ops._C_ascend.attn_res_fwd(
+        prefix,
+        addend,
+        bank,
+        projection,
+        gamma,
+        norm_eps,
+        valid,
+        output_gamma,
+        output_eps,
+        write_idx,
+        save_materialized,
+    )
+    torch_npu.npu.synchronize()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(raw.cpu(), raw_ref, rtol=0, atol=0)

+    if save_materialized:
+        comparisons.append(("materialized", materialized, mixture))
+    for name, actual, expected in comparisons:
+        error = (actual.float().cpu() - expected.float()).abs()
+        matched_ratio = (error <= (1 + expected.float().abs()) / 64).float().mean().item()
+        max_abs_error = error.max().item()
+        record_property(f"{name}_matched_ratio", matched_ratio)
+        record_property(f"{name}_max_abs_error", max_abs_error)
+        assert torch.isfinite(actual).all()

+def _make_case(heads, rope_dim, query_tokens, count):
+    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(20261029)
+    page_size, nope_dim, tile_size = 128, 512, 128
+    length = 4096 if count == 2048 else 128
+    query = torch.randn(query_tokens, heads, nope_dim + rope_dim, generator=generator).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    kv_dtype = torch.float8_e4m3fn if get_ascend_device_type() == AscendDeviceType.A5 else torch.int8
+    key_nope = (torch.randn(length, 1, nope_dim, generator=generator) * 2).to(kv_dtype)
+    key_rope = torch.randn(length, 1, rope_dim, generator=generator).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    scales = torch.rand(length, 1, nope_dim // tile_size, generator=generator) * 0.1 + 0.05
+    cache = (
+        torch.cat((key_nope.view(torch.uint8), key_rope.view(torch.uint8), scales.view(torch.uint8)), -1)
+        .reshape(length // page_size, page_size, 1, -1)
+        .view(kv_dtype)
+    )
+    indices = torch.full((query_tokens, 1, 2048), -1, dtype=torch.int32)
+    # All selected tokens are visible to every query in this chunk.
+    selected = torch.randperm(length - query_tokens + 1, generator=generator)[:count]
+    indices[:, 0, :count] = selected.to(torch.int32)
+    scale = (nope_dim + rope_dim) ** -0.5
+    kv_npu = cache.npu()
+    inputs = dict(
+        query=query.npu(),
+        key=kv_npu,
+        value=kv_npu,
+        sparse_indices=indices.npu(),
+        scale_value=scale,
+        sparse_block_size=1,
+        block_table=torch.arange(length // page_size, dtype=torch.int32).view(1, -1).npu(),
+        actual_seq_lengths_query=torch.tensor([query_tokens], dtype=torch.int32).npu(),
+        actual_seq_lengths_kv=torch.tensor([length], dtype=torch.int32).npu(),
+        layout_query="TND",
+        layout_kv="PA_BSND",
+        sparse_mode=3,

+        tile_size=tile_size,
+        key_quant_mode=2,
+        value_quant_mode=2,
+        rope_head_dim=rope_dim,

+def _check_reference(result, query, key, value, scale, return_lse):

+            assert torch.isneginf(maximum + total.log()).all()

+    if return_lse:

+    inputs["query"].copy_(changed_query)

+"""DCP8 rank-local QSFA boundary and changed-input graph replay on A3/A5.
+
+The physical page is 768 tokens and the operator page is 128 tokens. This
+exercises the 138-column view at the 135807 + 4 global-token boundary without
+requiring a full model or issuing an illegal device access on the old version.

+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_local_block_table_refresh_between_graph_replays(batch):
+    backing = torch.zeros(batch, 144, dtype=torch.int32, device="npu")
+    builder = AscendSFADCPMetadataBuilder.__new__(AscendSFADCPMetadataBuilder)
+    builder.max_local_block_table_cols = 138
+    builder.dcp_local_seq_lens_buf = torch.empty(batch, dtype=torch.int32, device="npu")
+    builder._local_block_table_buffers = {}
+    table = builder._get_dcp_local_block_table(backing, batch)
+    pages = torch.arange(batch * 2, dtype=torch.float32, device="npu")
+
+    def read_pages():
+        return torch.index_select(pages, 0, table[:, 0].to(torch.int64))
+

+        expected = torch.arange(batch, dtype=torch.int32) + offset
+        backing[:, 0].copy_(expected.npu())
+        table = builder._get_dcp_local_block_table(backing, batch)
+        graph.replay()
+        assert torch.equal(result.cpu(), expected.float())
+        torch.testing.assert_close(result, read_pages(), rtol=0, atol=0)
+    graph.reset()

+    # Each request has its own pages. The final column has a different value
+    # so dropping or misaddressing the tail changes the numerical result.
+    base = (torch.arange(batch) % 4 + 1).float()
+    values = base[:, None].expand(batch, cols).clone()
+    values[:, 0] += 16
+    values[:, -1] += 4
+    key_nope = values[:, :, None, None, None].expand(batch, cols, page_size, 1, nope).contiguous().to(dtype)
+    key_rope = torch.zeros(batch, cols, page_size, 1, rope, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    scales = torch.ones(batch, cols, page_size, 1, 4, dtype=torch.float32)
+    packed = torch.cat((key_nope.view(torch.uint8), key_rope.view(torch.uint8), scales.view(torch.uint8)), -1)
+    cache = packed.reshape(batch * cols, page_size, 1, 656).view(dtype).npu()
+    query = torch.zeros(batch * queries, heads, nope + rope, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="npu")
+    backing = torch.zeros(batch, cols + 6, dtype=torch.int32, device="npu")

+    kv_lens = torch.full((batch,), local_len, dtype=torch.int32, device="npu")

+    def run():

+            key_quant_mode=2,
+            value_quant_mode=2,
+            block_table=table,
+            actual_seq_lengths_query=q_lens,
+            actual_seq_lengths_kv=kv_lens,
+            sparse_block_size=1,
+            layout_query="TND",
+            layout_kv="PA_BSND",
+            sparse_mode=0,
+            attention_mode=2,
+            quant_scale_repo_mode=1,
+            tile_size=128,
+            rope_head_dim=rope,
+            return_softmax_lse=True,
+        )
+
+    def select(count):
+        selected = torch.arange(local_len - count, local_len, dtype=torch.int32)
+        indices.fill_(-1)
+        indices[:, 0, :count].copy_(selected.to("npu"))
+        return selected
+
+    def check(result, selected):
+        output, maximum, total = [tensor.cpu().float() for tensor in result]
+        page_ids = backing.cpu()[:, :cols][:, selected.long() // page_size]
+        reference = values.flatten()[page_ids.long()].mean(-1)
+        reference = reference.repeat_interleave(queries)[:, None, None].expand_as(output)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(output, reference, atol=0.04, rtol=0.01)
+        lse = maximum + total.log()
+        torch.testing.assert_close(lse, torch.full_like(lse, math.log(selected.numel())), atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5)

+    with torch.npu.graph(graph):

+    last_page = (local_len - 1) // page_size

+    selected = select(32)
+    graph.replay()
+    torch.npu.synchronize()
+    check(result, selected)
+    eager = run()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(result[0], eager[0])
+    graph.reset()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Independent CPU references for DCP operator tests."""
+
+import torch
+
+
+def local_to_global(indices, world_size, rank, interleave):
+    mapped = (indices // interleave * world_size + rank) * interleave + indices % interleave
+    return torch.where(indices >= 0, mapped, -1).to(torch.int32)
+
+
+def local_visible_lengths(visible, world_size, rank, interleave):
+    cycles = visible // (world_size * interleave)
+    tail = (visible % (world_size * interleave) - rank * interleave).clamp(0, interleave)
+    return cycles * interleave + tail
+
+
+def query_visible_lengths(seq_lens, cum_query_lens, rows, requests):
+    visible = (seq_lens[requests] - cum_query_lens[requests] + rows + 1).clamp_min(0)
+    return torch.where(rows < cum_query_lens[-1], visible, 0)
+
+
+def remap_reference(indices, world_size, rank, interleave):
+    result = torch.full_like(indices, -1)
+    for source, target in zip(indices.reshape(-1, indices.shape[-1]), result.reshape(-1, indices.shape[-1])):
+        owned = source[(source >= 0) & ((source // interleave) % world_size == rank)]
+        target[: owned.numel()] = owned // (world_size * interleave) * interleave + owned % interleave
+    return result
+
+
+def merge_topk_candidates(indices, scores, topk, *, local_rank=None, world_size=1, interleave=1):
+    indices, scores = indices.cpu(), scores.cpu().float()
+    valid = (indices >= 0) & torch.isfinite(scores)
+    values = torch.where(valid, scores, -torch.inf)
+    keys = torch.where(valid, indices, torch.iinfo(torch.int32).max)
+    by_id = keys.argsort(dim=-1, stable=True)
+    by_score = values.gather(-1, by_id).argsort(dim=-1, descending=True, stable=True)[..., :topk]
+    order = by_id.gather(-1, by_score)
+    selected = torch.where(values.gather(-1, order).isfinite(), indices.gather(-1, order), -1).to(torch.int32)
+    return selected if local_rank is None else remap_reference(selected, world_size, local_rank, interleave)
+
+
+def assert_dcp_close(actual, golden):
+    rtol, atol, fixed_limit = {
+        torch.float16: (2**-9, 2**-9, 0.1),
+        torch.bfloat16: (2**-6, 2**-6, 1.0),
+        torch.float32: (2**-10, 2**-16, 0.01),
+    }[actual.dtype]
+    limit = max(fixed_limit, 32 * torch.finfo(actual.dtype).eps)
+    error = (actual.cpu().double() - golden.cpu().double()).abs()
+    assert torch.isfinite(error).all()
+    if error.numel():
+        passing = error <= atol + rtol * golden.cpu().double().abs()
+        assert passing.double().mean() >= 0.99
+        assert error.max() <= limit

+def test_candidate_pipeline_and_changed_graph_inputs(world, rows, topk, local_k, dtype, local_rank, ties):
+    torch.npu.set_device(0)
+    interleave = 768
+    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(20883)
+    ids = torch.randint(0, 131072, (world, rows, 1, local_k), dtype=torch.int32, generator=generator)
+    scores = torch.randn(ids.shape, generator=generator).to(dtype)
+    if ties:
+        scores.fill_(1)
+    ids[:, 0] = -1
+    scores[..., :5] = torch.tensor([torch.nan, torch.inf, -torch.inf, 0.0, -0.0], dtype=dtype)
+    if dtype == torch.float32:
+        scores[..., 5:7] = torch.tensor([1.0, torch.nextafter(torch.tensor(1.0), torch.tensor(2.0))])
+    device_ids = torch.stack((ids, ids), -1).npu()[..., 0]
+    device_scores = torch.stack((scores, scores), -1).npu()[..., 1]
+    storage = torch.full((rows + 2, 1, topk), -123, dtype=torch.int32, device="npu")
+    result = storage[1:-1]
+    presorted = topk == 2048 and local_k <= 2048
+
+    def run():
+        packed = torch.cat(
+            [
+                pack_local_candidates(
+                    device_ids[r],
+                    device_scores[r],
+                    world,
+                    r,
+                    interleave,
+                    sort_candidates=presorted,
+                    fuse_sort=local_rank is not None,
+                )
+                for r in range(world)
+            ],
+            0,
+        )
+        return merge_packed_candidates(
+            packed,
+            rows,
+            world,
+            topk,
+            local_rank=local_rank,
+            interleave=interleave,
+            out=result,
+            presorted=presorted,
+            owner_sharded=local_rank is not None,
+        )
+
+    def expected():
+        global_ids = torch.cat([local_to_global(ids[r], world, r, interleave) for r in range(world)], -1)
+        return merge_topk_candidates(
+            global_ids,
+            torch.cat(list(scores.float()), -1),
+            topk,
+            local_rank=local_rank,
+            world_size=world,
+            interleave=interleave,
+        )
+
+    for _ in range(3):
+        run()
+    assert torch.equal(result.cpu(), expected())
+    graph = torch.npu.NPUGraph()
+    with torch.npu.graph(graph):
+        run()
+    for invalid in (False, True):
+        if invalid:
+            ids.fill_(-1)
+        else:
+            ids.copy_(ids.flip(-1))
+            scores[0].fill_(100)
+        device_ids.copy_(ids)
+        device_scores.copy_(scores)
+        graph.replay()
+        assert torch.equal(result.cpu(), expected())
+        assert (storage[[0, -1]].cpu() == -123).all()
+    graph.reset()
+

+    torch.npu.set_device(0)
+    k, rank, interleave = 2048, world - 1, 768
+    ids = torch.arange(k, dtype=torch.int32).repeat(rows, 1).view(rows, 1, k)
+    ids[..., -1] = 1 << 24
+    scores = torch.randn(ids.shape).to(dtype)
+    scores[..., :7] = torch.tensor([torch.nan, torch.inf, -torch.inf, 0.0, -0.0, 1.0, -1.0], dtype=dtype)
+    valid = (ids >= 0) & scores.isfinite()
+    values = torch.where(valid, scores.float(), -torch.inf)
+    mapped = torch.where(valid, local_to_global(ids, world, rank, interleave), -1)
+    by_id = torch.where(valid, ids, torch.iinfo(torch.int32).max).argsort(stable=True)
+    order = by_id.gather(-1, values.gather(-1, by_id).argsort(descending=True, stable=True))
+    expected = torch.stack((mapped.gather(-1, order), values.gather(-1, order).contiguous().view(torch.int32)), -1)[
+        :, 0
+    ]
+    actual = pack_local_candidates(

+    )

+def assert_matches_native(cache, x, host_slots, initial):
+    key, scale, backing = cache
+    quantized, fp32_scale = torch_npu.npu_dynamic_quant(x.contiguous(), dst_type=torch.int8)
+    quantized, fp16_scale = quantized.cpu(), fp32_scale.half().cpu()
+    if backing is None:
+        expected_key, expected_scale = (value.clone() for value in initial)
+    else:
+        expected_backing = initial.clone()
+        expected_key = expected_backing.view(torch.int8).as_strided(key.shape, key.stride(), key.storage_offset())
+        expected_scale = expected_backing.view(torch.float16).as_strided(
+            scale.shape, scale.stride(), scale.storage_offset()
+        )
+    for row, slot in enumerate(host_slots.tolist()):
+        if 0 <= slot < key.shape[0] * key.shape[1]:
+            page, token = divmod(slot, key.shape[1])
+            expected_key[page, token, 0].copy_(quantized[row])
+            expected_scale[page, token, 0, 0] = fp16_scale[row]
+    torch.testing.assert_close(key.cpu(), expected_key, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(scale.cpu(), expected_scale, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    if backing is not None:
+        # Includes untouched slots, both planes, page gaps and allocation guards.
+        torch.testing.assert_close(backing.cpu(), expected_backing, rtol=0, atol=0)

+@torch.inference_mode()
+def benchmark(tokens, trials):
+    """Measure separate graphs to exclude Python launch gaps and JIT warmup."""
+    assert get_current_hardware_profile().supports(HardwareCapability.NATIVE_INT8_SPARSE)
+    x, slots, host_slots = make_inputs(tokens, slot_dtype=torch.int32)
+    baseline, candidate = make_cache(), make_cache()
+    cache_scatter_indices = torch.stack((slots // baseline[0].shape[1], slots % baseline[0].shape[1]), dim=-1)
+
+    def split():
+        k, scale = torch_npu.npu_dynamic_quant(x, dst_type=torch.int8)
+        scale = scale.half()
+        AscendSFAIndexerBackend._write_cache_tensor(baseline[0], k, slots, cache_scatter_indices)
+        AscendSFAIndexerBackend._write_cache_tensor(baseline[1], scale.unsqueeze(-1), slots, cache_scatter_indices)
+
+    def fused():
+        indexer_quant_cache_int8(candidate[0], candidate[1], x, slots)
+
+    initial = snapshot(candidate)
+    split()
+    fused()
+    assert_matches_native(candidate, x, host_slots, initial)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(candidate[2].cpu(), baseline[2].cpu(), rtol=0, atol=0)
+    repeats = 100
+    graphs = {}
+    for name, fn in (("split", split), ("fused", fused)):
+        for _ in range(5):
+            fn()
+        torch.npu.synchronize()
+        graph = torch.npu.NPUGraph()
+        with torch.npu.graph(graph):
+            for _ in range(repeats):
+                fn()
+        for _ in range(5):
+            graph.replay()
+        graphs[name] = graph
+    samples: dict[str, list[float]] = {name: [] for name in graphs}
+    for trial in range(trials):
+        names = ("split", "fused") if trial % 2 == 0 else ("fused", "split")
+        for name in names:
+            start, end = torch.npu.Event(enable_timing=True), torch.npu.Event(enable_timing=True)
+            start.record()
+            graphs[name].replay()
+            end.record()
+            end.synchronize()
+            samples[name].append(start.elapsed_time(end) * 1000 / repeats)
+    medians = {name: statistics.median(values) for name, values in samples.items()}
+    print(json.dumps({"tokens": tokens, "trials": trials, "median_us": medians, "samples_us": samples}, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--tokens", type=int, choices=(1, 3, 16, 48, 128), default=48)
+    parser.add_argument("--trials", type=int, default=30)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.trials < 1:
+        parser.error("--trials must be positive")
+    benchmark(args.tokens, args.trials)

+def _create_builder(spec, config, indexer):
+    # Exercise the real upstream factory, including its kernel-size spec copy.
+    cls = AscendSFAIndexerMetadataBuilder if indexer else AscendSFADCPMetadataBuilder
+    backend = SimpleNamespace(get_builder_cls=lambda: cls, get_supported_kernel_block_sizes=lambda _spec: [128])

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("indexer", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("physical_size", [128, 768, 1536])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("max_len", [135807, 135808, 135809, 135811, 140000])
+def test_dcp_factory_preserves_complete_physical_pages(indexer, physical_size, max_len):
+    config = _config(max_len, physical_size)
+    spec_cls = AscendSFAIndexerCacheSpec if indexer else AscendMLAAttentionSpec
+    spec = spec_cls(block_size=physical_size, num_kv_heads=1, head_size=128, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    builder = _create_builder(spec, config, indexer)
+    physical_cols = spec.max_num_blocks_per_req(config, max_len)
+    split = physical_size // 128
+    assert builder.blocks_per_phys_block == split
+    assert builder.max_local_block_table_cols == physical_cols * split
+
+    table = AscendBlockTables.__new__(AscendBlockTables)
+    table.blocks_per_kv_block = [split]
+    storage = torch.zeros(30, physical_cols * split, dtype=torch.int32)
+
+    def write_row(self, req_index, new_block_ids, overwrite):
+        assert overwrite
+        storage[req_index, : len(new_block_ids[0])] = torch.tensor(new_block_ids[0], dtype=torch.int32)
+
+    # Distinct non-consecutive physical pages expose both lost tail columns and
+    # accidental reads from the next request. Include the last batch row.
+    # Exercise V2's real expansion; replace only the parent's staged device write.
+    with patch.object(BlockTables, "append_block_ids", write_row):
+        for row in range(30):
+            pages = [1 + 2 * col + row * physical_cols * 3 for col in range(physical_cols)]
+            table.append_block_ids(row, (pages,), overwrite=True)
+    local = get_sfa_dcp_local_block_table(storage, 30, builder.max_local_block_table_cols)
+    assert local.is_contiguous()
+    assert local.shape == (30, physical_cols * split)
+
+    # Independently assign every token to a rank, rather than checking against
+    # a second copy of the capacity formula.
+    global_tokens = torch.arange(max_len)
+    for rank in range(8):
+        owned = global_tokens[(global_tokens // physical_size) % 8 == rank]
+        local_indices = torch.arange(owned.numel())
+        assert local_indices.numel() <= local.shape[1] * 128
+        if local_indices.numel():
+            last = int(local_indices[-1])
+            for row in (0, 28, 29):
+                page = 1 + 2 * (last // physical_size) + row * physical_cols * 3
+                slot = int(local[row, last // 128]) * 128 + last % 128
+                assert slot == page * physical_size + last % physical_size

+"""Reproduce paired-SFA/DSpark spec geometry without constructing model weights.
+
+Run in the approved runtime container, e.g.::
+
+    python tests/ut/core/check_paired_sfa_dspark_geometry.py --draft-cache-dtype auto
+
+The default geometry is the delivered K3.1 TP16 checkpoint and five-layer
+DSpark draft after platform Mamba alignment to 768 tokens. Dtype is explicit:
+select the value assigned by the installed draft-loading context. This uses
+the real MLA spec method and worker conversion; only attention-layer discovery
+and non-geometric global feature switches are supplied by the harness.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)

+    parser.add_argument("--draft-cache-dtype", choices=("auto", "bfloat16", "int8"), required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    import torch
+    from vllm.model_executor.models.deepseek_v2 import DeepseekV32IndexerCache
+    from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import MambaSpec, MLAAttentionSpec
+
+    from vllm_ascend.models.kimi_k3 import paired_sfa_cache
+    from vllm_ascend.worker.v2 import attn_utils

+    config = SimpleNamespace(
+        parallel_config=SimpleNamespace(decode_context_parallel_size=16),
+        cache_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            block_size=args.block_size, cache_dtype="int8", mamba_page_size_padded=args.block_size * 656
+        ),
+        attention_config=SimpleNamespace(indexer_kv_dtype="int8"),
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            hf_text_config=SimpleNamespace(
+                model_type="kimi_linear", kv_lora_rank=512, qk_rope_head_dim=64, index_head_dim=128
+            ),
+        ),
+        scheduler_config=SimpleNamespace(disable_hybrid_kv_cache_manager=False),
+    )
+    ascend_config = SimpleNamespace(
+        sparse_kv_offload_config=SimpleNamespace(enabled=False),
+        is_sparse_li_c8_layer=lambda name: True,
+        is_sparse_li_c4_layer=lambda name: False,
+    )
+
+    def make_mla(name, cache_dtype, *, sparse):
+        layer = attn_utils.MLAAttention.__new__(attn_utils.MLAAttention)
+        torch.nn.Module.__init__(layer)
+        layer.layer_name = name
+        layer.is_draft_layer = not sparse
+        layer.num_heads = 4
+        layer.num_kv_heads = 1
+        layer.head_size = 576
+        layer.kv_lora_rank = 512
+        layer.qk_rope_head_dim = 64
+        layer.kv_cache_dtype = cache_dtype
+        layer.sliding_window = None
+        layer.indexer = object() if sparse else None
+        # The delivered draft has neither dflash_config.causal nor
+        # full_attention_causal, so K3 DSpark enables its non-causal window.
+        layer.non_causal_multi_token_decode = not sparse
+        layer.impl = SimpleNamespace(
+            fa_quant_layer=False,
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            enable_sparse_sfa_c8=sparse,
+            enable_sparse_sfa_turboquant=False,
+        )
+        return layer
+
+    target = "language_model.model.layers.3.self_attn.attn"
+    indexer_name = "language_model.model.layers.3.self_attn.indexer.k_cache"
+    indexer = DeepseekV32IndexerCache.__new__(DeepseekV32IndexerCache)
+    torch.nn.Module.__init__(indexer)
+    indexer.is_draft_layer = False
+    indexer.get_kv_cache_spec = lambda cfg: MLAAttentionSpec(
+        block_size=cfg.cache_config.block_size,
+        num_kv_heads=1,
+        head_size=128,
+        dtype=torch.int8,
+        cache_dtype_str="int8",
+    )
+    mamba = MambaSpec(
+        block_size=args.block_size,
+        shapes=((3, 2304), (6, 128, 128)),
+        dtypes=(torch.bfloat16, torch.float32),
+        mamba_cache_mode="align",
+        page_size_padded=config.cache_config.mamba_page_size_padded,
+    )
+    layers = {
+        target: make_mla(target, "int8", sparse=True),
+        indexer_name: indexer,
+        "language_model.model.layers.0.linear_attn": SimpleNamespace(
+            get_kv_cache_spec=lambda cfg: mamba, is_draft_layer=False
+        ),
+    }
+    for index in range(5):
+        name = f"model.layers.{93 + index}.self_attn.attn"
+        layers[name] = make_mla(name, args.draft_cache_dtype, sparse=False)
+
+    with (
+        patch.object(attn_utils, "get_layers_from_vllm_config", return_value=layers),
+        patch.object(attn_utils, "enable_sfa_dcp_replicated_indexer", return_value=False),
+        patch.object(attn_utils, "enable_sfa", return_value=True),
+        patch.object(attn_utils, "get_ascend_config", return_value=ascend_config),
+    ):
+        captured = attn_utils.get_kv_cache_spec(config)
+
+    assert captured, "Worker conversion did not produce cache specs"
+    summary = {
+        name: {
+            "type": type(spec).__name__,
+            "block_size": spec.block_size,
+            "head_size": getattr(spec, "head_size", None),
+            "dtype": str(getattr(spec, "dtype", None)),
+            "raw_page_bytes": getattr(spec, "real_page_size_bytes", spec.page_size_bytes),
+            "page_bytes": spec.page_size_bytes,
+            "packed_sfa": getattr(spec, "cache_sparse_sfa_c8", False),
+            "non_causal": getattr(spec, "non_causal_multi_token_decode", False),
+        }
+        for name, spec in captured.items()
+    }
+    target_only = {name: spec for name, spec in captured.items() if not name.startswith("model.layers.")}
+    groups = paired_sfa_cache.paired_sfa_cache_groups(config, target_only)
+    print(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "draft_cache_dtype": args.draft_cache_dtype,
+                "specs": summary,
+                "target_only_plan": "passed",
+                "target_only_group_count": len(groups),
+                "target_only_pool_bytes": paired_sfa_cache.paired_sfa_pool_bytes(groups),
+            },
+            indent=2,
+        )
+    )
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""CPU routing tests for the production MLP wrapper and linear quantization.
+
+The upstream MLP/SiTU contract is represented by CPU fixtures; NPU operations
+are mocked. These tests check activation/quantization boundaries, not device math.
+"""
+
+import ast
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+
+
+def load_nodes(path, names, scope):
+    tree = ast.parse((ROOT / path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    nodes = [n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, (ast.ClassDef, ast.FunctionDef)) and n.name in names]
+    assert {n.name for n in nodes} == set(names)
+    future = ast.ImportFrom(module="__future__", names=[ast.alias(name="annotations")], level=0)
+    exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[future, *nodes], type_ignores=[])), path, "exec"), scope)
+
+
+class Situ(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, beta, linear_beta, calls):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.beta, self.linear_beta = beta, linear_beta
+        self.calls = calls
+        self.output = None
+
+    def forward(self, x):
+        self.calls.append("activation")
+        gate, up = x.float().chunk(2, dim=-1)
+        gate = self.beta * torch.tanh(gate / self.beta) * torch.sigmoid(gate)
+        if self.linear_beta is not None:
+            up = self.linear_beta * torch.tanh(up / self.linear_beta)
+        self.output = (gate * up).to(x.dtype)
+        return self.output
+
+
+class MLPBase(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
+        super().__init__()
+        config = kwargs["quant_config"]
+        self.act_fn = Situ(kwargs["activation_situ_beta"], kwargs["activation_situ_linear_beta"], config.calls)
+        self.reduce_results = kwargs["reduce_results"]
+        self.down_proj = config.down_proj
+        self.gate_up_proj = config.gate_up_proj
+
+    def forward(self, x):
+        gate_up, _ = self.gate_up_proj(x)
+        return self.down_proj(self.act_fn(gate_up))[0]
+

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import ColumnParallelLinear, MergedColumnParallelLinear
+from vllm.model_executor.models.utils import PPMissingLayer
+
+from vllm_ascend.models.kimi_k3.kimi_k3 import AscendKimiLinearModel
+
+
+def make_linear(cls, output_sizes, tp_size=1, tp_rank=0):
+    # Exercise the real parameter loaders without initializing device kernels
+    # or a distributed process group. Tensor contents verify TP slicing.
+    layer = cls.__new__(cls)
+    nn.Module.__init__(layer)
+    layer.prefix = "layers.0.self_attn.g_proj" if cls is ColumnParallelLinear else "layers.0.self_attn.fused_qkv_a_proj"
+    layer.tp_rank = tp_rank
+    layer.tp_size = tp_size
+    layer.output_sizes = output_sizes
+    return layer
+
+
+def add_parameter(layer, name, shape, dtype=torch.float32, output_dim=0):
+    param = nn.Parameter(torch.full(shape, -1, dtype=dtype), requires_grad=False)
+    if output_dim is not None:
+        param.output_dim = output_dim
+    param.weight_loader = layer.weight_loader
+    layer.register_parameter(name, param)
+    return param
+
+
+def make_model(tp_size=1, tp_rank=0, fused_gate=False):
+    model = AscendKimiLinearModel.__new__(AscendKimiLinearModel)
+    nn.Module.__init__(model)
+    model.config = SimpleNamespace(
+        is_moe=False,
+        is_linear_attn=True,
+        linear_attn_config={"use_full_rank_gate": True},
+        q_lora_rank=1536,
+        mla_use_output_gate=True,
+        num_hidden_layers=2,
+        num_nextn_predict_layers=0,
+    )
+    model.n_redundant_experts = 0
+    layer = nn.Module()
+    layer.self_attn = nn.Module()
+    sizes = [4, 2, 32] if fused_gate else [4, 2]
+    fused = make_linear(MergedColumnParallelLinear, sizes)
+    add_parameter(fused, "weight", (sum(sizes), 4))
+    add_parameter(fused, "weight_scale", (sum(sizes), 1))
+    layer.self_attn.fused_qkv_a_proj = fused
+    if not fused_gate:
+        layer.self_attn.g_proj = make_linear(ColumnParallelLinear, [32], tp_size, tp_rank)
+    model.layers = nn.ModuleList([layer, PPMissingLayer()])
+    return model
+
+
+TP_RANKS = [(size, rank) for size in (1, 8, 16) for rank in range(size)]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tp_size,tp_rank", TP_RANKS)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.bfloat16, torch.int8, torch.float8_e4m3fn])
+def test_standalone_gate_loads_weights_and_quant_parameters(tp_size, tp_rank, dtype):
+    model = make_model(tp_size, tp_rank)
+    gate = model.layers[0].self_attn.g_proj
+    rows = 32 // tp_size
+    weights = []
+    expected = {}
+    for name, width, param_dtype in [
+        ("weight", 4, dtype),
+        ("weight_scale", 1, torch.float32),
+        ("weight_offset", 1, torch.float32),
+        ("bias", 1, torch.float32),
+    ]:
+        add_parameter(gate, name, (rows, width), param_dtype)
+        source = ((torch.arange(32 * width).reshape(32, width) % 7) + 1).to(param_dtype)
+        weights.append((f"layers.0.self_attn.g_proj.{name}", source))
+        expected[name] = source.narrow(0, tp_rank * rows, rows)
+    for name in ("input_scale", "input_offset"):
+        add_parameter(gate, name, (1,), output_dim=None)
+        weights.append((f"layers.0.self_attn.g_proj.{name}", torch.tensor(2.0)))
+        expected[name] = torch.tensor([2.0])
+
+    loaded = model.load_weights(iter(weights))
+
+    assert loaded == {name for name, _ in weights}
+    for name, value in expected.items():
+        torch.testing.assert_close(getattr(gate, name).float(), value.float(), rtol=0, atol=0)
+    fused = model.layers[0].self_attn.fused_qkv_a_proj
+    assert torch.all(fused.weight == -1)
+    assert torch.all(fused.weight_scale == -1)
+
+
+def test_standalone_gate_preserves_loader_kwargs_and_default_loader():
+    model = make_model()
+    gate = model.layers[0].self_attn.g_proj
+    param = add_parameter(gate, "weight", (32, 4))
+    seen = []
+
+    def weight_loader(param, value, *, marker):
+        seen.append(marker)
+        gate.weight_loader(param, value)
+
+    param.weight_loader = weight_loader
+    gate.register_parameter("input_scale", nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1), requires_grad=False))
+    kwargs = {"marker": "quant-loader-metadata"}
+    loaded = model.load_weights(
+        iter(
+            [
+                ("layers.0.self_attn.g_proj.weight", torch.ones(32, 4), kwargs),
+                ("layers.0.self_attn.g_proj.input_scale", torch.tensor([3.0])),
+            ]
+        )
+    )
+    assert seen == ["quant-loader-metadata"]
+    assert kwargs == {"marker": "quant-loader-metadata"}
+    assert torch.all(param == 1)
+    assert gate.input_scale.item() == 3
+    assert loaded == {"layers.0.self_attn.g_proj.weight", "layers.0.self_attn.g_proj.input_scale"}
+
+
+def test_gate_loading_retains_pp_skipping_and_qkv_loading():
+    model = make_model()
+    add_parameter(model.layers[0].self_attn.g_proj, "weight", (32, 4))
+    loaded = model.load_weights(
+        iter(
+            [
+                ("layers.1.self_attn.g_proj.weight", torch.ones(32, 4)),
+                ("layers.1.self_attn.g_proj.weight_scale", torch.ones(32, 1)),
+                ("layers.0.self_attn.q_a_proj.weight", torch.full((4, 4), 2.0)),
+                ("layers.0.self_attn.kv_a_proj_with_mqa.weight", torch.full((2, 4), 3.0)),
+                ("layers.0.self_attn.g_proj.weight", torch.full((32, 4), 4.0)),
+            ]
+        )
+    )
+    fused = model.layers[0].self_attn.fused_qkv_a_proj.weight
+    torch.testing.assert_close(fused, torch.cat([torch.full((4, 4), 2.0), torch.full((2, 4), 3.0)]))
+    assert torch.all(model.layers[0].self_attn.g_proj.weight == 4)
+    assert loaded == {"layers.0.self_attn.fused_qkv_a_proj.weight", "layers.0.self_attn.g_proj.weight"}
+
+
+def test_fused_mla_gate_keeps_upstream_shard_two_loading():
+    model = make_model(fused_gate=True)
+    loaded = model.load_weights(iter([("layers.0.self_attn.g_proj.weight", torch.full((32, 4), 5.0))]))
+    fused = model.layers[0].self_attn.fused_qkv_a_proj.weight
+    assert torch.all(fused[:6] == -1)
+    assert torch.all(fused[6:] == 5)
+    assert loaded == {"layers.0.self_attn.fused_qkv_a_proj.weight"}

+"""Exercise the production selector with real Dynamo and CPU-only operators.

+Run with --confcutdir=tests/ut/models. This does not validate NPU kernels.
+"""
+
+import ast
+import importlib.util
+from enum import Enum
+from pathlib import Path

+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+    "kimi_compile_prepared_input", ROOT / "vllm_ascend/quantization/prepared_linear_input.py"
+)
+assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+prepared_module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+spec.loader.exec_module(prepared_module)
+PreparedLinearInput = prepared_module.PreparedLinearInput
+
+
+class CUDAGraphMode(Enum):
+    NONE = 0
+
+
+def unpack(x):
+    if isinstance(x, PreparedLinearInput):
+        return x.quantized
+    return x[0] if isinstance(x, tuple) else x
+
+
+class MXFP8Method:
+    def apply_single_group_gmm(self, layer, x):
+        return unpack(x) * 3
+
+    def apply(self, layer, x, bias=None):
+        output = unpack(x) * 2
+        return output.unsqueeze(0) if layer._mxfp8_gmm_nz_layout else output
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def selector():
+    tree = ast.parse((ROOT / "vllm_ascend/models/kimi_k3/kimi_k3.py").read_text())

+    method = next(n for n in cls.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "apply_projection")
+    method.decorator_list = []
+    future = ast.ImportFrom(module="__future__", names=[ast.alias(name="annotations")], level=0)
+    context = SimpleNamespace(cudagraph_runtime_mode=CUDAGraphMode.NONE)
+    scope = dict(
+        torch=torch,
+        PreparedLinearInput=PreparedLinearInput,
+        AscendW8A8MXFP8DynamicLinearMethod=MXFP8Method,
+        CUDAGraphMode=CUDAGraphMode,
+        is_forward_context_available=lambda: True,
+        get_forward_context=lambda: context,
+    )
+    exec(
+        compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[future, method], type_ignores=[])), "kimi_k3.py", "exec"),
+        scope,
+    )
+    return scope["apply_projection"]

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("input_kind", ["tensor", "tuple", "prepared"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("nz_layout", [False, True])
+def test_fullgraph_compile_never_queries_npu_capture(selector, monkeypatch, input_kind, nz_layout):
+    def forbidden_capture_query():
+        raise AssertionError("The NPU capture query must not enter the compiled graph")

+"""Exercise the actual latent transform and norm bias loader on CPU.
+
+The CANN kernels and projection are mocked; this verifies routing and parameter
+handoff, not NPU numerical accuracy. Run with --confcutdir=tests/ut/models.
+"""
+
+import ast
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+
+
+def load_nodes(path, names, scope):
+    tree = ast.parse((ROOT / path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    nodes = [node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, (ast.ClassDef, ast.FunctionDef)) and node.name in names]
+    assert {node.name for node in nodes} == set(names)
+    future = ast.ImportFrom(module="__future__", names=[ast.alias(name="annotations")], level=0)
+    exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[future, *nodes], type_ignores=[])), path, "exec"), scope)
+
+
+class NormBase(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, hidden_size, eps, var_hidden_size, has_weight, dtype):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(hidden_size, dtype=dtype or torch.bfloat16), requires_grad=False)
+        self.variance_epsilon = eps
+
+    def forward(self, x):
+        return self.forward_oot(x)
+
+
+class TransformBase(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, norm, up_proj):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.norm, self.up_proj = norm, up_proj
+
+    def forward(self, x):
+        if self.norm is not None:
+            x = self.norm(x)
+        return self.up_proj(x)[0]
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def runtime(monkeypatch):
+    norm_kernel = Mock(side_effect=lambda x, *_: (x.clone(), None))
+    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "torch_npu", SimpleNamespace(npu_rms_norm=norm_kernel))
+    fused_kernel = Mock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.ops.npu, "npu_rms_norm_dynamic_mx_quant", fused_kernel, raising=False)
+    int8_kernel = Mock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.ops._C_ascend, "npu_rms_norm_dynamic_quant", int8_kernel, raising=False)
+    config = SimpleNamespace(quant_config=SimpleNamespace(quant_description={}), lora_config=None)
+    profile = SimpleNamespace(supports=Mock(return_value=True))
+    scheme_cls = type("MXFP8Linear", (), {})
+    scope = dict(
+        torch=torch,
+        nn=nn,
+        RMSNorm=NormBase,
+        KimiRoutedOutputTransform=TransformBase,

+        _NORM_BIAS_IN_QUANT_DESCRIPTION={},
+        get_current_vllm_config=lambda: config,
+        get_current_hardware_profile=lambda: profile,
+        HardwareCapability=SimpleNamespace(DYNAMIC_MX_QUANT_FUSION=object(), RMS_NORM_DYNAMIC_QUANT=object()),
+        AscendLinearScheme=object,
+        WeightSwitchGatherSpec=lambda *a, **kw: None,
+        register_scheme=lambda *a: lambda cls: cls,
+        __name__=__name__,
+    )
+    exec((ROOT / "vllm_ascend/quantization/prepared_linear_input.py").read_text(), scope)
+    load_nodes("vllm_ascend/quantization/methods/w8a8/w8a8_dynamic.py", ["AscendW8A8DynamicLinearMethod"], scope)
+    load_nodes("vllm_ascend/ops/layernorm.py", ["_quant_description_has_norm_bias", "AscendRMSNorm"], scope)
+    load_nodes("vllm_ascend/models/kimi_k3/kimi_k3.py", ["AscendKimiRoutedOutputTransform"], scope)
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        scope=scope,
+        config=config,
+        profile=profile,
+        norm_kernel=norm_kernel,
+        fused_kernel=fused_kernel,
+        scheme_cls=scheme_cls,
+        int8_kernel=int8_kernel,
+    )
+
+
+def make_transform(runtime, *, indexer_bias=True, hidden_size=3584, scale_alg=1):
+    if indexer_bias:
+        runtime.config.quant_config.quant_description = {
+            "language_model.model.layers.3.self_attn.indexer.k_norm.bias": "FLOAT"
+        }
+    norm = runtime.scope["AscendRMSNorm"](hidden_size, eps=1e-6)
+    scheme = runtime.scheme_cls()
+    scheme.group_size, scheme.dynamic_mx_quant_scale_alg = 32, scale_alg
+    up_proj = Mock(quant_method=SimpleNamespace(quant_method=scheme), return_value=(object(), None))
+    transform = runtime.scope["AscendKimiRoutedOutputTransform"](norm, up_proj)
+    return transform, norm, up_proj
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("indexer_bias", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("scale_alg", [0, 1])
+def test_unloaded_bias_uses_fused_norm_quant_without_requantizing(runtime, indexer_bias, scale_alg):
+    transform, norm, up_proj = make_transform(runtime, indexer_bias=indexer_bias, scale_alg=scale_alg)
+    assert (norm.bias is not None) is indexer_bias
+    assert not norm.bias_loaded
+    x = torch.randn(4, 3584, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    quantized = torch.empty_like(x, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn)

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.float16, torch.bfloat16])

+def test_quantize_once_and_reuse_scales(dtype, wrapped):
+    scheme = AscendW8A8DynamicLinearMethod()
+    method = SimpleNamespace(quant_method=scheme, apply=scheme.apply) if wrapped else scheme
+    layer = SimpleNamespace(quant_method=method, weight=object(), weight_scale=object())
+    attention = SimpleNamespace(in_proj_qkvgfab=layer)
+    x = torch.randn(4, 16, dtype=dtype)
+    q, scale, result = torch.zeros_like(x, dtype=torch.int8), torch.ones(4), object()
+    with (
+        patch(
+            "vllm_ascend.ops.kimi_kda.get_current_hardware_profile",
+            return_value=get_hardware_profile(AscendDeviceType.A3),
+        ),
+        patch("torch_npu.npu_dynamic_quant", return_value=(q, scale)) as quant,
+        patch("torch_npu.npu_quant_matmul", return_value=result) as matmul,
+    ):
+        prepared = AscendKimiK3DeltaAttention._quantize_fused_qkv(attention, x)

+        assert prepared.quantized is q and prepared.scale is scale
+        output = AscendKimiK3DeltaAttention._matmul_fused_qkv(attention, prepared)
+    assert output is result
+    quant.assert_called_once_with(x, dst_type=torch.int8)
+    assert matmul.call_args.args[0] is q
+    assert matmul.call_args.kwargs["pertoken_scale"] is scale
+    assert matmul.call_args.kwargs["output_dtype"] == dtype

+"""Run production BFG submission/packing on CPU with NPU streams simulated.
+

+import pytest

+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
