+msgid ""
+"- `--max-model-len 150000` limits the total input and output length of one\n"
+"        request. `--max-num-batched-tokens 8192` limits the tokens scheduled in one\n"
+"        iteration, while `--max-num-seqs 32` limits the sequences scheduled by each\n"
+"        DP engine. Increasing either scheduler limit can improve throughput but also\n"
+"        increases memory usage.\n"
+"    - `VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=36000` allows up to 36,000 seconds for engine\n"
+"        processes to finish initialization, including weight loading and graph\n"
+"        preparation.\n"
+"    - `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1` explicitly selects model runner V2.\n"
+"    - `--engram-config '{\"cpu_offload\":true,\"dp_shared_memory\":true}'` keeps the\n"
+"        Engram table in host memory and lets local DP ranks share the host-memory\n"
+"        allocation. This is required on A3 because the model's 24 Engram heads\n"
+"        cannot be evenly divided across 16 logical devices. It also reduces\n"
+"        duplicate host-memory copies. The A3 container example uses `--ipc=host` so\n"
+"        all four local DP ranks share the host IPC namespace.\n"
+"    - `--compilation-config '{\"cudagraph_mode\":\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"}'` captures the\n"
+"        Decode path while Prefill remains outside the captured graph.\n"
+"    - `--safetensors-load-strategy lazy` avoids eagerly materializing the whole\n"
+"        checkpoint during loading.\n"
+"    - `--swa-bounded-replay` enables SWA bounded replay.\n"
+"    - `enable_flashcomm1: false` disables FlashComm for compatibility with SWA bounded replay.\n"
+"    - `enable_fused_mc2` and `enable_shared_expert_dp` enable the A3 MoE and\n"
+"        communication optimizations\n"
+"        used by this configuration. `enable_cpu_binding` pins worker processes to\n"
+"        CPUs, while `enable_npugraph_ex` enables the enhanced ACL Graph path."
+msgstr ""
+"- `--max-model-len 150000` 限制单个请求的总输入和输出长度。`--max-num-batched-tokens 8192` 限制单次迭代中调度的 token 数，而 `--max-num-seqs 32` 限制每个 DP 引擎调度的序列数。增大任一调度器限制都可以提升吞吐量，但也会增加内存占用。\n"
+"    - `VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=36000` 允许引擎进程最多 36,000 秒完成初始化，包括权重加载和图准备。\n"
+"    - `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1` 显式选择模型运行器 V2。\n"
+"    - `--engram-config '{\"cpu_offload\":true,\"dp_shared_memory\":true}'` 将 Engram 表保留在主机内存中，并让本地 DP rank 共享主机内存分配。这在 A3 上是必需的，因为模型的 24 个 Engram head 无法均匀分配到 16 个逻辑设备上。它还能减少重复的主机内存副本。A3 容器示例使用 `--ipc=host`，使所有四个本地 DP rank 共享主机 IPC 命名空间。\n"
+"    - `--compilation-config '{\"cudagraph_mode\":\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"}'` 捕获 Decode 路径，而 Prefill 保持在捕获图之外。\n"
+"    - `--safetensors-load-strategy lazy` 避免在加载期间急切地物化整个检查点。\n"
+"    - `--swa-bounded-replay` 启用 SWA 有界重放。\n"
+"    - `enable_flashcomm1: false` 禁用 FlashComm，以兼容 SWA 有界重放。\n"
+"    - `enable_fused_mc2` 和 `enable_shared_expert_dp` 启用此配置所使用的 A3 MoE 和通信优化。`enable_cpu_binding` 将工作进程绑定到 CPU，而 `enable_npugraph_ex` 启用增强的 ACL Graph 路径。"
+
+msgid "#### 950DT DP8 Prefill and DP8 Decode"
+msgstr "#### 950DT DP8 Prefill 与 DP8 Decode"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use two eight-NPU servers for 1P1D. Both roles use DP8/TP1/EP8, with\n"
+"    one API endpoint per DP rank."
+msgstr "使用两台八 NPU 服务器进行 1P1D。两个角色均使用 DP8/TP1/EP8，每个 DP rank 对应一个 API 端点。"
+
+msgid "| Role | DP / TP / EP | API ports | DP RPC port | KV handshake ports |"
+msgstr "| 角色 | DP / TP / EP | API 端口 | DP RPC 端口 | KV 握手端口 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use the 950DT runtime from [Section 4.1](#41-docker-image-installation)\n"
+"    on both nodes. Prefill requires native SWA bounded replay with the PD connector."
+msgstr ""
+"在两个节点上均使用 [第 4.1 节](#41-docker-image-installation) 中的 950DT 运行时。Prefill 需要配合"
+" PD connector 使用原生 SWA 有界重放。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Both roles use DSpark with five speculative tokens and enable shared-expert\n"
+"    multistream overlap. Prefill runs the target and draft models in eager mode\n"
+"    and sets `multistream_engram_overlap: false`. Decode uses\n"
+"    `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` for the target model and the default draft graph execution,\n"
+"    with `combine_quant_mode: 4` and the recompute scheduler. The examples use\n"
+"    the 950DT defaults for CPU binding, DSA overlap, and Decode Engram overlap."
+msgstr ""
+"两个角色均使用 DSpark 并启用五个投机 token，同时启用共享专家多流重叠。Prefill 以 eager 模式运行目标模型和草稿模型，并设置 "
+"`multistream_engram_overlap: false`。Decode 对目标模型使用 "
+"`FULL_DECODE_ONLY`，草稿模型使用默认图执行，并设置 `combine_quant_mode: 4` 和重计算调度器。示例使用 "
+"950DT 在 CPU 绑定、DSA 重叠和 Decode Engram 重叠方面的默认值。"
+
+msgid ""
+"`multistream_engram_overlap` uses an auxiliary NPU stream to overlap Engram\n"
+"    preparation (hash calculation, table lookups, and DP/TP exchanges) with\n"
+"    model computation."
+msgstr ""
+"`multistream_engram_overlap` 使用辅助 NPU 流将 Engram 准备（哈希计算、表查找以及 DP/TP "
+"交换）与模型计算重叠。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Prefill and Decode form separate DP groups on different servers, so both\n"
+"    can use RPC port `12321`. Within each group, all ranks must use the same\n"
+"    coordinator IP and RPC port."
+msgstr ""
+"Prefill 和 Decode 在不同服务器上形成独立的 DP 组，因此两者都可以使用 RPC 端口 `12321`。在每个组内，所有 rank "
+"必须使用相同的协调器 IP 和 RPC 端口。"
+
+msgid "##### Prepare the 950DT DP Launcher"
+msgstr "##### 准备 950DT DP 启动器"
+
+msgid "On both nodes, create a working directory inside the container:"
+msgstr "在两个节点上，在容器内创建工作目录："
+
+msgid ""
+"Save the following script as `launch_online_dp.py` in this directory.\n"
+"    Keep the node's `run_dp_template.sh` in the same directory and run the\n"
+"    launcher from there. Each node needs its own role-specific template."
+msgstr ""
+"将以下脚本保存为此目录中的 `launch_online_dp.py`。将节点的 `run_dp_template.sh` "
+"保留在同一目录中，并从该目录运行启动器。每个节点都需要自己的角色专属模板。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The launcher divides the local NPUs among DP ranks and starts one vLLM\n"
+"    process per rank. If a rank fails, the launcher reports its global rank and\n"
+"    exit status, stops the other local engines, and exits with an error."
+msgstr ""
+"启动器将本地 NPU 分配给各个 DP rank，并为每个 rank 启动一个 vLLM 进程。如果某个 rank 失败，启动器会报告其全局 rank "
+"和退出状态，停止其他本地引擎，并以错误退出。"
+
+msgid "| Parameter | Description | Value in this 1P1D example |"
+msgstr "| 参数 | 描述 | 此 1P1D 示例中的值 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"    | `--dp-size` | Total DP ranks in one role's group, across all its "
+"nodes. Prefill and Decode form separate groups. | `8` on both roles. |"
+msgstr ""
+"    | `--dp-size` | 一个角色组中跨其所有节点的 DP rank 总数。Prefill 和 Decode 形成独立的组。 | "
+"两个角色均为 `8`。 |"
+
+msgid "    | `--tp-size` | Number of NPUs assigned to each DP rank. | `1`. |"
+msgstr "    | `--tp-size` | 分配给每个 DP rank 的 NPU 数量。 | `1`。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"    | `--dp-size-local` | Number of DP ranks started on the current node. | "
+"`8`. |"
+msgstr "    | `--dp-size-local` | 在当前节点上启动的 DP rank 数量。 | `8`。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"    | `--dp-rank-start` | Global rank of the first DP engine on this node. |"
+" `0`; local engines receive ranks `0` through `7`. |"
+msgstr ""
+"    | `--dp-rank-start` | 此节点上第一个 DP 引擎的全局 rank。 | `0`；本地引擎获得 rank `0` 到 "
+"`7`。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"    | `--dp-address` | DP master IP for this role's group; use the same "
+"address on every node in the group. | Prefill node IP for the Prefill group;"
+" Decode node IP for the Decode group. |"
+msgstr ""
+"    | `--dp-address` | 此角色组的 DP 主节点 IP；在组内每个节点上使用相同地址。 | Prefill 组使用 Prefill"
+" 节点 IP；Decode 组使用 Decode 节点 IP。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"    | `--dp-rpc-port` | Coordination port shared by all ranks in this role's"
+" DP group. | `12321`; the two groups can use the same port on different "
+"servers. |"
+msgstr ""
+"    | `--dp-rpc-port` | 此角色 DP 组中所有 rank 共享的协调端口。 | "
+"`12321`；两个组可以在不同服务器上使用相同端口。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"    | `--vllm-start-port` | API port of the first local engine, incremented "
+"by one for each subsequent engine. | `7100`, giving ports `7100` through "
+"`7107`. |"
+msgstr ""
+"    | `--vllm-start-port` | 第一个本地引擎的 API 端口，后续每个引擎递增一。 | `7100`，即端口 `7100` 到"
+" `7107`。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"For multi-node DP or wide EP, set `--dp-address` to the corresponding\n"
+"    group's DP master IP on every node, including worker nodes."
+msgstr "对于多节点 DP 或宽 EP，在每个节点（包括工作节点）上将 `--dp-address` 设置为对应组的 DP 主节点 IP。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The launcher calls `run_dp_template.sh` with seven positional arguments:\n"
+"    visible devices, API port, global DP size, global DP rank, coordinator IP,\n"
+"    coordinator RPC port, and TP size. Each template below documents this order."
+msgstr ""
+"启动器以七个位置参数调用 `run_dp_template.sh`：可见设备、API 端口、全局 DP 大小、全局 DP rank、协调器 IP、协调器"
+" RPC 端口和 TP 大小。下面的每个模板都记录了此顺序。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Prefill and Decode can start concurrently in separate terminals. Each\n"
+"    launcher runs in the foreground; keep its terminal open."
+msgstr "Prefill 和 Decode 可以在不同的终端中并发启动。每个启动器都在前台运行；请保持其终端打开。"
+
+msgid "##### Start the 950DT Decode Node"
+msgstr "##### 启动 950DT Decode 节点"
+
+msgid ""
+"On Decode, save the following as `~/dsv41-pd/run_dp_template.sh`, beside\n"
+"    `launch_online_dp.py`. Set `local_ip`, `nic_name`, and `MODEL_PATH` for the\n"
+"    Decode server."
+msgstr ""
+"在 Decode 上，将以下内容保存为 `~/dsv41-pd/run_dp_template.sh`，与 `launch_online_dp.py` "
+"放在一起。为 Decode 服务器设置 `local_ip`、`nic_name` 和 `MODEL_PATH`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"In the launch command below, `$1` is a visible NPU ID from `0` to `7`,\n"
+"    `$2` is its API port (`7100` through `7107`), `$3` is the global DP size\n"
+"    (`8`), `$4` is the global DP rank (`0` through `7`), `$5` is the Decode\n"
+"    group's coordinator IP, `$6` is its DP RPC port (`12321`), and `$7` is\n"
+"    the TP size (`1`)."
+msgstr ""
+"在下面的启动命令中，`$1` 是可见的 NPU ID（从 `0` 到 `7`），\n"
+"    `$2` 是其 API 端口（`7100` 到 `7107`），`$3` 是全局 DP 大小\n"
+"    （`8`），`$4` 是全局 DP rank（`0` 到 `7`），`$5` 是 Decode\n"
+"    组的协调器 IP，`$6` 是其 DP RPC 端口（`12321`），`$7` 是\n"
+"    TP 大小（`1`）。"
+
+msgid "Start the eight Decode engines from their working directory:"
+msgstr "从各自的工作目录启动八个 Decode 引擎："
+
+msgid "##### Start the 950DT Prefill Node"
+msgstr "##### 启动 Ascend 950DT Prefill 节点"
+
+msgid ""
+"On Prefill, save the following as `~/dsv41-pd/run_dp_template.sh`, beside\n"
+"    its own `launch_online_dp.py`. Set `local_ip`, `nic_name`, and `MODEL_PATH`\n"
+"    for the Prefill server."
+msgstr ""
+"在 Prefill 上，将以下内容保存为 `~/dsv41-pd/run_dp_template.sh`，与\n"
+"    其自身的 `launch_online_dp.py` 放在一起。为 Prefill 服务器设置 `local_ip`、`nic_name` 和 `MODEL_PATH`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"In the launch command below, `$1` is a visible NPU ID from `0` to `7`,\n"
+"    `$2` is its API port (`7100` through `7107`), `$3` is the global DP size\n"
+"    (`8`), `$4` is the global DP rank (`0` through `7`), `$5` is the Prefill\n"
+"    group's coordinator IP, `$6` is its DP RPC port (`12321`), and `$7` is\n"
+"    the TP size (`1`)."
+msgstr ""
+"在下面的启动命令中，`$1` 是可见的 NPU ID（从 `0` 到 `7`），\n"
+"    `$2` 是其 API 端口（`7100` 到 `7107`），`$3` 是全局 DP 大小\n"
+"    （`8`），`$4` 是全局 DP rank（`0` 到 `7`），`$5` 是 Prefill\n"
+"    组的协调器 IP，`$6` 是其 DP RPC 端口（`12321`），`$7` 是\n"
+"    TP 大小（`1`）。"
+
+msgid ""
+"`kv_port` is a base port; the connector adds the DP/TP/PCP rank offsets.\n"
+"    Keep the same base port on every rank of the same role. The `prefill`\n"
+"    and `decode` topology values must match on both nodes."
+msgstr ""
+"`kv_port` 是基础端口；连接器会加上 DP/TP/PCP rank 偏移量。\n"
+"    同一角色的每个 rank 上保持相同的基础端口。`prefill`\n"
+"    和 `decode` 的拓扑值在两个节点上必须一致。"
+
+msgid "Start the eight Prefill engines from their working directory:"
+msgstr "从各自的工作目录启动八个 Prefill 引擎："
+
+msgid "##### Deploy the 950DT PD Proxy"
+msgstr "##### 部署 Ascend 950DT PD Proxy"
+
+msgid ""
+"Each Prefill and Decode engine reports `Application startup complete.` in\n"
+"    its terminal when startup is complete. Once all engines are ready, start\n"
+"    the proxy inside the 950DT container in a separate terminal on a node that\n"
+"    can reach both servers. The image contains the non-layerwise proxy used\n"
+"    by the Hybrid Connector. Register all eight endpoints from each role:"
+msgstr ""
+"每个 Prefill 和 Decode 引擎在启动完成后会在其终端中输出 `Application startup complete.`。\n"
+"    所有引擎就绪后，在能够访问两个服务器的节点上，于 950DT 容器内的\n"
+"    单独终端中启动 proxy。该镜像包含 Hybrid Connector 所使用的\n"
+"    非分层 proxy。注册每个角色的全部八个端点："
+
+msgid ""
+"Check `GET /health` on every backend API endpoint (`7100-7107` on each\n"
+"    node) before sending requests through the proxy. The proxy's\n"
+"    `/healthcheck` reports configured instance counts, not backend readiness.\n"
+"    Verify the proxy and model entry with:"
+msgstr ""
+"在通过 proxy 发送请求之前，检查每个后端 API 端点（每个节点上的 `7100-7107`）\n"
+"    的 `GET /health`。proxy 的\n"
+"    `/healthcheck` 报告的是已配置的实例数量，而非后端就绪状态。\n"
+"    使用以下命令验证 proxy 和模型条目："
+
+msgid ""
+"The health request should return `HTTP 200`, and the model list should\n"
+"    contain `dsv41`. Reuse `SERVICE_URL` for the text request in\n"
+"    [Section 6.1](#61-text-request). Check the P/D logs for successful KV transfer."
+msgstr ""
+"健康检查请求应返回 `HTTP 200`，模型列表应\n"
+"    包含 `dsv41`。在\n"
+"    [第 6.1 节](#61-text-request)的文本请求中复用 `SERVICE_URL`。检查 P/D 日志以确认 KV 传输成功。"
+
+msgid "##### 950DT Replay Configuration Notes"
+msgstr "##### Ascend 950DT Replay 配置说明"
+
+msgid ""
+"- On Prefill, enable local prefix caching and `--swa-bounded-replay`.\n"
+"      After a prefix hit, the engine reuses cached non-SWA blocks and\n"
+"      recomputes the trailing SWA window.\n"
+"    - On Decode, enable local prefix caching and set\n"
+"      `scheduler_config.recompute_scheduler_enable` to `true`. The recompute\n"
+"      scheduler cannot perform bounded replay, so use `--no-swa-bounded-replay`.\n"
+"    - Set `--max-num-batched-tokens` to `5120` on Prefill and `1024` on Decode.\n"
+"    - Each launcher child starts one local DP engine. The templates therefore\n"
+"      pass `--data-parallel-size-local 1`, while the launcher starts eight\n"
+"      children with `--dp-size-local 8`."
+msgstr ""
+"- 在 Prefill 上，启用本地前缀缓存和 `--swa-bounded-replay`。\n"
+"      前缀命中后，引擎会复用已缓存的非 SWA 块，并\n"
+"      重新计算末尾的 SWA 窗口。\n"
+"    - 在 Decode 上，启用本地前缀缓存并将\n"
+"      `scheduler_config.recompute_scheduler_enable` 设置为 `true`。重计算\n"
+"      调度器无法执行有界 replay，因此使用 `--no-swa-bounded-replay`。\n"
+"    - 在 Prefill 上将 `--max-num-batched-tokens` 设置为 `5120`，在 Decode 上设置为 `1024`。\n"
+"    - 每个 launcher 子进程启动一个本地 DP 引擎。因此模板\n"
+"      传入 `--data-parallel-size-local 1`，而 launcher 使用\n"
+"      `--dp-size-local 8` 启动八个子进程。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Verify generation and an actual Prefill prefix-cache hit on the selected\n"
+"    build. See the [Public FAQs](../../faqs.md) for startup and environment\n"
+"    troubleshooting."
+msgstr ""
+"在所选构建上验证生成以及实际的 Prefill 前缀缓存命中。\n"
+"    有关启动和环境故障排查，请参阅[公共 FAQ](../../faqs.md)。"
+
+msgid "##### 950DT Deployment Extensions"
+msgstr "##### Ascend 950DT 部署扩展"
+
+msgid "###### 950DT PCP Prefill (Experimental)"
+msgstr "###### Ascend 950DT PCP Prefill（实验性）"
+
+msgid ""
+"For long prompts, PCP can distribute one Prefill request across all eight\n"
+"    NPUs. Starting from the DP8 Prefill template above, make these changes:"
+msgstr ""
+"对于长提示词，PCP 可以将一个 Prefill 请求分布到全部八个\n"
+"    NPU 上。从上面的 DP8 Prefill 模板开始，进行以下更改："
+
+msgid "| Setting | DP8 Prefill | PCP8 Prefill |"
+msgstr "| 设置 | DP8 Prefill | PCP8 Prefill |"
+
+msgid "    | Visible devices per process | One NPU | All eight NPUs |"
+msgstr "    | 每个进程的可见设备 | 一个 NPU | 全部八个 NPU |"
+
+msgid "    | Connector `prefill.dp_size` on both roles | 8 | 1 |"
+msgstr "    | 两个角色上的连接器 `prefill.dp_size` | 8 | 1 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"Replace Prefill's `--additional-config` with the following configuration.\n"
+"    Keep eager execution and `--max-num-seqs 16` unchanged."
+msgstr ""
+"将 Prefill 的 `--additional-config` 替换为以下配置。\n"
+"    保持 eager 执行和 `--max-num-seqs 16` 不变。"
+
+msgid "Run the modified template once with all eight visible devices:"
+msgstr "使用全部八个可见设备运行一次修改后的模板："
+
+msgid ""
+"Register only Prefill port `7100` in the proxy. Decode keeps DP8 and its\n"
+"    existing startup command. Update its connector's `prefill.dp_size` to `1`.\n"
+"    For Memcache pooling, start from the pooled Prefill template in\n"
+"    [Section 5.3.1](#531-memcache-kv-cache-pool), increase its\n"
+"    batch limit from `5120` to `16384`, and set `prefill.dp_size` to `1` in\n"
+"    the nested `MooncakeHybridConnector` on both roles. Keep `use_layerwise=false`. See the [Context Parallel guide](../../user_guide/feature_guide/context_parallel.md)\n"
+"    for PCP details."
+msgstr ""
+"在 proxy 中仅注册 Prefill 端口 `7100`。Decode 保持 DP8 及其\n"
+"    现有的启动命令。将其连接器的 `prefill.dp_size` 更新为 `1`。\n"
+"    对于 Memcache 池化，从\n"
+"    [第 5.3.1 节](#531-memcache-kv-cache-pool)的池化 Prefill 模板开始，将其\n"
+"    批处理上限从 `5120` 增加到 `16384`，并在两个角色上嵌套的 `MooncakeHybridConnector` 中将 `prefill.dp_size` 设置为 `1`。保持 `use_layerwise=false`。有关 PCP 详细信息，请参阅[上下文并行指南](../../user_guide/feature_guide/context_parallel.md)。"
+
+msgid "###### 950DT Decode with Wide Expert Parallelism"
+msgstr "###### Ascend 950DT 使用宽专家并行的 Decode"
+
+msgid ""
+"For higher Decode performance, evaluate a wider EP group across multiple\n"
+"    Decode servers. Two eight-NPU Decode servers can form DP16/TP1/EP16 while\n"
+"    Prefill remains DP8/TP1/EP8. Keep `--enable-expert-parallel` and TP1 in\n"
+"    the Decode template. Increasing global DP to 16 gives EP16. Retain its\n"
+"    batch limits, graph mode, DSpark, and other model settings as a starting point."
+msgstr ""
+"为获得更高的 Decode 性能，可在多个 Decode 服务器上评估更宽的 EP 组。\n"
+"    两个八 NPU 的 Decode 服务器可组成 DP16/TP1/EP16，而\n"
+"    Prefill 保持 DP8/TP1/EP8。在 Decode 模板中保留 `--enable-expert-parallel` 和 TP1。\n"
+"    将全局 DP 增加到 16 即可得到 EP16。将其\n"
+"    批处理上限、图模式、DSpark 及其他模型设置作为起点保留。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Verify [cross-node communication](../../getting_started/installation.md#installation-multi-node-interconnect)\n"
+"    first. Set the Decode template's local IP and network interface separately\n"
+"    on each Decode server. Both servers use the first Decode server's IP as\n"
+"    the DP master:"
+msgstr ""
+"首先验证[跨节点通信](../../getting_started/installation.md#installation-multi-node-interconnect)。\n"
+"    在每个 Decode 服务器上分别设置 Decode 模板的本地 IP 和网络接口。\n"
+"    两个服务器均使用第一个 Decode 服务器的 IP 作为\n"
+"    DP master："
+
+msgid ""
+"Set `decode.dp_size` to `16` in the connector configuration on both\n"
+"    Prefill and Decode. Keep `prefill.dp_size=8` and `tp_size=1`. For Memcache,\n"
+"    change the same values in the nested `MooncakeHybridConnector`. Keep the\n"
+"    Decode KV base port at `27010`. Global DP ranks use `27010–27025`.\n"
+"    Register ports `7100–7107` from each Decode server in the proxy, for 16\n"
+"    Decode endpoints in total. Start both servers before waiting for readiness.\n"
+"    Recheck Decode latency and throughput for the target workload before\n"
+"    changing the batch limits."
+msgstr ""
+"在 Prefill 和 Decode 上的连接器配置中将 `decode.dp_size` 设置为 `16`。\n"
+"    保持 `prefill.dp_size=8` 和 `tp_size=1`。对于 Memcache，\n"
+"    在嵌套的 `MooncakeHybridConnector` 中更改相同的值。保持\n"
+"    Decode KV 基础端口为 `27010`。全局 DP rank 使用 `27010–27025`。\n"
+"    在 proxy 中注册每个 Decode 服务器的端口 `7100–7107`，共 16\n"
+"    个 Decode 端点。在等待就绪之前启动两个服务器。\n"
+"    在更改批处理上限之前，针对目标工作负载重新检查 Decode 延迟和吞吐量。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This example uses W4A8 weights and model runner V2 on two Atlas 800 A3\n"
+"    servers. The Prefill node runs DP4/PCP4/TP1, and the Decode node runs\n"
+"    DP16/TP1. Both layouts consume all 16 logical devices on their respective\n"
+"    servers. Mooncake transfers KV cache from the Prefill engines to the Decode\n"
+"    engines."
+msgstr ""
+"本示例在两台 Atlas 800 A3 服务器上使用 W4A8 权重和 model runner V2。Prefill 节点运行 "
+"DP4/PCP4/TP1，Decode 节点运行 DP16/TP1。两种布局都会各自耗尽所在服务器上的全部 16 个逻辑设备。Mooncake 将 KV"
+" cache 从 Prefill 引擎传输到 Decode 引擎。"
+
+msgid ""
+"For W8A8 weights, use Prefill DP4/TP4 and Decode DP8/TP2. Adjust the\n"
+"    launcher, connector layouts, and proxy endpoints to match that topology."
+msgstr ""
+"对于 W8A8 权重，请使用 Prefill DP4/TP4 和 Decode DP8/TP2。请相应调整启动器、connector 布局和 proxy"
+" 端点以匹配该拓扑。"
+
+msgid "    | `--tp-size` | Tensor-parallel size within each DP rank. |"
+msgstr "    | `--tp-size` | 每个 DP rank 内的张量并行大小。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"    | `--pcp-size` | Prefill context-parallel size; each DP rank uses `tp-"
+"size * pcp-size` logical devices. Defaults to `1`. |"
+msgstr ""
+"    | `--pcp-size` | Prefill 上下文并行大小；每个 DP rank 使用 `tp-size * pcp-size` "
+"个逻辑设备。默认为 `1`。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"The launcher passes eight positional arguments to `run_dp_template.sh`:"
+msgstr "启动器向 `run_dp_template.sh` 传递八个位置参数："
+
+msgid "| Position | Value | Used by the template |"
+msgstr "| 位置 | 值 | 模板中的用途 |"
+
+msgid "    | `$1` | `visible_devices` | `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES` |"
+msgstr "    | `$1` | `visible_devices` | `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES` |"
+
+msgid "    | `$2` | `vllm_engine_port` | `--port` |"
+msgstr "    | `$2` | `vllm_engine_port` | `--port` |"
+
+msgid "    | `$3` | `dp_size` | `--data-parallel-size` |"
+msgstr "    | `$3` | `dp_size` | `--data-parallel-size` |"
+
+msgid "    | `$4` | `dp_rank` | `--data-parallel-rank` |"
+msgstr "    | `$4` | `dp_rank` | `--data-parallel-rank` |"
+
+msgid "    | `$5` | `args.dp_address` | `--data-parallel-address` |"
+msgstr "    | `$5` | `args.dp_address` | `--data-parallel-address` |"
+
+msgid "    | `$6` | `args.dp_rpc_port` | `--data-parallel-rpc-port` |"
+msgstr "    | `$6` | `args.dp_rpc_port` | `--data-parallel-rpc-port` |"
+
+msgid "    | `$7` | `tp_size` | `--tensor-parallel-size` |"
+msgstr "    | `$7` | `tp_size` | `--tensor-parallel-size` |"
+
+msgid "    | `$8` | `pcp_size` | `--prefill-context-parallel-size` |"
+msgstr "    | `$8` | `pcp_size` | `--prefill-context-parallel-size` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"Start four DP4/PCP4/TP1 Prefill engines. `--dp-address` uses the Prefill "
+"node IP."
+msgstr "启动四个 DP4/PCP4/TP1 Prefill 引擎。`--dp-address` 使用 Prefill 节点 IP。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Start sixteen DP16/TP1 Decode engines. `--dp-address` uses the Decode node "
+"IP."
+msgstr "启动十六个 DP16/TP1 Decode 引擎。`--dp-address` 使用 Decode 节点 IP。"
+
+msgid ""
+"After all Prefill and Decode engines are ready, deploy the proxy as described\n"
+"    in [Prefill-Decode Disaggregation (DeepSeek)](../features/pd_disaggregation_mooncake_multi_node.md).\n"
+"    Configure the proxy with Prefill endpoints `<PREFILL_NODE_IP>:7100` through\n"
+"    `<PREFILL_NODE_IP>:7103` and Decode endpoints `<DECODE_NODE_IP>:7100` through\n"
+"    `<DECODE_NODE_IP>:7115`."
+msgstr ""
+"所有 Prefill 和 Decode 引擎就绪后，按照 [Prefill-Decode "
+"分离（DeepSeek）](../features/pd_disaggregation_mooncake_multi_node.md) 中的说明部署 "
+"proxy。为 proxy 配置 Prefill 端点 `<PREFILL_NODE_IP>:7100` 至 "
+"`<PREFILL_NODE_IP>:7103`，以及 Decode 端点 `<DECODE_NODE_IP>:7100` 至 "
+"`<DECODE_NODE_IP>:7115`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=36000` gives every Prefill and Decode engine up\n"
+"      to 36,000 seconds to finish startup. This includes weight loading and Decode\n"
+"      graph preparation.\n"
+"    - `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1` selects model runner V2 on both roles.\n"
+"    - `--data-parallel-size`, `--prefill-context-parallel-size`, and\n"
+"      `--tensor-parallel-size` define DP4/PCP4/TP1 on Prefill and DP16/PCP1/TP1\n"
+"      on Decode. Their product is 16 on each node. The launcher assigns four\n"
+"      devices to each Prefill rank and one device to each Decode rank.\n"
+"    - `--swa-bounded-replay` enables SWA bounded replay on Prefill together with\n"
+"      PCP4; Prefill still uses `--enforce-eager`.\n"
+"    - `--data-parallel-address` and `--data-parallel-rpc-port` coordinate DP ranks\n"
+"      within one role. Prefill and Decode use their respective node IPs; port\n"
+"      `12321` can be reused because the roles run on different hosts.\n"
+"    - `--vllm-start-port 7100` assigns API ports `7100-7103` on Prefill and\n"
+"      `7100-7115` on Decode. These endpoints must be reachable by the PD proxy.\n"
+"    - Both roles use `--max-model-len 1048576`. Prefill uses\n"
+"      `--max-num-batched-tokens 8192` and `--max-num-seqs 16` to favor prompt\n"
+"      throughput, while Decode uses `512` and `72` respectively to favor decode\n"
+"      concurrency. Tune these role-specific scheduler limits independently.\n"
+"    - `MooncakeHybridConnector` transfers KV cache between the two roles.\n"
+"      `kv_role` must be `kv_producer` on Prefill and `kv_consumer` on Decode.\n"
+"      `kv_port` must be reachable and must not conflict with another service.\n"
+"    - `kv_connector_extra_config` must match the actual global layouts on both\n"
+"      sides: Prefill DP4/TP1 and Decode DP16/TP1. PCP4 is configured separately\n"
+"      with `--prefill-context-parallel-size`; it does not change `tp_size` in the\n"
+"      connector configuration. Keep both connector layouts identical in the\n"
+"      Prefill and Decode commands.\n"
+"    - Both roles use DSpark with five speculative tokens. Prefill runs the target\n"
+"      model in eager mode. Decode uses `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` for the target model\n"
+"      and allows graph execution for the DSpark draft model as well.\n"
+"    - `--engram-config '{\"cpu_offload\":true,\"dp_shared_memory\":true}'` keeps the\n"
+"      Engram table in host memory and lets local DP ranks share the host-memory\n"
+"      allocation. `dp_shared_memory` is required on A3 because the model's 24\n"
+"      Engram heads cannot be evenly divided across 16 logical devices. Both A3\n"
+"      containers use `--ipc=host` so the local DP ranks can share the allocation.\n"
+"    - `--compilation-config '{\"cudagraph_mode\":\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"}'` captures the\n"
+"      Decode path while Prefill remains outside the captured graph.\n"
+"    - Prefix caching is enabled only on Prefill. Decode disables it and enables\n"
+"      `recompute_scheduler_enable` so Prefill can recompute unavailable KV cache.\n"
+"    - Prefill uses the following `--additional-config` options:"
+msgstr ""
+"- `VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=36000` 为每个 Prefill 和 Decode 引擎提供最多 36,000 秒的启动时间。这包括权重加载和 Decode 图准备。\n"
+"    - `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1` 在两个角色上都选择 model runner V2。\n"
+"    - `--data-parallel-size`、`--prefill-context-parallel-size` 和 `--tensor-parallel-size` 在 Prefill 上定义 DP4/PCP4/TP1，在 Decode 上定义 DP16/PCP1/TP1。它们的乘积在每个节点上均为 16。启动器为每个 Prefill rank 分配四个设备，为每个 Decode rank 分配一个设备。\n"
+"    - `--swa-bounded-replay` 在 Prefill 上配合 PCP4 启用 SWA bounded replay；Prefill 仍使用 `--enforce-eager`。\n"
+"    - `--data-parallel-address` 和 `--data-parallel-rpc-port` 在一个角色内协调 DP rank。Prefill 和 Decode 使用各自的节点 IP；端口 `12321` 可以复用，因为两个角色运行在不同主机上。\n"
+"    - `--vllm-start-port 7100` 在 Prefill 上分配 API 端口 `7100-7103`，在 Decode 上分配 `7100-7115`。这些端点必须能被 PD proxy 访问。\n"
+"    - 两个角色都使用 `--max-model-len 1048576`。Prefill 使用 `--max-num-batched-tokens 8192` 和 `--max-num-seqs 16` 以提升 prompt 吞吐量，而 Decode 分别使用 `512` 和 `72` 以提升 decode 并发度。请独立调整这些角色特定的调度器限制。\n"
+"    - `MooncakeHybridConnector` 在两个角色之间传输 KV cache。`kv_role` 在 Prefill 上必须为 `kv_producer`，在 Decode 上必须为 `kv_consumer`。`kv_port` 必须可访问，且不得与其他服务冲突。\n"
+"    - `kv_connector_extra_config` 必须与两侧实际的全局布局匹配：Prefill DP4/TP1 和 Decode DP16/TP1。PCP4 通过 `--prefill-context-parallel-size` 单独配置；它不会改变 connector 配置中的 `tp_size`。请确保 Prefill 和 Decode 命令中的两个 connector 布局完全一致。\n"
+"    - 两个角色都使用带五个推测 token 的 DSpark。Prefill 以 eager 模式运行目标模型。Decode 对目标模型使用 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`，并同样允许 DSpark draft 模型进行图执行。\n"
+"    - `--engram-config '{\"cpu_offload\":true,\"dp_shared_memory\":true}'` 将 Engram 表保留在主机内存中，并允许本地 DP rank 共享该主机内存分配。在 A3 上必须使用 `dp_shared_memory`，因为模型的 24 个 Engram head 无法在 16 个逻辑设备上均匀划分。两个 A3 容器都使用 `--ipc=host`，以便本地 DP rank 可以共享该分配。\n"
+"    - `--compilation-config '{\"cudagraph_mode\":\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"}'` 捕获 Decode 路径，而 Prefill 保持在捕获图之外。\n"
+"    - Prefix caching 仅在 Prefill 上启用。Decode 禁用它并启用 `recompute_scheduler_enable`，以便 Prefill 可以重新计算不可用的 KV cache。\n"
+"    - Prefill 使用以下 `--additional-config` 选项："
+
+msgid ""
+"- `enable_cpu_binding: true` enables Ascend-native CPU affinity for worker\n"
+"        processes and runtime threads.\n"
+"        - `enable_fused_mc2: 2` selects the MegaMoE path on Prefill.\n"
+"        - `enable_flashcomm1: false` disables FlashComm for compatibility with SWA bounded replay.\n"
+"        - `multistream_overlap_shared_expert: false` disables shared-expert\n"
+"        multistream overlap on Prefill, where MegaMoE is enabled."
+msgstr ""
+"- `enable_cpu_binding: true` 为 worker 进程和运行时线程启用昇腾原生 CPU 亲和性。\n"
+"        - `enable_fused_mc2: 2` 在 Prefill 上选择 MegaMoE 路径。\n"
+"        - `enable_flashcomm1: false` 禁用 FlashComm，以兼容 SWA bounded replay。\n"
+"        - `multistream_overlap_shared_expert: false` 在启用 MegaMoE 的 Prefill 上禁用 shared-expert 多流重叠。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `ascend_compilation_config.enable_npugraph_ex: true` enables the enhanced\n"
+"        ACL Graph compilation and execution path used by `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`.\n"
+"        - `ascend_compilation_config.enable_static_kernel: false` disables static\n"
+"        kernel generation while retaining the enhanced ACL Graph path.\n"
+"        - `enable_cpu_binding: true` enables Ascend-native CPU affinity for worker\n"
+"        processes and runtime threads.\n"
+"        - `multistream_overlap_shared_expert: true` enables shared-expert multistream\n"
+"        overlap on Decode, where MegaMoE is not enabled. Shared-expert execution\n"
+"        overlaps routed-expert computation on separate streams.\n"
+"        - `recompute_scheduler_enable: true` enables the PD Decode recomputation\n"
+"        scheduler. When the Decode-side KV cache is unavailable, the request can be\n"
+"        sent back to Prefill to recompute it. Enable this option only on Decode."
+msgstr ""
+"- `ascend_compilation_config.enable_npugraph_ex: true` 启用 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 所使用的增强 ACL Graph 编译与执行路径。\n"
+"        - `ascend_compilation_config.enable_static_kernel: false` 禁用静态 kernel 生成，同时保留增强的 ACL Graph 路径。\n"
+"        - `enable_cpu_binding: true` 为 worker 进程和运行时线程启用昇腾原生 CPU 亲和性。\n"
+"        - `multistream_overlap_shared_expert: true` 在未启用 MegaMoE 的 Decode 上启用共享专家多流重叠。共享专家执行与路由专家计算在不同流上重叠进行。\n"
+"        - `recompute_scheduler_enable: true` 启用 PD Decode 重计算调度器。当 Decode 侧 KV cache 不可用时，请求可被送回 Prefill 重新计算。仅在 Decode 上启用此选项。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The Prefill and Decode configurations are role-specific. Do not copy the\n"
+"      Prefill MegaMoE and PCP options to Decode, or the Decode graph, multistream,\n"
+"      and recomputation options to Prefill, without validating the resulting\n"
+"      topology and performance."
+msgstr ""
+"Prefill 和 Decode 配置是角色专用的。在未验证最终拓扑和性能的情况下，请勿将 Prefill 的 MegaMoE 和 PCP 选项复制到 "
+"Decode，也不要将 Decode 的 graph、multistream 和重计算选项复制到 Prefill。"
+
+msgid ""
+"`HCCL_IF_IP` and the socket interface variables must select the same high-speed\n"
+"      service network used by the configured node IPs. `HCCL_BUFFSIZE` is `1024` on\n"
+"      Prefill and `4096` on Decode; retain these role-specific values unless another\n"
+"      setting has been validated. The DP RPC, engine, Mooncake, and proxy ports must\n"
+"      be allowed by the host firewall.\n"
+"      Wait until every engine finishes loading weights and Decode finishes graph\n"
+"      capture. A successful startup includes output similar to:"
+msgstr ""
+"`HCCL_IF_IP` 和套接字接口变量必须选择与所配置节点 IP 相同的高速服务网络。`HCCL_BUFFSIZE` 在 Prefill 上为 `1024`，在 Decode 上为 `4096`；除非已验证其他设置，否则请保留这些角色专用值。DP RPC、engine、Mooncake 和 proxy 端口必须被主机防火墙放行。\n"
+"      等待所有 engine 完成权重加载且 Decode 完成 graph 捕获。成功启动会包含类似以下内容的输出："
+
+msgid "Select the tab for the target hardware."
+msgstr "选择目标硬件对应的标签页。"
+
+msgid "#### 5.3.1 Memcache KV Cache Pool"
+msgstr "#### 5.3.1 Memcache KV Cache 池"
+
+msgid ""
+"This example adds a DRAM KV Cache Pool to the two-server DP8 Prefill / DP8\n"
+"    Decode deployment in [950DT DP8 Prefill and DP8 Decode](#950dt-dp8-prefill-and-dp8-decode). The model layout, ports, and proxy are\n"
+"    the same as ordinary PD deployment."
+msgstr ""
+"本示例为 [950DT DP8 Prefill 和 DP8 Decode](#950dt-dp8-prefill-and-dp8-decode) "
+"中的双服务器 DP8 Prefill / DP8 Decode 部署添加一个 DRAM KV Cache 池。模型布局、端口和 proxy 与普通 PD"
+" 部署相同。"
+
+msgid ""
+"`MultiConnector` combines `MooncakeHybridConnector` for P-to-D transfer with\n"
+"    `AscendStoreConnector` for Memcache access. Prefill looks up, loads, and\n"
+"    stores reusable prefixes; Decode receives KV from Prefill. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash\n"
+"    uses bulk pool access: set `use_layerwise` to `false` on both roles."
+msgstr ""
+"`MultiConnector` 将用于 P 到 D 传输的 `MooncakeHybridConnector` 与用于 Memcache 访问的 "
+"`AscendStoreConnector` 组合在一起。Prefill 查找、加载并存储可复用的前缀；Decode 从 Prefill 接收 "
+"KV。DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 使用批量池访问：在两个角色上都将 `use_layerwise` 设置为 `false`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"On Prefill, set `--max-num-batched-tokens` to `5120` and enable\n"
+"    `--swa-bounded-replay`. Disable local prefix caching so that repeated-prefix\n"
+"    requests exercise the external pool. On Decode, use `1024` batch tokens,\n"
+"    enable local prefix caching, and disable SWA bounded replay for the\n"
+"    recompute scheduler."
+msgstr ""
+"在 Prefill 上，将 `--max-num-batched-tokens` 设置为 `5120` 并启用 `--swa-bounded-"
+"replay`。禁用本地前缀缓存，以便重复前缀请求使用外部池。在 Decode 上，使用 `1024` 个 batch "
+"token，启用本地前缀缓存，并为重计算调度器禁用 SWA bounded replay。"
+
+msgid "##### 5.3.1.1 Prepare Memcache"
+msgstr "##### 5.3.1.1 准备 Memcache"
+
+msgid ""
+"On both nodes, create a separate working directory for the pooled "
+"deployment:"
+msgstr "在两个节点上，为池化部署创建一个独立的工作目录："
+
+msgid ""
+"Save `launch_online_dp.py` from\n"
+"    [Prepare the 950DT DP Launcher](#prepare-the-950dt-dp-launcher) in this directory on each\n"
+"    node. It uses the same arguments described there. Save the corresponding\n"
+"    pooled `run_dp_template.sh` below beside it and run all launcher commands\n"
+"    from this directory, because the launcher opens `./run_dp_template.sh`."
+msgstr ""
+"将 [准备 950DT DP 启动器](#prepare-the-950dt-dp-launcher) 中的 `launch_online_dp.py`"
+" 保存到每个节点的此目录中。它使用那里描述的相同参数。将下面相应的池化 `run_dp_template.sh` "
+"保存到其旁边，并从此目录运行所有启动器命令，因为启动器会打开 `./run_dp_template.sh`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Install `memfabric-hybrid` and `memcache-hybrid` on both nodes using the\n"
+"    [Memcache backend guide](../../user_guide/feature_guide/kv_cache_pool_ascend_store.md#scenario-2-memcache-backend).\n"
+"    Use `device_urma` for Device UB, or `device_uboe` for UBOE."
+msgstr ""
+"使用 [Memcache "
+"后端指南](../../user_guide/feature_guide/kv_cache_pool_ascend_store.md#scenario-2-memcache-"
+"backend) 在两个节点上安装 `memfabric-hybrid` 和 `memcache-hybrid`。Device UB 使用 "
+"`device_urma`，UBOE 使用 `device_uboe`。"
+
+msgid "Create `meta.conf` on the MetaService node:"
+msgstr "在 MetaService 节点上创建 `meta.conf`："
+
+msgid ""
+"Create `mmc-local.conf` on both Prefill and Decode nodes, using the same\n"
+"    MetaService IP:"
+msgstr "在 Prefill 和 Decode 节点上创建 `mmc-local.conf`，使用相同的 MetaService IP："
+
+msgid ""
+"Each vLLM worker starts an embedded LocalService. `dram.size` is the DRAM\n"
+"    contributed by each LocalService. With eight workers per node, `25GB`\n"
+"    reserves about 200 GiB per node, or 400 GiB across the two servers.\n"
+"    `max.dram.size` must be at least the largest `dram.size` contributed by any\n"
+"    LocalService; it does not limit the total pool capacity. Adjust both values\n"
+"    to the host memory available after Engram offloading and model loading.\n"
+"    `world_size` is the maximum number of LocalServices in the pool, not the DP\n"
+"    size. No standalone LocalService is needed for this configuration."
+msgstr ""
+"每个 vLLM worker 都会启动一个内嵌的 LocalService。`dram.size` 是每个 LocalService 贡献的 "
+"DRAM。每节点八个 worker 时，`25GB` 会在每节点预留约 200 GiB，两台服务器共约 400 GiB。`max.dram.size` "
+"必须至少为任一 LocalService 贡献的最大 `dram.size`；它不限制池的总容量。请根据 Engram "
+"卸载和模型加载后主机可用的内存调整这两个值。`world_size` 是池中 LocalService 的最大数量，而不是 DP "
+"size。此配置不需要独立的 LocalService。"
+
+msgid "Start one MetaService before starting vLLM:"
+msgstr "在启动 vLLM 之前启动一个 MetaService："
+
+msgid ""
+"Keep MetaService running in its terminal. After MetaService is ready,\n"
+"    Prefill and Decode can start concurrently in separate terminals."
+msgstr ""
+"让 MetaService 在其终端中保持运行。MetaService 就绪后，Prefill 和 Decode 可以在各自的终端中并发启动。"
+

+"    for this node. Set `MEMCACHE_INSTALL_PATH` to the `Location` reported by\n"
+"    `pip show memcache_hybrid`, and `MEMCACHE_CONFIG_DIR` to the directory\n"
+"    containing this node's `mmc-local.conf`."

+"`MEMCACHE_CONFIG_DIR` 设置为包含此节点 `mmc-local.conf` 的目录。"
+
+msgid "After MetaService is ready, start the eight Decode engines:"
+msgstr "MetaService 就绪后，启动八个 Decode engine："
+
+msgid "##### 5.3.1.3 Start the Prefill Node with Pooling"
+msgstr "##### 5.3.1.3 启动带池化的 Prefill 节点"
+
+msgid ""
+"On Prefill, save the following as `~/dsv41-memcache/run_dp_template.sh`,\n"
+"    beside its own `launch_online_dp.py`. Set this node's network, model, and\n"
+"    Memcache paths as described for Decode above. Both nodes must use the same\n"

+msgstr ""
+"在 Prefill 上，将以下内容保存为 `~/dsv41-memcache/run_dp_template.sh`，放在其自身的 "

+
+msgid "After MetaService is ready, start the eight Prefill engines:"

+msgid "##### 5.3.1.4 Start the Proxy and Verify Pooling"
+msgstr "##### 5.3.1.4 启动 Proxy 并验证池化"
+
+msgid ""
+"Each Prefill and Decode engine reports `Application startup complete.` in\n"
+"    its terminal when startup is complete. Once all engines are ready, start\n"
+"    the proxy from [Deploy the 950DT PD Proxy](#deploy-the-950dt-pd-proxy) with the same\n"
+"    endpoints. Verify the service using [Section 5.6](#56-service-verification).\n"

+msgstr ""
+"每个 Prefill 和 Decode 引擎在启动完成后会在其终端中输出 `Application startup "
+"complete.`。所有引擎就绪后，使用相同的端点，按照 [部署 Ascend 950DT PD Proxy](#deploy-the-950dt-"

+msgid ""
+"Check Prefill external prefix-cache hits and MetaService DRAM get hits:"
+msgstr "检查 Prefill 的外部前缀缓存命中情况和 MetaService DRAM 获取命中情况："
+
+msgid ""
+"Check all Prefill ranks because the proxy may\n"
+"    route requests to different ranks. Confirm that external hit tokens and\n"
+"    Memcache DRAM get hits increase, and that Prefill logs show a successful\n"
+"    external load. Decode external hits also include P-to-D transfer, so they\n"
+"    do not identify a DRAM pool hit by themselves."
+msgstr ""
+"检查所有 Prefill rank，因为代理可能会将请求路由到不同的 rank。确认外部命中 token 数和 Memcache DRAM "
+"获取命中数增加，并且 Prefill 日志显示外部加载成功。Decode 的外部命中还包括 P-to-D 传输，因此它们本身并不能标识 DRAM "
+"池命中。"
+
+msgid "#### 5.3.2 Memcache KV Cache Pool"
+msgstr "#### 5.3.2 Memcache KV Cache 池"
+
+msgid ""
+"This configuration extends the A3 1P1D deployment in [Section 5.2](#52-1p1d-pd-disaggregated-deployment) with a\n"
+"    Memcache KV Cache Pool. `MooncakeHybridConnector` continues to transfer KV\n"
+"    cache from Prefill to Decode, while `AscendStoreConnector` stores reusable KV\n"
+"    cache in Memcache. Both connectors are configured as children of\n"
+"    `MultiConnector`."
+msgstr ""
+"此配置在 [第 5.2 节](#52-1p1d-pd-disaggregated-deployment) 中的 A3 1P1D 部署基础上增加了 "
+"Memcache KV Cache 池。`MooncakeHybridConnector` 继续将 KV cache 从 Prefill 传输到 "
+"Decode，而 `AscendStoreConnector` 将可复用的 KV cache 存储到 Memcache 中。两个连接器都配置为 "
+"`MultiConnector` 的子连接器。"
+
+msgid ""
+"DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash does not support layerwise KV Cache Pool access because its\n"
+"    CED hybrid-attention model structure is incompatible with layer-by-layer KV\n"
+"    save and load. Keep `use_layerwise` set to `false` on both Prefill and Decode."
+msgstr ""
+"DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 不支持分层（layerwise）KV Cache 池访问，因为其 CED 混合注意力模型结构与逐层 KV "
+"保存和加载不兼容。请在 Prefill 和 Decode 上都将 `use_layerwise` 设置为 `false`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Before starting vLLM, follow the\n"
+"    [Memcache backend guide](../../user_guide/feature_guide/kv_cache_pool_ascend_store.md#scenario-2-memcache-backend)\n"
+"    to install `memfabric-hybrid` and `memcache-hybrid`, configure\n"
+"    `meta.conf`, `mmc-local.conf`, and `mmc-local-standalone.conf`, and start the\n"
+"    Memcache MetaService. The\n"
+"    Prefill and Decode nodes must use the same MetaService endpoint. Keep the\n"
+"    `/etc/hccn.conf` container mount from [Section 4.1](#41-docker-image-installation)."

+"在启动 vLLM 之前，请按照 [Memcache "
 "后端指南](../../user_guide/feature_guide/kv_cache_pool_ascend_store.md#scenario-2-memcache-"
 "backend) 安装 `memfabric-hybrid` 和 `memcache-hybrid`，配置 `meta.conf`、`mmc-"
 "local.conf` 和 `mmc-local-standalone.conf`，并启动 Memcache MetaService。Prefill 和"
-" Decode 节点必须使用相同的 MetaService 端点。请保留 [第 4.1 节](#41-docker-image-"

+" Decode 节点必须使用相同的 MetaService 端点。保留 [第 4.1 节](#41-docker-image-installation)"

+msgid ""
+"This example uses separated Memcache deployment so that the pool reserves host\n"

+"    two LocalService configurations as described below."
+msgstr ""
+"此示例使用分离式 Memcache 部署，以便缓存池在 vLLM 加载模型之前预留主机内存。请按如下说明准备一份 MetaService 配置和两份 "
+"LocalService 配置。"

+msgid "##### 5.3.2.1 Prepare the Memcache Services"
+msgstr "##### 5.3.2.1 准备 Memcache 服务"
+
+msgid ""
+"Create `mmc-local.conf` on both Prefill and Decode nodes for the LocalService\n"

+msgstr "在 Prefill 和 Decode 节点上为 vLLM 内嵌的 LocalService 创建 `mmc-local.conf`："

+msgid ""
+"Create `mmc-local-standalone.conf` on both nodes for the standalone Memcache\n"
+"    process. It uses the same endpoints, world size, and protocol, but contributes\n"
+"    the host DRAM used by the pool:"
+msgstr ""
+"在两个节点上为独立 Memcache 进程创建 `mmc-local-standalone.conf`。它使用相同的端点、world size "
+"和协议，但提供缓存池所使用的主机 DRAM："
+
+msgid ""
+"`world_size` is the maximum number of LocalServices that can join the pool, not\n"
+"    the DP size. Changing it after LocalServices connect requires restarting\n"
+"    MetaService. `device_sdma` is recommended for A3 HCCS and requires LingQu\n"
+"    Computing Network 1.5 or later. The `200GB` standalone DRAM value is an example;\n"
+"    set it according to the host memory available after reserving capacity for the\n"
+"    operating system and vLLM. `max.dram.size` must be at least the largest\n"
+"    `dram.size` contributed by any LocalService."
+msgstr ""
+"`world_size` 是能够加入缓存池的 LocalService 最大数量，而不是 DP 大小。在 LocalService "
+"连接后修改该值需要重启 MetaService。A3 HCCS 推荐使用 `device_sdma`，并且需要灵衢计算网络 1.5 "
+"或更高版本。`200GB` 的独立 DRAM 值仅为示例；请根据为操作系统和 vLLM 预留容量后剩余的主机内存进行设置。`max.dram.size`"
+" 必须至少等于任一 LocalService 所提供的最大 `dram.size`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Save the following script as `memcache_standalone.py` on both Prefill and\n"
+"    Decode nodes:"
+msgstr "将以下脚本保存为 Prefill 和 Decode 节点上的 `memcache_standalone.py`："
+
+msgid ""
+"After MetaService is ready, start the standalone Memcache process on both\n"
+"    Prefill and Decode nodes and wait for successful initialization:"
+msgstr "MetaService 就绪后，在 Prefill 和 Decode 节点上启动独立 Memcache 进程，并等待初始化成功："
+
+msgid ""
+"For additional parameters and capacity constraints, refer to\n"
+"    [Memcache and vLLM separated deployment](../../user_guide/feature_guide/kv_cache_pool_ascend_store.md#Memcache-and-vLLM-Separated-Deployment)."
+msgstr ""
+"有关其他参数和容量约束，请参阅 [Memcache 与 vLLM "
+"分离部署](../../user_guide/feature_guide/kv_cache_pool_ascend_store.md#Memcache-"
+"and-vLLM-Separated-Deployment)。"

-"      enable FlashComm1.\n"

-"      `multistream_overlap_shared_expert: true`,\n"
-"      `enable_shared_expert_dp: true`, and `recompute_scheduler_enable: true`.\n"
