+msgid "{% set vllm_ascend_version = \"nightly-releases-v0.32.0rc\" %}"
+msgstr "{% set vllm_ascend_version = \"nightly-releases-v0.32.0rc\" %}"
+
+msgid ""
+"GLM-5.3-Flash is supported in **vLLM-Ascend v0.30.0 and later**.\n"
+"This guide follows the deployment configurations on the vLLM-Ascend\n"
+"`releases/v0.32.0rc` branch.\n"
+"To use the latest features, use the latest supported release candidate or\n"
+"official version of vLLM-Ascend."
+msgstr ""
+"GLM-5.3-Flash 在 **vLLM-Ascend v0.30.0 及更高版本**中受支持。\n"
+"本指南遵循 vLLM-Ascend `releases/v0.32.0rc` 分支上的部署配置。\n"
+"如需使用最新特性，请使用 vLLM-Ascend 最新支持的候选发布版本或\n"
+"正式版本。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use the matching upstream vLLM revision for the selected vLLM-Ascend version.\n"
+"For source builds, use the upstream vLLM tag recorded in\n"
+"`.github/vllm-release-tag.commit` at the selected vLLM-Ascend release tag."
+msgstr ""
+"请为所选的 vLLM-Ascend 版本使用匹配的上游 vLLM 修订版本。\n"
+"对于源码构建，请使用所选 vLLM-Ascend 发布标签中\n"
+"`.github/vllm-release-tag.commit` 记录的上游 vLLM 标签。"
+
+msgid ""
+"All deployment examples on this page use Model Runner V2 with\n"
+"`VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`. Every PD Prefill role uses PCP8 with TP1;\n"
+"Decode keeps PCP1."
+msgstr ""
+"本页所有部署示例均使用 Model Runner V2，并设置\n"
+"`VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`。每个 PD Prefill 角色均使用 PCP8 和 TP1；\n"
+"Decode 保持 PCP1。"
+
+msgid ""
+"GLM-5.3-Flash supports Prefill Context Parallelism (PCP), ReplaySSM\n"
+"(`--use-replayssm`), and BF16 SSM state (`--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16`).\n"
+"The [A3 ordinary PD examples](#glm53-flash-5-3-a3) use these features together.\n"
+"The [A3 KV Cache Pool example](#glm53-flash-5-4-a3)\n"
+"uses native KDA because ReplaySSM does not support `MultiConnector`."
+msgstr ""
+"GLM-5.3-Flash 支持 Prefill 上下文并行（PCP）、ReplaySSM\n"
+"（`--use-replayssm`）以及 BF16 SSM 状态（`--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16`）。\n"
+"[A3 普通 PD 示例](#glm53-flash-5-3-a3) 将这些特性结合使用。\n"
+"[A3 KV Cache Pool 示例](#glm53-flash-5-4-a3)\n"
+"使用原生 KDA，因为 ReplaySSM 不支持 `MultiConnector`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `--data-parallel-size 1`: Runs a single DP rank. `--tensor-parallel-size` is 8 on 950DT products and 16 on A3 series. This layout is recommended to balance memory capacity and compute efficiency for the w8a8 weights.\n"
+"- `--enable-expert-parallel`: Must be enabled for the MoE architecture of GLM-5.3-Flash.\n"
+"- `--quantization ascend`: Enables Ascend quantization for the w8a8 quantized weights.\n"
+"- `--kv-cache-dtype`: Enables 8-bit KV cache quantization (C8) for Sparse Flash Attention (SFA).\n"
+"  Use C8 when long contexts or concurrent requests are limited by KV cache memory.\n"
+"  The complete single-node commands above use `fp8` on 950DT products and `int8` on A3 series.\n"
+"  KV cache quantization is independent of weight quantization: enabling C8 does not require W8A8 weights or a separate C8 checkpoint.\n"
+"  The examples use W8A8-MXFP8 weights on 950DT products and W8A8 weights on A3 series, as listed in Section 3.1.\n"
+"- `--attention-config.indexer_kv_dtype`: Uses FP8 KPool indexer cache on 950DT products and INT8 on A3 series, independently of `--kv-cache-dtype`.\n"
+"- `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16`: Uses BF16 SSM state in the A3 series single-node example.\n"
+"- `--compilation-config '{\"cudagraph_mode\": \"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"}'`: Enables graph capture for the decode phase only, improving decode performance by reducing kernel launch overhead.\n"
+"- `--limit-mm-per-prompt '{\"image\":1,\"video\":0}'`: Allows at most one image per prompt and disables video input where specified. A3 ordinary PD uses `'{\"image\":1}'` to limit image input only.\n"
+"- `--speculative-config`: Enables Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) speculative decoding with the DeepSeek-style MTP draft head of GLM-5.3-Flash. The single-node examples use five speculative tokens. GLM-5.3-Flash supports MTP draft graph execution."
+msgstr ""
+"- `--data-parallel-size 1`：运行单个 DP rank。`--tensor-parallel-size` 在 Ascend 950DT系列产品上为 8，在 A3系列上为 16。推荐采用此布局，以在 w8a8 权重下平衡内存容量与计算效率。\n"
+"- `--enable-expert-parallel`：必须为 GLM-5.3-Flash 的 MoE 架构启用。\n"
+"- `--quantization ascend`：为 w8a8 量化权重启用昇腾量化。\n"
+"- `--kv-cache-dtype`：为稀疏 Flash Attention（SFA）启用 8 位 KV cache 量化（C8）。\n"
+"  当长上下文或并发请求受限于 KV cache 内存时，请使用 C8。\n"
+"  上述完整的单节点命令在 Ascend 950DT系列产品上使用 `fp8`，在 A3系列上使用 `int8`。\n"
+"  KV cache 量化与权重量化相互独立：启用 C8 不需要 W8A8 权重，也不需要单独的 C8 checkpoint。\n"
+"  如第 3.1 节所列，示例在 Ascend 950DT系列产品上使用 W8A8-MXFP8 权重，在 A3系列上使用 W8A8 权重。\n"
+"- `--attention-config.indexer_kv_dtype`：在 Ascend 950DT系列产品上使用 FP8 KPool indexer cache，在 A3系列上使用 INT8，与 `--kv-cache-dtype` 相互独立。\n"
+"- `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16`：在 A3系列单节点示例中使用 BF16 SSM 状态。\n"
+"- `--compilation-config '{\"cudagraph_mode\": \"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"}'`：仅为 decode 阶段启用图捕获，通过减少 kernel 启动开销来提升 decode 性能。\n"
+"- `--limit-mm-per-prompt '{\"image\":1,\"video\":0}'`：每个 prompt 最多允许一张图像，并在指定位置禁用视频输入。A3 普通 PD 使用 `'{\"image\":1}'` 仅限制图像输入。\n"
+"- `--speculative-config`：使用 GLM-5.3-Flash 的 DeepSeek 风格 MTP draft head 启用多 Token 预测（MTP）投机解码。单节点示例使用五个投机 Token。GLM-5.3-Flash 支持 MTP draft 图执行。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The launcher passes visible devices, engine port, global DP size, DP rank, DP\n"
+"address, DP RPC port, TP size, and PCP size to each role script as `$1` through\n"
+"`$8`. Each local DP rank uses TP×PCP devices. `--pcp-size` defaults to `1`."
+msgstr ""
+"启动器将可见设备、引擎端口、全局 DP 大小、DP rank、DP\n"
+"地址、DP RPC 端口、TP 大小和 PCP 大小作为 `$1` 到\n"
+"`$8` 传递给每个角色脚本。每个本地 DP rank 使用 TP×PCP 个设备。`--pcp-size` 默认为 `1`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"When `--dp-size 1` is selected, the launcher removes lines containing\n"
+"`--data-parallel-rank` or `--data-parallel-external-lb` before running the role\n"
+"script. These options enable external DP load balancing, which requires DP>1.\n"
+"Keep each option on its own line so other arguments are preserved when filtering.\n"
+"For DP>1, the launcher executes the role script without filtering."
+msgstr ""
+"当选择 `--dp-size 1` 时，启动器会在运行角色脚本前移除包含\n"
+"`--data-parallel-rank` 或 `--data-parallel-external-lb` 的行。这些选项用于启用外部 DP 负载均衡，需要 DP>1。\n"
+"请将每个选项单独放在一行，以便在过滤时保留其他参数。\n"
+"对于 DP>1，启动器执行角色脚本时不做过滤。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use two nodes with eight devices each: Prefill TP1/PCP8/DP1 and Decode\n"
+"    TP1/PCP1/DP8. Both roles use EP8.\n"
+"    Both nodes use the same GLM-5.3-Flash W8A8-MXFP8 checkpoint and software build.\n"
+"    Set the local IP, network interface and checkpoint path in each script."
+msgstr ""
+"使用两个节点，每个节点八张设备：Prefill 为 TP1/PCP8/DP1，Decode 为\n"
+"    TP1/PCP1/DP8。两个角色均使用 EP8。\n"
+"    两个节点使用相同的 GLM-5.3-Flash W8A8-MXFP8 checkpoint 和软件构建。\n"
+"    在每个脚本中设置本地 IP、网络接口和 checkpoint 路径。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `--data-parallel-size`, `--tensor-parallel-size`, and\n"
+"      `--prefill-context-parallel-size` define TP1/PCP8/DP1 on Prefill\n"
+"      and TP1/PCP1/DP8 on Decode. Each role uses eight devices on one node.\n"
+"      Prefill runs one eight-device engine. `--device-ids \"$1\"` binds each\n"
+"      engine to the device list passed by the launcher: devices `0-7` for\n"
+"      Prefill and one device per DP rank for Decode.\n"
+"    - `--data-parallel-address` and `--data-parallel-rpc-port` coordinate\n"
+"      ranks within each role. Prefill and Decode use their respective node\n"
+"      IPs; RPC port `12325` is reused on the separate hosts.\n"
+"    - `--vllm-start-port 8000` assigns Prefill API port `8000` and Decode\n"
+"      API ports `8000-8007`. Register all eight Decode endpoints with the\n"
+"      proxy.\n"
+"    - Both roles use `--max-model-len 133120`, `--kv-cache-dtype fp8`, and\n"
+"      `deepseek_mtp` with five speculative tokens.\n"
+"    - Prefill sets `--max-num-seqs 256` and\n"
+"      `--max-num-batched-tokens 24576`; Decode sets `30` and `120`,\n"
+"      respectively. Tune these per-engine scheduler limits for the workload.\n"
+"    - Prefill enables shared-expert multistream overlap, with\n"
+"      `enable_fused_mc2: 0`.\n"
+"      Decode enables shared-expert multistream overlap, recomputation\n"
+"      scheduling and `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` for target and MTP draft. Prefill\n"
+"      target and draft are eager. FlashComm1 and shared-expert DP require\n"
+"      TP>1 and are therefore not enabled on either role.\n"
+"    - Prefill uses PCP8, while Decode keeps the default PCP1. Both roles\n"
+"      keep the default DCP1. For PCP configuration, refer to\n"
+"      [Context Parallel](../../user_guide/feature_guide/context_parallel.md).\n"
+"    - Both roles enable prefix caching and allow one image per prompt,\n"
+"      with video input disabled through `--limit-mm-per-prompt`.\n"
+"    - `MooncakeConnectorV2` uses `kv_producer` on Prefill and `kv_consumer`\n"
+"      on Decode, with base KV ports `30100` and `30800`, respectively.\n"
+"      Both roles declare Prefill TP1/PCP8/DP1 and Decode TP1/PCP1/DP8.\n"
+"    - `HCCL_IF_IP` and the socket interface variables select each node's\n"
+"      communication network. `HCCL_BUFFSIZE` is `3072` on Prefill and\n"
+"      `1024` on Decode. The DP RPC, API, Mooncake and proxy ports must be\n"
+"      reachable between the corresponding hosts."
+msgstr ""
+"- `--data-parallel-size`、`--tensor-parallel-size` 和\n"
+"      `--prefill-context-parallel-size` 在 Prefill 上定义 TP1/PCP8/DP1，\n"
+"      在 Decode 上定义 TP1/PCP1/DP8。每个角色在一个节点上使用八个设备。\n"
+"      Prefill 运行一个八设备引擎。`--device-ids \"$1\"` 将每个引擎绑定到\n"
+"      启动器传入的设备列表：Prefill 使用设备 `0-7`，Decode 每个 DP rank\n"
+"      使用一个设备。\n"
+"    - `--data-parallel-address` 和 `--data-parallel-rpc-port` 协调\n"
+"      每个角色内的 rank。Prefill 和 Decode 使用各自的节点 IP；\n"
+"      RPC 端口 `12325` 在不同主机上重复使用。\n"
+"    - `--vllm-start-port 8000` 为 Prefill 分配 API 端口 `8000`，为 Decode\n"
+"      分配 API 端口 `8000-8007`。将所有八个 Decode 端点注册到\n"
+"      代理。\n"
+"    - 两个角色都使用 `--max-model-len 133120`、`--kv-cache-dtype fp8` 和\n"
+"      `deepseek_mtp`，并启用五个投机 token。\n"
+"    - Prefill 设置 `--max-num-seqs 256` 和\n"
+"      `--max-num-batched-tokens 24576`；Decode 分别设置为 `30` 和 `120`。\n"
+"      请根据工作负载调整这些每引擎调度器限制。\n"
+"    - Prefill 启用共享专家多流重叠，并设置\n"
+"      `enable_fused_mc2: 0`。\n"
+"      Decode 启用共享专家多流重叠、重计算\n"
+"      调度以及针对 target 和 MTP draft 的 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`。Prefill\n"
+"      的 target 和 draft 为 eager 模式。FlashComm1 和共享专家 DP 需要\n"
+"      TP>1，因此两个角色均未启用。\n"
+"    - Prefill 使用 PCP8，而 Decode 保持默认的 PCP1。两个角色\n"
+"      都保持默认的 DCP1。有关 PCP 配置，请参阅\n"
+"      [上下文并行](../../user_guide/feature_guide/context_parallel.md)。\n"
+"    - 两个角色都启用前缀缓存，并允许每个 prompt 一张图像，\n"
+"      通过 `--limit-mm-per-prompt` 禁用视频输入。\n"
+"    - `MooncakeConnectorV2` 在 Prefill 上使用 `kv_producer`，在 Decode 上\n"
+"      使用 `kv_consumer`，基础 KV 端口分别为 `30100` 和 `30800`。\n"
+"      两个角色都声明 Prefill TP1/PCP8/DP1 和 Decode TP1/PCP1/DP8。\n"
+"    - `HCCL_IF_IP` 和 socket 接口变量选择每个节点的\n"
+"      通信网络。`HCCL_BUFFSIZE` 在 Prefill 上为 `3072`，在 Decode 上为\n"
+"      `1024`。DP RPC、API、Mooncake 和代理端口必须在\n"
+"      相应主机之间可达。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This example uses two A3 series servers. The Prefill node runs two\n"
+"    DP ranks with TP1/PCP8 (DP2/TP1/PCP8), and the Decode node runs eight DP ranks\n"
+"    with TP2 (DP8/TP2). Both layouts consume all 16 logical devices on their\n"
+"    respective servers. `MooncakeConnectorV2` transfers KV cache from the\n"
+"    Prefill engines to the Decode engines."
+msgstr ""
+"本示例使用两台 Atlas A3系列产品服务器。Prefill 节点运行两个\n"
+"    DP rank，采用 TP1/PCP8（DP2/TP1/PCP8），Decode 节点运行八个 DP rank，\n"
+"    采用 TP2（DP8/TP2）。两种布局都消耗各自服务器上的全部 16 个逻辑设备。\n"
+"    `MooncakeConnectorV2` 将 KV 缓存从 Prefill 引擎传输到\n"
+"    Decode 引擎。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Start Decode first, then Prefill. In another terminal, check "
+"`<DECODE_NODE_IP>:9900/health` through port `9907` and "
+"`<PREFILL_NODE_IP>:9081/health` through port `9082` with `curl --fail`. "
+"Start the proxy only after all ten endpoints respond successfully; inspect "
+"each launcher terminal if a rank fails to initialize."
+msgstr ""
+"先启动 Decode，再启动 Prefill。在另一个终端中，使用 `curl --fail` 通过端口 `9907` 检查 "
+"`<DECODE_NODE_IP>:9900/health`，并通过端口 `9082` 检查 "
+"`<PREFILL_NODE_IP>:9081/health`。仅在所有十个端点都成功响应后才启动代理；如果某个 rank "
+"初始化失败，请检查各启动器终端。"
+
+msgid ""
+"On the Prefill node, save the following script as `run_p.sh`. The launcher\n"
+"    passes the visible devices, API port, DP configuration, TP size, and PCP size as\n"
+"    positional arguments."
+msgstr ""
+"在 Prefill 节点上，将以下脚本保存为 `run_p.sh`。启动器\n"
+"    将可见设备、API 端口、DP 配置、TP 大小和 PCP 大小作为\n"
+"    位置参数传入。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Start two TP1/PCP8 Prefill engines (total DP2). `--dp-address` uses the Prefill node IP.\n"
+"    The launcher assigns API ports `9081-9082`."
+msgstr ""
+"启动两个 TP1/PCP8 Prefill 引擎（总计 DP2）。`--dp-address` 使用 Prefill 节点 IP。\n"
+"    启动器分配 API 端口 `9081-9082`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Start eight TP2 Decode engines (total DP8). `--dp-address` uses the Decode node\n"
+"    IP. The launcher assigns API ports `9900-9907`."
+msgstr ""
+"启动八个 TP2 Decode 引擎（总计 DP8）。`--dp-address` 使用 Decode 节点\n"
+"    IP。启动器分配 API 端口 `9900-9907`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"After all Prefill and Decode engines are ready, open another terminal in\n"
+"    the Prefill container and start the\n"
+"    [load-balancing proxy](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/main/examples/disaggregated_prefill_v1/load_balance_proxy_server_example.py).\n"
+"    The proxy listens on port `8081`, distributes requests across Prefill\n"
+"    endpoints `9081-9082`, and then forwards Decode work to endpoints\n"
+"    `9900-9907`."
+msgstr ""
+"在所有 Prefill 和 Decode 引擎就绪后，在 Prefill 容器中打开另一个终端\n"
+"    并启动\n"
+"    [负载均衡代理](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/main/examples/disaggregated_prefill_v1/load_balance_proxy_server_example.py)。\n"
+"    该代理监听端口 `8081`，将请求分发到 Prefill\n"
+"    端点 `9081-9082`，然后将 Decode 工作转发到端点\n"
+"    `9900-9907`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Prefill uses DP2/TP1/PCP8: each of its two engines receives eight\n"
+"      devices from `launch_online_dp.py`. Decode uses DP8/TP2: each of its\n"
+"      eight engines receives two devices. Both roles use all 16 logical devices\n"
+"      on their respective A3 series nodes.\n"
+"    - `--data-parallel-address` and `--data-parallel-rpc-port` coordinate DP\n"
+"      ranks within one role. Prefill and Decode use their respective node IPs.\n"
+"      The default RPC port `12325` can be reused on the separate hosts.\n"
+"    - `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=\"$1\"` selects the launcher-assigned devices\n"
+"      for each engine.\n"
+"    - Prefill API ports are `9081-9082`; Decode API ports are `9900-9907`.\n"
+"      All ten endpoints must be reachable from the proxy.\n"
+"    - Both roles use Model Runner V2, INT8 main and indexer KV caches,\n"
+"      `--max-model-len 1048576`, MTP3, `--use-replayssm`, and\n"
+"      `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16`. Prefix caching uses the model default.\n"
+"      Refer to [GLM KDA RecoverSSM](../../user_guide/feature_guide/speculative_decoding.md)\n"
+"      for the ReplaySSM switch and its requirements.\n"
+"    - Prefill runs the target eagerly and enables draft graph execution.\n"
+"      It enables asynchronous EPLB with the `stair` policy and `hixl`\n"
+"      communicator. The Prefill configuration sets `enable_fused_mc2` to `2`\n"
+"      and `enable_shared_expert_dp` to `true`.\n"
+"    - Prefill uses `--max-num-seqs 32` and\n"
+"      `--max-num-batched-tokens 16384`. Decode uses `40` and `240`, respectively.\n"
+"    - Decode uses `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` with default capture sizes, FlashComm1,\n"
+"      shared-expert DP and multistream\n"
+"      overlap. Recompute scheduling is enabled through `scheduler_config`.\n"
+"    - Both roles explicitly limit image input to one image per prompt.\n"
+"    - `MooncakeConnectorV2` uses `kv_producer` and engine ID `0` on Prefill,\n"
+"      and `kv_consumer` and engine ID `1` on Decode. These IDs identify the\n"
+"      roles in this deployment. Base KV ports are `36680` and `36580`.\n"
+"    - The HCCS resource settings select device communication; `HCCL_IF_IP`\n"
+"      and the socket interface variables select the host network. The DP RPC,\n"
+"      API, Mooncake and proxy ports must be available on the respective hosts."
+msgstr ""
+"- Prefill 使用 DP2/TP1/PCP8：其两个引擎各自从 `launch_online_dp.py`\n"
+"      获得八个设备。Decode 使用 DP8/TP2：其八个引擎各自获得两个设备。\n"
+"      两个角色都使用各自 A3 系列节点上的全部 16 个逻辑设备。\n"
+"    - `--data-parallel-address` 和 `--data-parallel-rpc-port` 用于协调\n"
+"      同一角色内的 DP rank。Prefill 和 Decode 使用各自的节点 IP。\n"
+"      默认 RPC 端口 `12325` 可以在不同主机上复用。\n"
+"    - `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=\"$1\"` 用于为每个引擎选择启动器分配的设备。\n"
+"    - Prefill API 端口为 `9081-9082`；Decode API 端口为 `9900-9907`。\n"
+"      全部十个端点都必须能从代理访问。\n"
+"    - 两个角色都使用 Model Runner V2、INT8 主 KV 缓存和 indexer KV 缓存、\n"
+"      `--max-model-len 1048576`、MTP3、`--use-replayssm` 以及\n"
+"      `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16`。前缀缓存使用模型默认值。\n"
+"      关于 ReplaySSM 开关及其要求，请参阅\n"
+"      [GLM KDA RecoverSSM](../../user_guide/feature_guide/speculative_decoding.md)。\n"
+"    - Prefill 以 eager 模式运行目标模型，并启用 draft 图执行。\n"
+"      它启用异步 EPLB，使用 `stair` 策略和 `hixl` 通信器。\n"
+"      Prefill 配置将 `enable_fused_mc2` 设置为 `2`，\n"
+"      并将 `enable_shared_expert_dp` 设置为 `true`。\n"
+"    - Prefill 使用 `--max-num-seqs 32` 和\n"
+"      `--max-num-batched-tokens 16384`。Decode 分别使用 `40` 和 `240`。\n"
+"    - Decode 使用 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 及默认捕获大小、FlashComm1、\n"
+"      共享专家 DP 和多流重叠。重计算调度通过 `scheduler_config` 启用。\n"
+"    - 两个角色都显式将图像输入限制为每个提示一张图像。\n"
+"    - `MooncakeConnectorV2` 在 Prefill 上使用 `kv_producer` 和引擎 ID `0`，\n"
+"      在 Decode 上使用 `kv_consumer` 和引擎 ID `1`。这些 ID 用于标识\n"
+"      此部署中的角色。基础 KV 端口为 `36680` 和 `36580`。\n"
+"    - HCCS 资源配置选择设备通信；`HCCL_IF_IP`\n"
+"      和套接字接口变量选择主机网络。DP RPC、\n"
+"      API、Mooncake 和代理端口必须在相应主机上可用。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This example uses four A2 series (64GB × 8) servers: two Prefill\n"
+"    nodes running one DP rank with TP1/PCP8 each (DP2/TP1/PCP8 in total), and two\n"
+"    Decode nodes running four DP ranks with TP2 each (DP8/TP2 in total).\n"
+"    Each Prefill rank uses eight devices, and each Decode rank uses two.\n"
+"    Together, the local ranks use all eight devices on each server.\n"
+"    `MooncakeConnectorV2` transfers KV cache from the Prefill engines to the\n"
+"    Decode engines. The topology names the two Prefill nodes P0/P1 and the\n"
+"    two Decode nodes D0/D1. P0 serves the Prefill API endpoint; P1 is\n"
+"    headless. The proxy addresses the API endpoints on both Decode nodes."
+msgstr ""
+"本示例使用四台 A2 系列（64GB × 8）服务器：两个 Prefill\n"
+"    节点各运行一个 DP rank，使用 TP1/PCP8（总计 DP2/TP1/PCP8）；两个\n"
+"    Decode 节点各运行四个 DP rank，使用 TP2（总计 DP8/TP2）。\n"
+"    每个 Prefill rank 使用八个设备，每个 Decode rank 使用两个。\n"
+"    本地 rank 合计使用每台服务器上的全部八个设备。\n"
+"    `MooncakeConnectorV2` 将 KV 缓存从 Prefill 引擎传输到\n"
+"    Decode 引擎。拓扑将两个 Prefill 节点命名为 P0/P1，\n"
+"    两个 Decode 节点命名为 D0/D1。P0 提供 Prefill API 端点；P1 为\n"
+"    无头模式。代理访问两个 Decode 节点上的 API 端点。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- A2 series uses global DP2/TP1/PCP8 Prefill and DP8/TP2 Decode, with each\n"
+"      role spread across two nodes with eight devices per node. A3 ordinary PD uses\n"
+"      DP2/TP1/PCP8 Prefill and DP8/TP2 Decode, each on one node with 16 logical devices.\n"
+"    - P0 and P1 use the shared launcher with one local DP rank each. P0\n"
+"      exposes the Prefill API with `--api-server-count 1`; P1 is headless.\n"
+"      D0 and D1 each run four API-serving TP2 engines(total DP8) through their\n"
+"      node-specific wrapper scripts.\n"
+"    - `kv_connector_extra_config` enables `use_ascend_direct` for direct\n"
+"      NPU-to-NPU KV transfer and declares the actual Prefill and Decode\n"
+"      `{dp_size, tp_size, pcp_size}` topology. The declared values must match the\n"
+"      real deployment.\n"
+"    - Prefill uses `--max-num-seqs 64` and `--max-num-batched-tokens 4096`\n"
+"      without `--enforce-eager`; Decode uses `--max-num-seqs 60` and\n"
+"      `--max-num-batched-tokens 192` with `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` graph mode.\n"
+"      Both roles run with `--async-scheduling`.\n"
+"    - Both roles use Model Runner V2 via `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`.\n"
+"      Prefill uses PCP8 and TP1; Decode keeps PCP1.\n"
+"      `--device-ids \"$1\"` binds each engine to the launcher-assigned devices.\n"
+"      `VLLM_HOST_IP` advertises the IP that peers use to reach each\n"
+"      engine for KV transfer.\n"
+"    - MTP speculative decoding uses five speculative tokens on A2 series.\n"
+"      Prefill uses `enforce_eager: true`; Decode uses `enforce_eager: false`\n"
+"      with `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` graph mode.\n"
+"    - `HCCL_HOST_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE` and `HCCL_NPU_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE` on\n"
+"      Decode reserve a disjoint 100-port window per DP rank (starting at\n"
+"      `60000 + rank * 100`). When several engines share one node, these\n"
+"      ranges prevent the HCCL host-side sockets from silently sharing\n"
+"      ports across ranks, which can block engine startup.\n"
+"    - The remaining timeout and runtime variables\n"
+"      (`VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`, `HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT`,\n"
+"      `HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT`, `VLLM_RPC_TIMEOUT`, `OMP_PROC_BIND`,\n"
+"      `OMP_NUM_THREADS`) are the validated A2 series startup defaults for this\n"
+"      model size; keep them unless your environment requires different\n"
+"      values.\n"
+"    - `HCCL_IF_IP` and all socket interface variables must select the\n"
+"      service network used by the configured node IPs. The DP RPC,\n"
+"      engine, Mooncake, and proxy ports must be allowed by the host\n"
+"      firewall."
+msgstr ""
+"- A2 系列使用全局 DP2/TP1/PCP8 Prefill 和 DP8/TP2 Decode，每个\n"
+"      角色分布在两个节点上，每节点八个设备。A3 普通 PD 使用\n"
+"      DP2/TP1/PCP8 Prefill 和 DP8/TP2 Decode，各自在一个节点上使用 16 个逻辑设备。\n"
+"    - P0 和 P1 使用共享启动器，各自有一个本地 DP rank。P0\n"
+"      通过 `--api-server-count 1` 暴露 Prefill API；P1 为无头模式。\n"
+"      D0 和 D1 各自通过其节点专用的包装脚本运行四个提供 API 服务的 TP2 引擎（总计 DP8）。\n"
+"    - `kv_connector_extra_config` 启用 `use_ascend_direct` 以实现直接的\n"
+"      NPU 到 NPU KV 传输，并声明实际的 Prefill 和 Decode\n"
+"      `{dp_size, tp_size, pcp_size}` 拓扑。声明的值必须与实际\n"
+"      部署一致。\n"
+"    - Prefill 使用 `--max-num-seqs 64` 和 `--max-num-batched-tokens 4096`，\n"
+"      不使用 `--enforce-eager`；Decode 使用 `--max-num-seqs 60` 和\n"
+"      `--max-num-batched-tokens 192`，并采用 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 图模式。\n"
+"      两个角色都使用 `--async-scheduling` 运行。\n"
+"    - 两个角色都通过 `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1` 使用 Model Runner V2。\n"
+"      Prefill 使用 PCP8 和 TP1；Decode 保持 PCP1。\n"
+"      `--device-ids \"$1\"` 将每个引擎绑定到启动器分配的设备。\n"
+"      `VLLM_HOST_IP` 通告对等方用于访问每个引擎以进行 KV 传输的 IP。\n"
+"    - MTP 投机解码在 A2 系列上使用五个投机 token。\n"
+"      Prefill 使用 `enforce_eager: true`；Decode 使用 `enforce_eager: false`\n"
+"      并采用 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 图模式。\n"
+"    - Decode 上的 `HCCL_HOST_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE` 和 `HCCL_NPU_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE`\n"
+"      为每个 DP rank 保留一个互不重叠的 100 端口窗口（从\n"
+"      `60000 + rank * 100` 开始）。当多个引擎共享一个节点时，这些\n"
+"      范围可防止 HCCL 主机侧套接字在不同 rank 之间静默共享\n"
+"      端口，从而避免阻塞引擎启动。\n"
+"    - 其余超时和运行时变量\n"
+"      （`VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`、`HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT`、\n"
+"      `HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT`、`VLLM_RPC_TIMEOUT`、`OMP_PROC_BIND`、\n"
+"      `OMP_NUM_THREADS`）是针对此模型大小经过验证的 A2 系列启动默认值；\n"
+"      除非你的环境需要不同的值，否则请保留它们。\n"
+"    - `HCCL_IF_IP` 和所有套接字接口变量必须选择\n"
+"      配置的节点 IP 所使用的服务网络。DP RPC、\n"
+"      引擎、Mooncake 和代理端口必须被主机\n"
+"      防火墙允许。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This section uses the Memcache backend for 950DT products and A3 series,\n"
+"and the Mooncake backend for A2 series. Select the platform subsection that matches\n"
+"the PD topology in [Section 5.3](#53-1p1d-pd-disaggregated-deployment).\n"
+"`MultiConnector` combines two connectors:"
+msgstr ""
+"本节针对 Ascend 950DT系列产品 和 A3 系列使用 Memcache 后端，\n"
+"针对 A2 系列使用 Mooncake 后端。请选择与\n"
+"[第 5.3 节](#53-1p1d-pd-disaggregated-deployment)中 PD 拓扑匹配的平台小节。\n"
+"`MultiConnector` 组合两个连接器："
+
+msgid "#### 950DT products {: #glm53-flash-5-4-950dt }"
+msgstr "#### Ascend 950DT系列产品 {: #glm53-flash-5-4-950dt }"
+
+msgid ""
+"Reuse the Prefill TP1/PCP8/DP1 and Decode TP1/PCP1/DP8 topology,\n"
+"    launcher and proxy from [Section 5.3](#glm53-flash-5-3-950dt).\n"
+"    Both roles use EP8, FP8 main KV cache and an FP8 indexer."
+msgstr ""
+"复用 [第 5.3 节](#glm53-flash-5-3-950dt)中的 Prefill TP1/PCP8/DP1 和 Decode TP1/PCP1/DP8 拓扑、\n"
+"    启动器和代理。\n"
+"    两个角色都使用 EP8、FP8 主 KV 缓存和 FP8 indexer。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Follow [Scenario 2: Memcache Backend](../../user_guide/feature_guide/kv_cache_pool_ascend_store.md#scenario-2-memcache-backend)\n"
+"    for the Memcache backend configuration."
+msgstr ""
+"请参考[场景 2：Memcache 后端](../../user_guide/feature_guide/kv_cache_pool_ascend_store.md#scenario-2-memcache-backend)\n"
+"    进行 Memcache 后端配置。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Keep prefix caching, chunked prefill and the hybrid KV cache manager\n"
+"    enabled. With prefix caching enabled, the model configuration selects\n"
+"    `mamba_cache_mode=align`, which is required by `AscendStoreConnector`.\n"
+"    Keep `use_layerwise=false` and PP=DCP=1. Do not enable\n"
+"    [RecoverSSM](../../user_guide/feature_guide/speculative_decoding.md)\n"
+"    for this deployment: its KV-transfer path does not accept `MultiConnector`."
+msgstr ""
+"保持前缀缓存、分块预填充和混合 KV cache 管理器处于启用状态。启用前缀缓存后，\n"
+"    模型配置会选择 `mamba_cache_mode=align`，这是 `AscendStoreConnector` 所要求的。\n"
+"    保持 `use_layerwise=false` 且 PP=DCP=1。请勿为此部署启用\n"
+"    [RecoverSSM](../../user_guide/feature_guide/speculative_decoding.md)：\n"
+"    其 KV 传输路径不接受 `MultiConnector`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"1. On the Prefill node, replace the final `--kv-transfer-config`\n"
+"       argument in `run_dp_template.sh` with the following fragment.\n"
+"       Keep the remaining Prefill flags from Section 5.3, including\n"
+"       `--device-ids \"$1\"`, PCP8, FP8 indexer and eager execution."
+msgstr ""
+"1. 在 Prefill 节点上，将 `run_dp_template.sh` 中最后的 `--kv-transfer-config`\n"
+"       参数替换为以下片段。\n"
+"       保留第 5.3 节中其余的 Prefill 参数，包括\n"
+"       `--device-ids \"$1\"`、PCP8、FP8 indexer 和 eager 执行。"
+
+msgid ""
+"2. On the Decode node, replace the final `--kv-transfer-config`\n"
+"       argument in `run_dp_template.sh` with the following fragment.\n"
+"       Keep the remaining Decode flags from Section 5.3, including\n"
+"       `--device-ids \"$1\"`, the FP8 indexer, MTP5 and `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`."
+msgstr ""
+"2. 在 Decode 节点上，将 `run_dp_template.sh` 中最后的 `--kv-transfer-config`\n"
+"       参数替换为以下片段。\n"
+"       保留第 5.3 节中其余的 Decode 参数，包括\n"
+"       `--device-ids \"$1\"`、FP8 indexer、MTP5 和 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"`$4` is the DP rank passed by the launcher. The Prefill lookup value\n"
+"    is `37000`; the Decode values are `37100-37107`. `lookup_rpc_port`\n"
+"    identifies the local IPC endpoint between the pooling scheduler and\n"
+"    worker. Prefill loads and saves pooled prefixes; Decode receives KV\n"
+"    cache through `MooncakeConnectorV2` and contributes DDR pool memory."
+msgstr ""
+"`$4` 是启动器传入的 DP rank。Prefill 的 lookup 值为\n"
+"    `37000`；Decode 的值为 `37100-37107`。`lookup_rpc_port`\n"
+"    标识池化调度器与 worker 之间的本地 IPC 端点。Prefill 加载并保存池化的前缀；\n"
+"    Decode 通过 `MooncakeConnectorV2` 接收 KV\n"
+"    cache，并贡献 DDR 池内存。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This KV Cache Pool example uses DP2/TP1/PCP8 Prefill and DP8/TP2 Decode,\n"
+"    using Model Runner V2 and native KDA. Prepare separate `run_p.sh` and\n"
+"    `run_d.sh` files for this scenario from the [A3 PD scripts](#glm53-flash-5-3-a3).\n"
+"    Keep the ordinary PD serving parameters on both roles, including\n"
+"    `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=\"$1\"`, INT8 main and indexer KV caches,\n"
+"    BF16 SSM state, MTP3, and the role-specific scheduling and tuning options.\n"
+"    Prefill uses 32 sequences and 16384 batched tokens; Decode uses 40\n"
+"    sequences and 240 batched tokens. Both roles limit image input to one image.\n"
+"    Add `--enable-prefix-caching` and remove `--use-replayssm`: this pooling\n"
+"    example uses native KDA because ReplaySSM does not accept `MultiConnector`.\n"
+"    Add the Memcache environment settings and replace the connectors as\n"
+"    described below. Reuse the ordinary PD launch commands and proxy mapping."
+msgstr ""
+"此 KV Cache Pool 示例使用 DP2/TP1/PCP8 Prefill 和 DP8/TP2 Decode，\n"
+"    采用 Model Runner V2 和原生 KDA。请基于 [A3 PD 脚本](#glm53-flash-5-3-a3)\n"
+"    为此场景准备单独的 `run_p.sh` 和\n"
+"    `run_d.sh` 文件。\n"
+"    在两个角色上保留常规 PD 服务参数，包括\n"
+"    `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=\"$1\"`、INT8 主 KV cache 和 indexer KV cache、\n"
+"    BF16 SSM 状态、MTP3，以及角色特定的调度和调优选项。\n"
+"    Prefill 使用 32 个序列和 16384 个批处理 token；Decode 使用 40\n"
+"    个序列和 240 个批处理 token。两个角色均将图像输入限制为一张图像。\n"
+"    添加 `--enable-prefix-caching` 并移除 `--use-replayssm`：此池化\n"
+"    示例使用原生 KDA，因为 ReplaySSM 不接受 `MultiConnector`。\n"
+"    添加 Memcache 环境设置并按\n"
+"    下文所述替换连接器。复用常规 PD 启动命令和代理映射。"
+
+msgid ""
+"`dram.size` specifies the DDR capacity allocated per worker. Prefill\n"
+"    (DP2/TP1/PCP8) and Decode (DP8/TP2) each start 16 workers. At `20GB` per worker,\n"
+"    each node contributes `320GB`, for a total DDR pool capacity of `640GB`.\n"
+"    Reserve sufficient DDR memory for the operating system and vLLM. For\n"
+"    `device_sdma`, keep each non-zero size aligned to `1GB`."
+msgstr ""
+"`dram.size` 指定每个 worker 分配的 DDR 容量。Prefill\n"
+"    (DP2/TP1/PCP8) 和 Decode (DP8/TP2) 各启动 16 个 worker。每个 worker 为 `20GB` 时，\n"
+"    每个节点贡献 `320GB`，DDR 池总容量为 `640GB`。\n"
+"    为操作系统和 vLLM 预留足够的 DDR 内存。对于\n"
+"    `device_sdma`，保持每个非零大小按 `1GB` 对齐。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use the same `PYTHONHASHSEED` and Memcache service endpoints on both nodes.\n"
+"    Keep the HCCS communication settings from [Section 5.3](#glm53-flash-5-3-a3), including\n"
+"    `ASCEND_GLOBAL_RESOURCE_CONFIG`."
+msgstr ""
+"在两个节点上使用相同的 `PYTHONHASHSEED` 和 Memcache 服务端点。\n"
+"    保留[第 5.3 节](#glm53-flash-5-3-a3)中的 HCCS 通信设置，包括\n"
+"    `ASCEND_GLOBAL_RESOURCE_CONFIG`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"For A3 series KV Cache Pool deployment, add `--enable-prefix-caching` to both\n"
+"    `run_p.sh` and `run_d.sh` prepared above, and keep\n"
+"    chunked prefill enabled (the model default). GLM-5.3-Flash has\n"
+"    linear-attention state, and `AscendStoreConnector`\n"
+"    requires `mamba_cache_mode=align`; the model configuration selects this mode\n"
+"    when prefix caching is enabled. Keep the hybrid KV cache manager enabled\n"
+"    and `use_layerwise` disabled for this configuration."
+msgstr ""
+"对于 Atlas A3系列产品 KV Cache Pool 部署，在之前准备的 `run_p.sh` 和 `run_d.sh`\n"
+"    中都添加 `--enable-prefix-caching`，并保持\n"
+"    分块预填充启用（模型默认值）。GLM-5.3-Flash 具有\n"
+"    线性注意力状态，而 `AscendStoreConnector`\n"
+"    要求 `mamba_cache_mode=align`；启用前缀缓存时，模型配置会选择此模式。\n"
+"    对于此配置，保持混合 KV cache 管理器启用\n"
+"    且 `use_layerwise` 禁用。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Replace the final `--kv-transfer-config` argument in `run_p.sh` with the\n"
+"    following fragment. Apart from the prefix-caching change above, keep\n"
+"    the remaining A3 series Prefill flags from ordinary PD, including\n"
+"    `--max-num-seqs 32`."
+msgstr ""
+"将 `run_p.sh` 中最后的 `--kv-transfer-config` 参数替换为\n"
+"    以下片段。除上述前缀缓存更改外，保留\n"
+"    常规 PD 中其余的 Atlas A3系列产品 Prefill 参数，包括\n"
+"    `--max-num-seqs 32`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Replace the final `--kv-transfer-config` argument in `run_d.sh` with the\n"
+"    following fragment. Apart from the prefix-caching change above, keep\n"
+"    the remaining A3 series Decode flags from ordinary PD, including\n"
+"    `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` graph mode and the MTP configuration."
+msgstr ""
+"将 `run_d.sh` 中最后的 `--kv-transfer-config` 参数替换为\n"
+"    以下片段。除上述前缀缓存更改外，保留\n"
+"    常规 PD 中其余的 Atlas A3系列产品 Decode 参数，包括\n"
+"    `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 图模式和 MTP 配置。"
+
+msgid ""
+"`$4` is the DP rank passed by `launch_online_dp.py`. Each engine must have a\n"
+"    unique `lookup_rpc_port`. The Prefill lookup values are `37000-37001`, and the\n"
+"    Decode lookup values are `37100-37107`. Keep the role-specific Mooncake KV\n"
+"    base ports from [Section 5.3](#glm53-flash-5-3-a3); its workers and schedulers derive their own\n"
+"    ports from the topology."
+msgstr ""
+"`$4` 是 `launch_online_dp.py` 传入的 DP rank。每个引擎必须具有\n"
+"    唯一的 `lookup_rpc_port`。Prefill 的 lookup 值为 `37000-37001`，\n"
+"    Decode 的 lookup 值为 `37100-37107`。保留[第 5.3 节](#glm53-flash-5-3-a3)中角色特定的 Mooncake KV\n"
+"    基础端口；其 worker 和调度器会根据拓扑推导各自的\n"
+"    端口。"
+
+msgid ""
+"2. Start Decode with DP8/TP2. Wait until all eight engines on ports\n"
+"       `9900-9907` are ready and their Memcache LocalServices have reserved\n"
+"       the configured DDR pool memory."
+msgstr ""
+"2. 以 DP8/TP2 启动 Decode。等待端口\n"
+"       `9900-9907` 上的全部八个引擎就绪，且其 Memcache LocalService 已预留\n"
+"       配置的 DDR 池内存。"
+
+msgid ""
+"3. Start Prefill with DP2/TP1/PCP8. Wait until both engines on ports\n"
+"       `9081-9082` are ready and their Memcache LocalServices have reserved\n"
+"       the configured DDR pool memory."
+msgstr ""
+"3. 以 DP2/TP1/PCP8 启动 Prefill。等待端口\n"
+"       `9081-9082` 上的两个引擎就绪，且其 Memcache LocalService 已预留\n"
+"       配置的 DDR 池内存。"
+
+msgid ""
+"4. In a separate terminal, set `export D_N=8`, then run the\n"
+"       [A3 series proxy script](#glm53-flash-a3-proxy). It uses Prefill ports\n"
+"       `9081-9082` and Decode ports `9900-9907` for this pooling scenario.\n"
+"       Send requests to `<PREFILL_NODE_IP>:8081` using\n"
+"       [Section 6](#6-functional-verification)."
+msgstr ""
+"4. 在单独的终端中，设置 `export D_N=8`，然后运行\n"
+"       [Atlas A3系列产品代理脚本](#glm53-flash-a3-proxy)。此池化场景使用 Prefill 端口\n"
+"       `9081-9082` 和 Decode 端口 `9900-9907`。\n"
+"       使用[第 6 节](#6-functional-verification)向 `<PREFILL_NODE_IP>:8081`\n"
+"       发送请求。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- P0: Prefill DP rank 0, TP1/PCP8, API port `8000`;\n"
+"    - P1: Prefill DP rank 1, TP1/PCP8, API port `8000`;\n"
+"    - D0: Decode DP ranks 0-3, TP2, API ports `8000-8003`;\n"
+"    - D1: Decode DP ranks 4-7, TP2, API ports `8000-8003`."
+msgstr ""
+"- P0：Prefill DP rank 0，TP1/PCP8，API 端口 `8000`；\n"
+"    - P1：Prefill DP rank 1，TP1/PCP8，API 端口 `8000`；\n"
+"    - D0：Decode DP rank 0-3，TP2，API 端口 `8000-8003`；\n"
+"    - D1：Decode DP rank 4-7，TP2，API 端口 `8000-8003`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"`global_segment_size` is registered per worker. With DP2/TP1/PCP8 spread across\n"
+"    two Prefill nodes, each node starts 8 workers; with the same configuration\n"
+"    on Decode, the pool also reserves the configured segment size there. Adjust\n"
+"    `24GB` only when the available host memory and SSD capacity require a\n"
+"    different per-worker value, keeping each non-zero segment size aligned to\n"
+"    `1GB`."
+msgstr ""
+"`global_segment_size` 按 worker 注册。当 DP2/TP1/PCP8 分布在两个 Prefill 节点上时，每个节点启动 8"
+" 个 worker；在 Decode 上使用相同配置时，缓存池也会在该处预留所配置的段大小。仅当可用的主机内存和 SSD 容量需要不同的每 worker"
+" 值时，才调整 `24GB`，并保持每个非零段大小对齐到 `1GB`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The actual `pd_pool_engine.sh` must use `--reasoning-parser glm45`,\n"
+"    `--tool-call-parser glm47`, Prefill `--max-num-batched-tokens 4096`, and\n"
+"    Decode `--max-num-seqs 60 --max-num-batched-tokens 192`. The Prefill and\n"
+"    Decode connector topology must be DP2/TP1/PCP8 and DP8/TP2/PCP1 respectively."
+msgstr ""
+"实际的 `pd_pool_engine.sh` 必须使用 `--reasoning-parser glm45`、`--tool-call-parser "
+"glm47`，Prefill 使用 `--max-num-batched-tokens 4096`，Decode 使用 `--max-num-seqs "
+"60 --max-num-batched-tokens 192`。Prefill 和 Decode 的连接器拓扑必须分别为 DP2/TP1/PCP8 和"
+" DP8/TP2/PCP1。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Save the [PCP-aware launcher from Section 5.3](#53-1p1d-pd-disaggregated-deployment)\n"
+"    as `<DEPLOYMENT_ROOT>/common/launch_online_dp.py`. Run each node's launcher\n"
+"    from its pool directory containing `run_dp_template.sh`."
+msgstr ""
+"将[第 5.3 节中支持 PCP 的启动器](#53-1p1d-pd-disaggregated-deployment)保存为 "
+"`<DEPLOYMENT_ROOT>/common/launch_online_dp.py`。在包含 `run_dp_template.sh` "
+"的池目录中运行各节点的启动器。"
+
+msgid "### 7.1 Using AISBench {: #glm53-flash-accuracy-aisbench }"
+msgstr "### 7.1 使用 AISBench {: #glm53-flash-accuracy-aisbench }"
+
+msgid ""
+"The A3 series results below were obtained using an earlier PD\n"
+"configuration with DP2/TP8 on the Prefill node and DP8/TP2 on the Decode node.\n"
+"Evaluation requests were sent through the PD proxy. The table below lists the\n"
+"generation parameters used for each dataset. See [Section 5.3](#53-1p1d-pd-disaggregated-deployment)\n"
+"for the current serving examples."
+msgstr ""
+"以下 Atlas A3系列产品结果使用较早的 PD 配置获得，其中 Prefill 节点为 DP2/TP8，Decode 节点为 "
+"DP8/TP2。评估请求通过 PD 代理发送。下表列出了每个数据集所使用的生成参数。当前的服务示例请参见[第 5.3 节](#53-1p1d-pd-"
+"disaggregated-deployment)。"
+
+msgid ""
+"| GPQA | 950DT products | 91.2 | `temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95, "
+"max_tokens=131072` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| GPQA | Ascend 950DT系列产品 | 91.2 | `temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95, "
+"max_tokens=131072` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"The following optimizations are already enabled in the A3 series reference\n"
+"configuration in [Section 5.3](#glm53-flash-5-3-a3). Use the same W8A8 weights\n"
+"and role-specific settings when reproducing the deployment."
+msgstr ""
+"以下优化已在[第 5.3 节](#glm53-flash-5-3-a3)的 Atlas A3系列产品参考配置中启用。复现部署时，请使用相同的 W8A8 "
+"权重和角色特定设置。"
+
+msgid ""
+"| FlashComm1 | Decode | `enable_flashcomm1: true` | Optimizes tensor-"
+"parallel communication. |"
+msgstr "| FlashComm1 | Decode | `enable_flashcomm1: true` | 优化张量并行通信。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Prefill context parallelism | Prefill | `--prefill-context-parallel-size "
+"8` | Each TP1 Prefill engine uses eight devices. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| Prefill 上下文并行 | Prefill | `--prefill-context-parallel-size 8` | 每个 TP1 "
+"Prefill 引擎使用八个设备。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Prefill MoE communication | Prefill | `enable_fused_mc2: 2`, `--enable-"
+"eplb` | Uses fused MoE communication and asynchronous EPLB with the `stair` "
+"policy and `hixl` communicator. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| Prefill MoE 通信 | Prefill | `enable_fused_mc2: 2`, `--enable-eplb` | 使用融合 "
+"MoE 通信和异步 EPLB，采用 `stair` 策略和 `hixl` 通信器。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| MTP | Prefill and Decode | `num_speculative_tokens: 3`, `--use-replayssm` "
+"| Uses ReplaySSM with draft graph execution on both roles; the Prefill "
+"target is eager. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| MTP | Prefill 和 Decode | `num_speculative_tokens: 3`, `--use-replayssm` | "
+"在两个角色上使用 ReplaySSM 和 draft 图执行；Prefill 目标为 eager 模式。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"The settings below refer to the [A3 series PD example](#glm53-flash-5-3-a3).\n"
+"Use the role-specific values in the 950DT products example when deploying on that hardware."
+msgstr ""
+"以下设置参考 [Atlas A3系列产品 PD 示例](#glm53-flash-5-3-a3)。在该硬件上部署时，请使用 Ascend "
+"950DT系列产品示例中的角色特定值。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Tune `--max-num-seqs` and `--max-num-batched-tokens` independently on each\n"
+"  role. The reference uses 32 sequences and 16384 batched tokens on Prefill,\n"
+"  and 40 sequences and 240 batched tokens on Decode. Measure time to first\n"
+"  token, time per output token, and throughput before changing these limits.\n"
+"- Set `--max-model-len` to the required context length and adjust\n"
+"  `--gpu-memory-utilization` to the available NPU memory. The reference uses\n"
+"  1048576 tokens and a utilization of 0.92 on both roles.\n"
+"- Decode enables `recompute_scheduler_enable: true` to allow recomputation\n"
+"  on Prefill when Decode KV cache is insufficient. Keep it disabled on Prefill.\n"
+"- For repeated prefixes, use the DDR KV Cache Pool configuration in\n"
+"  [Section 5.4](#54-prefill-decode-disaggregation-with-kv-cache-pool). Both\n"
+"  Prefill and Decode contribute `20GB` per worker. Confirm pool hits when\n"
+"  evaluating reuse benefits."
+msgstr ""
+"- 在每个角色上独立调整 `--max-num-seqs` 和 `--max-num-batched-tokens`。参考配置在 Prefill 上使用 32 个序列和 16384 个批处理 token，在 Decode 上使用 40 个序列和 240 个批处理 token。在更改这些限制之前，请测量首 token 时间、每输出 token 时间和吞吐量。\n"
+"- 将 `--max-model-len` 设置为所需的上下文长度，并根据可用的 NPU 内存调整 `--gpu-memory-utilization`。参考配置在两个角色上均使用 1048576 个 token 和 0.92 的利用率。\n"
+"- Decode 启用 `recompute_scheduler_enable: true`，以便在 Decode KV 缓存不足时允许在 Prefill 上重新计算。在 Prefill 上保持禁用。\n"
+"- 对于重复前缀，请使用[第 5.4 节](#54-prefill-decode-disaggregation-with-kv-cache-pool)中的 DDR KV Cache Pool 配置。Prefill 和 Decode 每个 worker 各贡献 `20GB`。在评估复用收益时，请确认缓存池命中情况。"
+
+msgid "### 9.3 Tool-Assisted Tuning with msmodeling"
+msgstr "### 9.3 使用 msmodeling 进行工具辅助调优"
+
+msgid ""
+"The msmodeling tool (MindStudio-Modeling) tunes serving and benchmark parameters\n"
+"using measured results and knowledge-base guidance. For the complete walkthrough,\n"
+"refer to [Optix-for-PD-disaggregation](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/msmodeling/blob/master/docs/en/quick_start/optix_agent_pd_disaggregation.md)."
+msgstr ""
+"msmodeling 工具（MindStudio-Modeling）利用实测结果和知识库指导来调优服务和基准测试参数。完整操作流程请参阅 [Optix-"
+"for-PD-"
+"disaggregation](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/msmodeling/blob/master/docs/en/quick_start/optix_agent_pd_disaggregation.md)。"

 msgid ""
-"- `--quantization ascend` loads the Ascend-compatible W8A8 checkpoint.\n"
-"    - `--tensor-parallel-size 8` and `--data-parallel-size 1` configure the A3 single-DP TP8 topology.\n"
-"    - `--max-model-len 131072` caps the maximum context length. Common values: `65536` (64K), `131072` (128K).\n"
-"    - `--enable-expert-parallel` enables expert parallelism for the MoE layers.\n"
-"    - `--enable-prefix-caching --mamba-cache-mode align` enables Prefix Caching with aligned GDN and PLE state checkpoints.\n"
-"    - The validated command does not set `--language-model-only`, so the vision encoder remains enabled and the service accepts both text and multimodal requests. For a text-only deployment, you may add `--language-model-only` to skip loading the vision encoder.\n"
-"    - `--enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml` enables automatic Function Calling with the Qwen3 XML parser.\n"
-"    - `--reasoning-parser qwen3` separates reasoning from the final answer in the OpenAI-compatible response.\n"
-"    - `--speculative-config` uses the model's MTP head to draft three tokens. `enforce_eager=true` keeps the MTP proposer in eager mode.\n"
-"    - `--compilation-config` enables `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` ACLGraph for decode.\n"
-"    - `fuse_norm_quant=false` selects the validated norm and quantization path for this W8A8 deployment."
+"Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (experimental) was first supported in `vllm-"
+"ascend:v0.26.0rc`. The examples use W4A8 checkpoints (W4A8-MXFP on 950DT "
+"products). For the best performance, it is recommended to use **vLLM-Ascend "
+"v0.32.0rc** (`releases/v0.32.0rc`)."
 msgstr ""
-"- `--quantization ascend` 加载昇腾兼容的 W8A8 检查点。\n"
-"    - `--tensor-parallel-size 8` 和 `--data-parallel-size 1` 配置 A3 单 DP TP8 拓扑。\n"
-"    - `--max-model-len 131072` 限制最大上下文长度。常用值：`65536`（64K）、`131072`（128K）。\n"
-"    - `--enable-expert-parallel` 为 MoE 层启用专家并行。\n"
-"    - `--enable-prefix-caching --mamba-cache-mode align` 启用前缀缓存，并对齐 GDN 和 PLE 状态检查点。\n"
-"    - 已验证的命令未设置 `--language-model-only`，因此视觉编码器保持启用，服务同时接受文本和多模态请求。如需纯文本部署，可添加 `--language-model-only` 以跳过加载视觉编码器。\n"
-"    - `--enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml` 使用 Qwen3 XML 解析器启用自动 Function Calling。\n"
-"    - `--reasoning-parser qwen3` 在 OpenAI 兼容响应中将推理内容与最终答案分离。\n"
-"    - `--speculative-config` 使用模型的 MTP 头草拟三个 token。`enforce_eager=true` 使 MTP 提议器保持 eager 模式。\n"
-"    - `--compilation-config` 为解码启用 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` ACLGraph。\n"
-"    - `fuse_norm_quant=false` 为此 W8A8 部署选择已验证的归一化和量化路径。"
+"Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（实验特性）首次在 `vllm-ascend:v0.26.0rc` 中支持。示例使用 W4A8 权重（在 "
+"Ascend 950DT系列产品上使用 W4A8-MXFP）。为获得最佳性能，推荐使用 **vLLM-Ascend "
+"v0.32.0rc**（`releases/v0.32.0rc`）。"

+msgstr "按照安装指南的说明，在服务 shell 中初始化 CANN 和 ATB 环境。对于多节点部署，请在每个节点上配置环境。"
+
+msgid "### 4.3 Docker for Three-Tier PD Pooling"
+msgstr "### 4.3 用于三级 PD 池化的 Docker"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use these containers for [MemCache three-tier PD pooling](#54-pd-separation-"
+"with-memcache-three-tier-kv-cache-pool). Other deployment modes use Section "
+"4.1. Container privileges follow the [MemCache Docker "
+"example](../../user_guide/feature_guide/kv_cache_pool_ascend_store.md#step-1-prerequisite-"
+"checks)."
+msgstr ""
+"这些容器用于 [MemCache 三级 PD 池化](#54-pd-separation-with-memcache-three-tier-kv-"
+"cache-pool)。其他部署模式请使用 4.1 节。容器权限配置请遵循 [MemCache Docker "
+"示例](../../user_guide/feature_guide/kv_cache_pool_ascend_store.md#step-1-prerequisite-"
+"checks)。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Prepare storage on the **host**, then create one container per host using "
+"the matching hardware tab. Start the services inside the containers as "
+"described in Section 5.4."
+msgstr "在**主机**上准备存储，然后使用对应的硬件选项卡为每台主机创建一个容器。按照 5.4 节的说明在容器内启动服务。"
+
+msgid ""
+"For A2, prepare a separate SSD and configuration directory on each host. Run"
+" Prefill, MetaService, and Proxy on the prefill host, and Decode on the "
+"decode host, using shared MetaService and ConfigStore endpoints."
+msgstr ""
+"对于 A2，请在每台主机上准备独立的 SSD 和配置目录。在 prefill 主机上运行 Prefill、MetaService 和 Proxy，在 "
+"decode 主机上运行 Decode，并使用共享的 MetaService 和 ConfigStore 端点。"
+
+msgid "!!! note \"A2 host HDK requirement\""
+msgstr "!!! note \"A2 主机 HDK 要求\""
+
+msgid ""
+"A2 three-tier pooling requires **HDK 25.5.1 or later on both hosts**. HDK is"
+" installed on the host, not in the Docker image. Run `npu-smi info` on each "
+"host to check the version; if it is older, follow the [HDK upgrade "
+"guide](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/latest/softwareinst/instg/instg_0029.html)"
+" and check again before starting the containers."
+msgstr ""
+"A2 三级池化要求**两台主机上的 HDK 均为 25.5.1 或更高版本**。HDK 安装在主机上，而非 Docker 镜像中。请在每台主机上运行 "
+"`npu-smi info` 检查版本；如果版本较低，请遵循 [HDK "
+"升级指南](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/CANNCommunityEdition/latest/softwareinst/instg/instg_0029.html)"
+" 升级，并在启动容器前再次检查。"
+
+msgid "**Prepare the SSD device on the host:**"
+msgstr "**在主机上准备 SSD 设备：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"Choose a dedicated device with no partitions, mount points, filesystem "
+"signatures, or data to retain. Do not use a system disk. If a suitable "
+"device is already available, skip the loop-file commands below."
+msgstr ""
+"请选择一块专用设备，其上没有分区、挂载点、文件系统签名或需要保留的数据。不要使用系统盘。如果已有合适的设备，可跳过下面的 loop 文件命令。"
+
+msgid ""
+"For a test without a dedicated disk, select a new backing-file path on an "
+"existing SSD filesystem. Set `LOOP_BACKING_SIZE` to the capacity planned for"
+" this deployment, including its unit. Its parent directory must exist and "
+"have sufficient free space:"
+msgstr ""
+"如果没有专用磁盘而需要进行测试，请在现有 SSD 文件系统上选择一个全新的后备文件路径。将 `LOOP_BACKING_SIZE` "
+"设置为此部署计划使用的容量（包含单位）。其父目录必须存在且有足够的可用空间："
+
+msgid ""
+"Set `SSD_DEVICE_PATH` to the device returned by `losetup`, not the backing-"
+"file path. For the A3 two-device example, prepare a second device with a "
+"different backing file before continuing. Skip loop-device creation when "
+"using dedicated disks."
+msgstr ""
+"将 `SSD_DEVICE_PATH` 设置为 `losetup` 返回的设备，而不是后备文件路径。对于 A3 "
+"双设备示例，请先使用不同的后备文件准备第二个设备，然后再继续。使用专用磁盘时可跳过 loop 设备的创建。"
+
+msgid ""
+"When reusing an existing pool, keep its devices and backing files; skip new-"
+"device creation and initialization."
+msgstr "复用现有池时，请保留其设备和后备文件；跳过新设备的创建和初始化。"
+
+msgid "**Prepare the personal configuration directory and device mapping:**"
+msgstr "**准备个人配置目录和设备映射：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"In the host terminal used for `docker run`, set `MEMCACHE_CONFIG_DIR` to "
+"your personal configuration directory and `SSD_DEVICE_PATH` to the dedicated"
+" or loop device:"
+msgstr ""
+"在用于 `docker run` 的主机终端中，将 `MEMCACHE_CONFIG_DIR` 设置为您的个人配置目录，将 "
+"`SSD_DEVICE_PATH` 设置为专用设备或 loop 设备："
+
+msgid ""
+"For a new pool, proceed only after confirming that each selected device has "
+"no filesystem signature or mount point; `blkid` normally prints nothing and "
+"returns a nonzero status for a blank device. The A2 and 950DT products "
+"commands below map one device; the A3 example maps two. Prepare all devices "
+"before creating the container, and separate their matching `ubsio.disk.path`"
+" entries with `:`."
+msgstr ""
+"对于新建的存储池，只有在确认每个所选设备都没有文件系统签名或挂载点后才能继续；对于空白设备，`blkid` 通常不输出任何内容并返回非零状态。下方 "
+"Atlas A2系列产品和 Ascend 950DT系列产品的命令各映射一个设备；Atlas "
+"A3系列产品的示例映射两个设备。请在创建容器前准备好所有设备，并用 `:` 分隔它们对应的 `ubsio.disk.path` 条目。"
+
+msgid ""
+"In Section 5.4, `MEMCACHE_FORCE_NEW_DISK` controls "
+"`ubsio.standalone.force_new_disk`. Setting it to `true` reinitializes cache "
+"storage at startup. Select its value for the target deployment and use only "
+"dedicated cache storage."
+msgstr ""
+"在第 5.4 节中，`MEMCACHE_FORCE_NEW_DISK` 控制 "
+"`ubsio.standalone.force_new_disk`。将其设置为 `true` "
+"会在启动时重新初始化缓存存储。请根据目标部署选择其取值，并且仅使用专用缓存存储。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Set `MEMCACHE_CONFIG_DIR` before starting Docker. `-e` passes its value into"
+" the container, and `-v` mounts the directory at the same path. Section 5.4 "
+"copies image templates into this directory and uses those personal files."
+msgstr ""
+"在启动 Docker 之前设置 `MEMCACHE_CONFIG_DIR`。`-e` 将其值传入容器，`-v` 将该目录挂载到相同路径。第 5.4 "
+"节会将镜像模板复制到该目录，并使用这些个人文件。"
+
+msgid ""
+"In Section 5.4, set `MEMCACHE_SSD_PATHS` to the device paths mapped by "
+"`--device`."
+msgstr "在第 5.4 节中，将 `MEMCACHE_SSD_PATHS` 设置为由 `--device` 映射的设备路径。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Verify that all host device and file paths exist before running Docker."
+msgstr "在运行 Docker 之前，请确认所有主机设备和文件路径均存在。"
+
+msgid "!!! note \"950DT products communication prerequisites\""
+msgstr "!!! note \"Ascend 950DT系列产品通信前提条件\""
+
+msgid ""
+"Prepare the communication environment following the [950DT container "
+"requirements](../features/pd_disaggregation_mooncake_multi_node.md#atlas-850850e950-superpod-950pr950dt-"
+"container-requirements) and [MemCache environment "
+"preparation](../../user_guide/feature_guide/kv_cache_pool_ascend_store.md#scenario-2-memcache-"
+"backend). Add communication-file mounts required by the selected runtime and"
+" transport; the container requirements describe when `/lib/route.conf` can "
+"be omitted."
+msgstr ""
+"请按照 [Ascend "
+"950DT系列产品容器要求](../features/pd_disaggregation_mooncake_multi_node.md#atlas-850850e950-superpod-950pr950dt-"
+"container-requirements) 和 [MemCache "
+"环境准备](../../user_guide/feature_guide/kv_cache_pool_ascend_store.md#scenario-2-memcache-"
+"backend) 准备通信环境。添加所选运行时和传输方式所需的通信文件挂载；容器要求中说明了何时可以省略 `/lib/route.conf`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The A3 example in Section 5.4 uses two SSD-backed devices. Set "
+"`SSD_DEVICE_PATH` to the first device and `SSD_DEVICE_PATH_2` to the second "
+"device prepared above; check both before creating the container. The example"
+" device names are `/dev/loop0` and `/dev/loop1`, but use the actual names "
+"returned on your host."
+msgstr ""
+"第 5.4 节中的 Atlas A3系列产品示例使用两个 SSD 后端设备。将 `SSD_DEVICE_PATH` 设置为第一个设备，将 "
+"`SSD_DEVICE_PATH_2` 设置为上面准备好的第二个设备；在创建容器前请检查这两个设备。示例设备名称为 `/dev/loop0` 和 "
+"`/dev/loop1`，但请使用您主机上实际返回的名称。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Keep the container running. Open additional service terminals from the host "
+"with:"
+msgstr "保持容器运行。在主机上使用以下命令打开额外的服务终端："
+
+msgid ""
+"Use the container name set by `NAME`. New shells inherit "
+"`MEMCACHE_CONFIG_DIR`; repeat the Section 5.4 library and service exports in"
+" each shell. Keep the directory path consistent with the container's "
+"environment and mount."
+msgstr ""
+"使用由 `NAME` 设置的容器名称。新 shell 会继承 `MEMCACHE_CONFIG_DIR`；请在每个 shell 中重复第 5.4 "
+"节的库和服务导出操作。请保持目录路径与容器的环境和挂载一致。"
+
+msgid ""
+"After entering the container, check that the model and storage dependencies "
+"are available:"
+msgstr "进入容器后，检查模型和存储依赖是否可用："
+
+msgid ""
+"Check MemCache dependency versions in Section 5.4. Budget pool DRAM and UBS "
+"IO memory separately from the container's `/dev/shm` limit (`--shm-size`)."
+msgstr ""
+"在第 5.4 节中检查 MemCache 依赖版本。请将存储池的 DRAM 和 UBS IO 内存与容器的 `/dev/shm` 限制（`--shm-"
+"size`）分开规划。"
+
+msgid "!!! note \"950 DT pooling runtime\""
+msgstr "!!! note \"Ascend 950DT系列产品池化运行时\""
+
+msgid ""
+"Use a runtime that supports Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and MemCache three-tier "
+"pooling. Initialize CANN/ATB as described in Section 4.1. If the image does "
+"not initialize its repository, custom operators, and model libraries "
+"automatically, apply the following in each service shell; use actual "
+"container paths, with library directories separated by `:`."
+msgstr ""
+"请使用支持 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 和 MemCache 三级池化的运行时。按照第 4.1 节所述初始化 "
+"CANN/ATB。如果镜像不会自动初始化其仓库、自定义算子和模型库，请在每个服务 shell 中执行以下操作；请使用实际的容器路径，并用 `:` "
+"分隔库目录。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use the active environment's Mooncake, Torch, and torch_npu library "
+"directories. MemCache/MemFabric library paths are set in Section 5.4."
+msgstr ""
+"请使用当前活动环境的 Mooncake、Torch 和 torch_npu 库目录。MemCache/MemFabric 库路径在第 5.4 节中设置。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Prefill and decode run in the same service. Select the hardware tab below."
+msgstr "Prefill 和 decode 在同一服务中运行。请选择下方的硬件标签页。"
+
+msgid "Before starting:"
+msgstr "启动之前："
+
+msgid ""
+"- Ensure the serving environment can access ModelScope to download the checkpoint.\n"
+"- Verify available NPU memory before changing context length, concurrency, or memory utilization."
+msgstr ""
+"- 确保服务环境可以访问 ModelScope 以下载检查点。\n"
+"- 在更改上下文长度、并发数或内存利用率之前，请确认可用的 NPU 内存。"
+
+msgid "**Common settings:**"
+msgstr "**通用设置：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"- All three examples enable Model Runner V2, async scheduling, expert parallelism, prefix caching, decode graph capture (`FULL_DECODE_ONLY`), and three-token MTP. MTP explicitly sets `enforce_eager=false` to allow graph execution; `true` forces eager execution for MTP.\n"
+"- `cpu_offload=true` places Engram embedding tables in host memory; `dp_shared_memory=false` disables sharing for DP1. Use a checkpoint with supported n-gram layers and sufficient host memory.\n"
+"- CPU binding, FlashComm1, shared expert DP, and shared expert overlap are enabled. Shared expert DP requires expert parallelism and TP > 1. `enable_fused_mc2=0` disables fused MC2; norm/quantization fusion is disabled.\n"
+"- `--mamba-cache-mode align` aligns GDN and PLE state checkpoints for prefix caching. Tool calling and reasoning parsing are covered in [Section 6](#6-functional-verification).\n"
+"- Multimodal requests require a vision encoder; add `--language-model-only` for text-only serving."
+msgstr ""
+"- 三个示例均启用了 Model Runner V2、异步调度、专家并行、前缀缓存、decode 图捕获（`FULL_DECODE_ONLY`）和三 token MTP。MTP 显式设置 `enforce_eager=false` 以允许图执行；设置为 `true` 会强制 MTP 使用 eager 执行。\n"
+"- `cpu_offload=true` 将 Engram 嵌入表放在主机内存中；`dp_shared_memory=false` 为 DP1 禁用共享。请使用具有受支持 n-gram 层且主机内存充足的检查点。\n"
+"- 已启用 CPU 绑定、FlashComm1、共享专家 DP 和共享专家重叠。共享专家 DP 需要专家并行且 TP > 1。`enable_fused_mc2=0` 禁用融合 MC2；norm/量化融合已禁用。\n"
+"- `--mamba-cache-mode align` 为前缀缓存对齐 GDN 和 PLE 状态检查点。工具调用和推理解析见[第 6 节](#6-functional-verification)。\n"
+"- 多模态请求需要视觉编码器；如需纯文本服务，请添加 `--language-model-only`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This W4A8 deployment uses TP8 × DP1, a maximum context length of 131072 "
+"tokens, and up to 8 active sequences."
+msgstr "此 W4A8 部署使用 TP8 × DP1，最大上下文长度为 131072 个 token，最多 8 个活动序列。"
+
+msgid "**Key parameters:**"
+msgstr "**关键参数：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"- TP8 × DP1 uses eight devices. NPU graph extension is enabled; static "
+"kernels and super kernels are disabled."
+msgstr "- TP8 × DP1 使用八个设备。已启用 NPU 图扩展；静态 kernel 和超级 kernel 已禁用。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- TP8 × DP1 uses eight devices. NPU graph extension and static kernels are "
+"enabled; super kernels are disabled."
+msgstr "- TP8 × DP1 使用八个设备。已启用 NPU 图扩展和静态 kernel；超级 kernel 已禁用。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This W4A8-MXFP deployment uses TP4 × DP1, a maximum context length of 141312"
+" tokens, and up to 32 active sequences."
+msgstr "此 W4A8-MXFP 部署使用 TP4 × DP1，最大上下文长度为 141312 个 token，最多 32 个活动序列。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- TP4 × DP1 uses devices 0–3 and a W4A8-MXFP checkpoint. NPU graph extension and static kernels are enabled; super kernels are disabled.\n"
+"    - Prefix caching automatically selects Mamba cache mode `align` from the default `none`; A2/A3 set `align` explicitly."
+msgstr ""
+"- TP4 × DP1 使用设备 0–3 和 W4A8-MXFP 检查点。已启用 NPU 图扩展和静态 kernel；超级 kernel 已禁用。\n"
+"    - 前缀缓存会自动从默认的 `none` 选择 Mamba 缓存模式 `align`；A2/A3 会显式设置 `align`。"
+
+msgid "**Service Verification:**"
+msgstr "**服务验证：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"Wait for model loading and graph capture to complete, then check the service"
+" from the serving host. Use port `8088` for A2 series and A3 series or "
+"`8087` for 950 DT:"
+msgstr ""
+"等待模型加载和图捕获完成，然后从服务主机检查服务。Atlas A2系列产品和 Atlas A3系列产品使用端口 `8088`，Ascend "
+"950DT系列产品使用端口 `8087`："
+
+msgid ""
+"The response should list the configured model name. After startup, use "
+"[Section 6](#6-functional-verification) to verify generation."
+msgstr "响应中应列出已配置的模型名称。启动后，请使用[第 6 节](#6-functional-verification)验证生成。"
+
+msgid "### 5.2 Basic PD Separation Deployment"
+msgstr "### 5.2 基础 PD 分离部署"
 
 msgid ""
-"Audited Qwen3.8 Flash Next Model Runner V2 consumers automatically use optimistic\n"
-"CPU length bounds while exact execution lengths remain on device. This capability\n"
-"is enabled by default for supported consumers and requires no configuration switch.\n"
-"The resolved target architecture must be `Qwen4ExpForCausalLM` or\n"
-"`Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration`. Other models retain their existing behavior."
+"Prepare the runtime from Section 4 and follow the [Mooncake installation "
+"guide](../features/pd_disaggregation_mooncake_single_node.md#install-"
+"mooncake). Run P/D commands in separate terminals, then start the proxy "
+"after their APIs are ready."
 msgstr ""
-"经过审计的 Qwen3.8 Flash Next Model Runner V2 消费者会自动使用乐观的\n"
-"CPU 长度边界，而精确的执行长度仍保留在设备上。对于受支持的消费者，此能力\n"
-"默认启用，无需配置开关。\n"
-"解析后的目标架构必须为 `Qwen4ExpForCausalLM` 或\n"
-"`Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration`。其他模型保持其现有行为。"
+"按照第 4 节准备运行时，并遵循 [Mooncake "
+"安装指南](../features/pd_disaggregation_mooncake_single_node.md#install-"
+"mooncake)。在不同终端中分别运行 P/D 命令，待其 API 就绪后再启动代理。"
 
 msgid ""
-"The model checks the initialized target and MTP draft attention consumers once\n"
-"after KV initialization. A supported model skips both the corrected-count D2H\n"
-"copy and its CPU synchronization, using the runner's existing paired exemption.\n"
-"Exact positions, accepted counts, KV slots and recurrent state still use device\n"
-"state. Existing connector loads, waits, acknowledgements and errors are unchanged."
+"Set the IP and interface variables in each terminal; `nic_name` must own "
+"`local_ip`. The communication exports use these values, and "
+"`no_proxy`/`NO_PROXY` bypass HTTP proxies for the service addresses."
 msgstr ""
-"模型在 KV 初始化后会对已初始化的目标和 MTP 草稿注意力消费者检查一次。\n"
-"受支持的模型会同时跳过修正计数 D2H 拷贝及其 CPU 同步，使用 runner 现有的配对豁免。\n"
-"精确位置、接受计数、KV 槽位和循环状态仍使用设备\n"
-"状态。现有的连接器加载、等待、确认和错误均保持不变。"
+"在每个终端中设置 IP 和网卡变量；`nic_name` 必须拥有 "
+"`local_ip`。通信相关的环境变量导出使用这些值，`no_proxy`/`NO_PROXY` 用于让服务地址绕过 HTTP 代理。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This W4A8 deployment uses two eight-device A2 series hosts. Prefill runs on "
+"`PREFILL_HOST` and Decode runs on `DECODE_HOST`, each using devices 0–7. "
+"Prefill uses TP4 × PP2 × DP1, and Decode uses TP2 × DP4, matching the A3 "
+"model topology. Both roles load the same checkpoint; the proxy routes "
+"requests through one API endpoint per role (1P1D)."
+msgstr ""
+"此 W4A8 部署使用两台八卡 Atlas A2系列产品主机。Prefill 运行在 `PREFILL_HOST` 上，Decode 运行在 "
+"`DECODE_HOST` 上，各自使用设备 0–7。Prefill 使用 TP4 × PP2 × DP1，Decode 使用 TP2 × DP4，与 "
+"A3 模型拓扑保持一致。两个角色加载相同的检查点；代理通过每个角色一个 API 端点（1P1D）路由请求。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Expose the required devices, mount `/etc/hccn.conf`, and use `--shm-size=128g`. Provide sufficient host memory for Engram CPU offload and DP shared memory.\n"
+"    - Run P and D in separate terminals. After both APIs are ready, start the proxy on the prefill host from the vLLM-Ascend repository root."
+msgstr ""
+"- 暴露所需设备，挂载 `/etc/hccn.conf`，并使用 `--shm-size=128g`。为 Engram CPU 卸载和 DP 共享内存提供充足的主机内存。\n"
+"    - 在不同终端中分别运行 P 和 D。待两个 API 就绪后，在 prefill 主机上从 vLLM-Ascend 仓库根目录启动代理。"
+
+msgid "**Prefill:**"
+msgstr "**Prefill：**"
+
+msgid "**Decode:**"
+msgstr "**Decode：**"
+
+msgid "**Proxy:**"
+msgstr "**代理：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"Check the startup logs for TP4 × PP2 × DP1 on Prefill and TP2 × DP4 with "
+"`enable_static_kernel=true` on Decode. From the prefill host, check that "
+"both APIs list `qwen38-flash-next-a2-pd`:"
+msgstr ""
+"检查启动日志，确认 Prefill 使用 TP4 × PP2 × DP1，Decode 使用 TP2 × DP4 且 "
+"`enable_static_kernel=true`。在 prefill 主机上，检查两个 API 是否都列出 `qwen38-flash-"
+"next-a2-pd`："
+
+msgid ""
+"After both checks succeed, start Proxy in a separate terminal and verify the"
+" complete PD path:"
+msgstr "两项检查均成功后，在单独终端中启动代理，并验证完整的 PD 路径："
+
+msgid ""
+"Inspect the prefill, decode, and proxy terminal output if the request fails."
+msgstr "如果请求失败，请检查 prefill、decode 和代理终端的输出。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This W4A8 PD deployment uses one 16-device A3 series host specified by "
+"`local_ip`. Prefill uses TP4 × PP2 × DP1 on devices 0–7; Decode uses TP2 × "
+"DP4 on devices 8–15. Both roles load the same checkpoint. The proxy routes "
+"requests through one Prefill API endpoint and one Decode API endpoint "
+"(1P1D); Decode runs four DP replicas behind its endpoint."
+msgstr ""
+"此 W4A8 PD 部署使用一台由 `local_ip` 指定的 16 卡 Atlas A3系列产品主机。Prefill 在设备 0–7 上使用 TP4"
+" × PP2 × DP1；Decode 在设备 8–15 上使用 TP2 × DP4。两个角色加载相同的检查点。代理通过一个 Prefill API "

+msgid ""

+msgid ""
+"This W4A8-MXFP deployment uses eight devices on one 950DT products host. "
+"Prefill and decode each use TP2 × DP2 without pipeline parallelism, with one"

+"此 W4A8-MXFP 部署在一台 Ascend 950DT系列产品主机上使用八张设备。Prefill 和 decode 各自使用 TP2 × "
+"DP2，不使用流水线并行，每个角色一条命令，在单个 API 端点后管理两个 DP 副本。MooncakeConnectorV2 在两个角色之间传输 KV"
+" 缓存。"
+

 msgid ""

 msgstr ""

+msgid ""
+"These commands retain `VLLM_VERSION=0.32.0` from the validated runtime. This"
+" variable overrides vLLM version detection; it does not install or upgrade "
+"vLLM. Initialize CANN/ATB as described in Section 4.1."
+msgstr ""
+"这些命令保留了已验证运行时中的 `VLLM_VERSION=0.32.0`。该变量会覆盖 vLLM 版本检测；它不会安装或升级 vLLM。按第 4.1 "
+"节所述初始化 CANN/ATB。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Run the following command from the vLLM-Ascend repository root after both "
+"model APIs are ready:"
+msgstr "待两个模型 API 就绪后，从 vLLM-Ascend 仓库根目录运行以下命令："
+
+msgid ""
+"Check the startup logs for TP2 × DP2 on each role, `cudagraph_mode=NONE` on "
+"Prefill, and `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` with static kernels on Decode. Check that "
+"both APIs list `qwen38-flash-next-950-dt-pd` before starting the proxy:"
+msgstr ""
+"检查启动日志，确认每个角色使用 TP2 × DP2，Prefill 使用 `cudagraph_mode=NONE`，Decode 使用 "
+"`FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 和静态内核。在启动代理前，检查两个 API 是否都列出 `qwen38-flash-next-950-dt-"
+"pd`："
+
+msgid "Once the proxy is listening, verify the complete PD path:"
+msgstr "代理开始监听后，验证完整的 PD 路径："
+
+msgid "**A2/A3 key parameters:**"
+msgstr "**A2/A3 关键参数：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Prefill uses TP4 × PP2 × DP1 in eager mode, with `enable_prefill_mc2=true` and fused MC2 disabled. Check MC2 token limits before increasing the batch budget.\n"
+"- Decode uses TP2 × DP4, `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`, NPU graph extension, static kernels, and recompute scheduling; super kernels are disabled.\n"
+"- Both roles use three MTP draft tokens, with `enforce_eager=true` on P and `false` on D. Batch tokens are 8192; P/D HCCL buffers are 8192/512.\n"
+"- Engram CPU offload requires supported n-gram layers and sufficient host memory. P uses `dp_shared_memory=false`; D uses `true`. Shared-memory DP replicas must share a host and shared-memory namespace; elastic EP is unsupported.\n"
+"- Both roles set prefix caching, Mamba cache mode `align`, and Mamba state dtype `bfloat16`. Keep Mooncake TP/PP/DP declarations consistent with the model commands; clear `VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION` to use the default partition.\n"
+"- `enable_fused_mc2=0` is compatible with shared expert overlap; D uses the runtime default of zero. For tool calling and reasoning parsing, add `--enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --reasoning-parser qwen3` to both roles and verify requests through the proxy."
+msgstr ""
+"- Prefill 在 eager 模式下使用 TP4 × PP2 × DP1，并设置 `enable_prefill_mc2=true` 且禁用融合 MC2。在提高批处理预算前，请检查 MC2 token 限制。\n"
+"- Decode 使用 TP2 × DP4、`FULL_DECODE_ONLY`、NPU 图扩展、静态内核和重计算调度；超级内核已禁用。\n"
+"- 两个角色均使用三个 MTP 草稿 token，P 上 `enforce_eager=true`，D 上为 `false`。批处理 token 数为 8192；P/D HCCL 缓冲区为 8192/512。\n"
+"- Engram CPU 卸载需要受支持的 n-gram 层和充足的主机内存。P 使用 `dp_shared_memory=false`；D 使用 `true`。共享内存 DP 副本必须共享同一主机和共享内存命名空间；不支持弹性 EP。\n"
+"- 两个角色均设置前缀缓存、Mamba 缓存模式 `align` 和 Mamba 状态 dtype `bfloat16`。保持 Mooncake TP/PP/DP 声明与模型命令一致；清除 `VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION` 以使用默认分区。\n"
+"- `enable_fused_mc2=0` 与共享专家重叠兼容；D 使用运行时默认值零。对于工具调用和推理解析，请为两个角色添加 `--enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --reasoning-parser qwen3`，并通过代理验证请求。"
+
+msgid "**950DT products key parameters:**"
+msgstr "**Ascend 950DT系列产品关键参数：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Each command starts TP2 × DP2 on four devices. `--api-server-count 1` exposes one API endpoint per role; use distinct DP RPC ports for Prefill and Decode.\n"
+"- Model Runner V2, async scheduling, and expert parallelism are enabled; EPLB is not enabled.\n"
+"- Engram uses CPU offload and DP shared memory. DP replicas must share the same host and shared-memory namespace; elastic EP is not enabled.\n"
+"- Prefill enables prefix caching, which automatically selects Mamba cache mode `align` from the default `none`, and uses `cudagraph_mode=NONE`; static kernels are disabled. Its validated MTP configuration leaves `enforce_eager` unset, inheriting the model setting; graph capture remains disabled by `cudagraph_mode=NONE`.\n"
+"- Decode enables prefix caching, `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`, static kernels, and recompute scheduling; MTP sets `enforce_eager=false` to allow graph execution.\n"
+"- Both roles enable CPU binding, shared expert DP, FlashComm1, shared expert multistream overlap, and NPU graph extension. Fused MC2, norm/quantization fusion, and super kernels are disabled.\n"
+"- Both roles use three MTP draft tokens and `VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=4800` for engine startup; model execution uses `VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3000`.\n"
+"- Both roles use `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=8192` and `ASCEND_BUFFER_POOL=0:0`. The validated configuration separates Prefill and Decode HCCL base ports (62000/63000) and NPU socket ranges (61400–61499/61500–61599).\n"
+"- Keep Mooncake DP2/TP2 declarations consistent with the services. The proxy connects to Prefill on port 8088 and Decode on port 8092. Keep the configured KV base ports at 30000 and 30100; the connector applies rank offsets internally.\n"
+"- For Function Calling and reasoning parsing, add `--enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --reasoning-parser qwen3` to both model commands and verify proxy forwarding. Validate multimodal input and thinking control through the proxy with the selected checkpoint."
+msgstr ""
+"- 每条命令在四个设备上启动 TP2 × DP2。`--api-server-count 1` 为每个角色暴露一个 API 端点；Prefill 和 Decode 使用不同的 DP RPC 端口。\n"
+"- 启用了 Model Runner V2、异步调度和专家并行；未启用 EPLB。\n"
+"- Engram 使用 CPU 卸载和 DP 共享内存。DP 副本必须共享同一主机和共享内存命名空间；未启用弹性 EP。\n"
+"- Prefill 启用前缀缓存，该功能会自动将 Mamba 缓存模式从默认的 `none` 切换为 `align`，并使用 `cudagraph_mode=NONE`；静态 kernel 被禁用。其经验证的 MTP 配置未设置 `enforce_eager`，继承模型设置；图捕获仍由 `cudagraph_mode=NONE` 禁用。\n"
+"- Decode 启用前缀缓存、`FULL_DECODE_ONLY`、静态 kernel 和重计算调度；MTP 设置 `enforce_eager=false` 以允许图执行。\n"
+"- 两个角色均启用 CPU 绑定、共享专家 DP、FlashComm1、共享专家多流重叠和 NPU 图扩展。融合 MC2、归一化/量化融合和超级 kernel 被禁用。\n"
+"- 两个角色均使用三个 MTP 草稿 token 和 `VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=4800` 用于引擎启动；模型执行使用 `VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3000`。\n"
+"- 两个角色均使用 `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=8192` 和 `ASCEND_BUFFER_POOL=0:0`。经验证的配置将 Prefill 和 Decode 的 HCCL 基础端口（62000/63000）和 NPU socket 范围（61400–61499/61500–61599）分开。\n"
+"- 保持 Mooncake DP2/TP2 声明与服务一致。代理连接到 Prefill 的 8088 端口和 Decode 的 8092 端口。保持配置的 KV 基础端口为 30000 和 30100；连接器在内部应用 rank 偏移。\n"
+"- 对于 Function Calling 和推理解析，在两个模型命令中添加 `--enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --reasoning-parser qwen3`，并验证代理转发。使用所选 checkpoint 通过代理验证多模态输入和思考控制。"
+
+msgid "### 5.3 Image-and-Text 10K PD Separation Deployment"
+msgstr "### 5.3 图文 10K PD 分离部署"
+
+msgid ""
+"This case uses the same eight-device 950DT products host as the basic PD "
+"example in [Section 5.2](#52-basic-pd-separation-deployment). For image-and-"
+"text 10K validation, prefill uses TP2 × PP2 × DP1 with a `25,23` layer "
+"partition, and decode uses TP2 × DP2 behind one API endpoint. Both roles use"
+" 8192 batch tokens and `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=512`. Both roles enable prefix "
+"caching; decode also enables static kernels."
+msgstr ""
+"本案例使用与 [5.2 节](#52-basic-pd-separation-deployment)中基础 PD 示例相同的八设备 Ascend "
+"950DT系列产品主机。对于图文 10K 验证，prefill 使用 TP2 × PP2 × DP1，层划分为 `25,23`，decode 使用 "
+"TP2 × DP2，位于一个 API 端点之后。两个角色均使用 8192 批处理 token 和 "
+"`HCCL_BUFFSIZE=512`。两个角色均启用前缀缓存；decode 还启用静态 kernel。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The 10K target is the processed input length, including text and image "
+"tokens. Both roles retain `--max-model-len 143360`; keep the input plus "
+"requested output within this limit. Use the W4A8-MXFP checkpoint from "
+"[Section 3.1](#31-model-weight) with its vision encoder and image processor."
+msgstr ""
+"10K 目标是指处理后的输入长度，包括文本和图像 token。两个角色均保留 `--max-model-len "
+"143360`；请确保输入加上请求的输出在此限制之内。使用 [3.1 节](#31-model-weight)中的 W4A8-MXFP "
+"checkpoint 及其视觉编码器和图像处理器。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Initialize the environment as described in [Section 4](#4-installation) and "
+"run Prefill and Decode in separate terminals. Both roles load `Eco-"
+"Tech/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-w4a8-mxfp` from ModelScope."
+msgstr ""
+"按照 [4 节](#4-installation)所述初始化环境，并在单独的终端中运行 Prefill 和 Decode。两个角色均从 "
+"ModelScope 加载 `Eco-Tech/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-w4a8-mxfp`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"After both model APIs are ready, run the proxy from the vLLM-Ascend "
+"repository root:"
+msgstr "两个模型 API 就绪后，从 vLLM-Ascend 仓库根目录运行代理："
+
+msgid ""
+"Check P TP2/PP2/DP1, D TP2/DP2 with static kernels, and "
+"`max_model_len=143360` in the startup logs. Send a 10K sample through the "
+"proxy, replacing `<IMAGE_URL>` and `<TEXT_PROMPT>` with an accessible image "
+"and its text:"
+msgstr ""
+"在启动日志中检查 P 的 TP2/PP2/DP1、D 的 TP2/DP2（含静态 kernel）以及 "
+"`max_model_len=143360`。通过代理发送一个 10K 样本，将 `<IMAGE_URL>` 和 `<TEXT_PROMPT>` "
+"替换为可访问的图像及其文本："
+
+msgid ""
+"Expect HTTP 200 and an answer addressing the image and text. Check "
+"`usage.prompt_tokens` against the 10K target and confirm there are no image-"
+"processing, KV-transfer, or out-of-memory errors."
+msgstr ""
+"预期返回 HTTP 200 以及针对图像和文本的回答。对照 10K 目标检查 `usage.prompt_tokens`，并确认没有图像处理、KV "
+"传输或内存不足错误。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Prefill partitions the layers across two pipeline stages with `VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION=25,23`. Keep `pp_size=2` and `pp_layer_partition=\"25,23\"` in both Mooncake configurations consistent with this partition.\n"
+"    - Decode uses TP2 × DP2 behind one API endpoint on port `8248`; the proxy routes to that endpoint rather than separate DP-rank APIs.\n"
+"    - Both roles enable prefix caching. Prefill disables graph capture and sets MTP `enforce_eager=true`. Decode uses `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`, sets MTP `enforce_eager=false`, enables static kernels, and disables super kernels.\n"
+"    - Both roles enable Engram CPU offload with `dp_shared_memory=false`, use `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=512`, and set `VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=4800` to allow sufficient engine initialization time. Provide sufficient host memory for the checkpoint and the decode DP replicas.\n"
+"    - `VLLM_ASCEND_PLE_BACKEND` only applies to runtimes that implement it; an unknown-variable warning means it has no effect."
+msgstr ""
+"- Prefill 通过 `VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION=25,23` 将层划分到两个流水线阶段。在两个 Mooncake 配置中保持 `pp_size=2` 和 `pp_layer_partition=\"25,23\"` 与此划分一致。\n"
+"    - Decode 使用 TP2 × DP2，位于端口 `8248` 上的一个 API 端点之后；代理路由到该端点，而不是单独的 DP rank API。\n"
+"    - 两个角色均启用前缀缓存。Prefill 禁用图捕获并设置 MTP `enforce_eager=true`。Decode 使用 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`，设置 MTP `enforce_eager=false`，启用静态 kernel，并禁用超级 kernel。\n"
+"    - 两个角色均启用 Engram CPU 卸载并设置 `dp_shared_memory=false`，使用 `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=512`，并设置 `VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=4800` 以留出足够的引擎初始化时间。为 checkpoint 和 decode DP 副本提供足够的主机内存。\n"
+"    - `VLLM_ASCEND_PLE_BACKEND` 仅适用于实现了它的运行时；未知变量警告意味着它不生效。"
+
+msgid "### 5.4 PD Separation with MemCache Three-Tier KV Cache Pool"
+msgstr "### 5.4 使用 MemCache 三级 KV 缓存池的 PD 分离"
+
+msgid ""
+"`MultiConnector` combines Mooncake P-to-D transport with MemCache-backed KV "
+"caching in HBM, DRAM, and SSD. Each hardware tab contains its complete "
+"pooling Prefill and Decode commands. A2/A3 retain the model settings from "
+"[Section 5.2](#52-basic-pd-separation-deployment) and add the matching "
+"MemCache environment and connector configuration. This section does not "
+"cover colocated deployment or the image-and-text 10K case."
+msgstr ""
+"`MultiConnector` 将 Mooncake P 到 D 传输与基于 MemCache 的 HBM、DRAM 和 SSD KV "
+"缓存相结合。每个硬件标签页包含其完整的池化 Prefill 和 Decode 命令。A2/A3 保留 [5.2 节](#52-basic-pd-"
+"separation-deployment)中的模型设置，并添加匹配的 MemCache 环境和连接器配置。本节不涵盖共置部署或图文 10K 案例。"
+
+msgid "**Before starting:**"
+msgstr "**开始之前：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"Prepare the container, SSD mapping, configuration directory, and A2 HDK "
+"requirement in [Section 4.3](#43-docker-for-three-tier-pd-pooling). Run the "

+"guide](../../user_guide/feature_guide/kv_cache_pool_ascend_store.md#scenario-2-memcache-"
+"backend) for runtime dependencies."
+msgstr ""
+"在 [4.3 节](#43-docker-for-three-tier-pd-pooling)中准备容器、SSD 映射、配置目录和 A2 HDK "
+"要求。在容器内运行以下内容。A3 HCCS 还需要灵衢计算网络 1.5 或更高版本；运行时依赖请参阅 [MemCache "
+"后端指南](../../user_guide/feature_guide/kv_cache_pool_ascend_store.md#scenario-2-memcache-"
+"backend)。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Both packages must be at least version 1.3.0. If missing, install compatible"
+" versions and repeat the import check in Section 4.3:"
+msgstr "两个软件包版本必须至少为 1.3.0。如果缺失，请安装兼容版本并重复 4.3 节中的导入检查："
+
+msgid ""
+"Use the package `Location` reported above to set the library directories. "
+"Run these exports in every service terminal, preserving the initialized "
+"model runtime's library paths:"
+msgstr "使用上面报告的软件包 `Location` 设置库目录。在每个服务终端中运行这些导出命令，保留已初始化的模型运行时的库路径："
+
+msgid ""
+"`MEMCACHE_LIB_DIR` and `MEMFABRIC_LIB_DIR` are the respective package "
+"`Location` plus `/memcache_hybrid/lib` and `/memfabric_hybrid/lib`. Set the "
+"template directory in the configuration-editing terminal:"
+msgstr ""
+"`MEMCACHE_LIB_DIR` 和 `MEMFABRIC_LIB_DIR` 分别为对应软件包的 `Location` 加上 "
+"`/memcache_hybrid/lib` 和 `/memfabric_hybrid/lib`。在用于编辑配置的终端中设置模板目录："
+
+msgid ""
+"Use the templates shipped inside the selected image: "
+"`/usr/local/python3.11.10/lib/python3.11/site-"
+"packages/memcache_hybrid/config/` is an example, and the actual path varies "
+"with the Python version and installation location. Set "
+"`MEMCACHE_TEMPLATE_DIR` to that directory and copy its files into your "
+"personal mounted `MEMCACHE_CONFIG_DIR`. Edit only the keys listed below in "
+"those copies, preserving the other template entries; `cp -n` leaves existing"
+" personal files unchanged. In the INI examples, replace `<MEMCACHE_...>` "
+"with the actual value selected in the matching hardware tab; configuration "
+"files do not expand shell variables."
+msgstr ""
+"使用所选镜像内置的模板：`/usr/local/python3.11.10/lib/python3.11/site-"
+"packages/memcache_hybrid/config/` 仅为示例，实际路径随 Python 版本和安装位置而变化。将 "
+"`MEMCACHE_TEMPLATE_DIR` 设置为该目录，并将其中的文件复制到个人挂载的 `MEMCACHE_CONFIG_DIR` "
+"中。在这些副本中仅编辑下面列出的键，保留其他模板条目；`cp -n` 不会改动已存在的个人文件。在 INI 示例中，将 `<MEMCACHE_...>`"
+" 替换为在对应硬件标签页中选择的实际值；配置文件不会展开 shell 变量。"
+
+msgid "**Choose a new or existing pool before editing configuration:**"
+msgstr "**在编辑配置之前，选择新建或已有资源池：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"- **New pool:** follow **Prepare a new pool** in the matching hardware tab, using only the devices mapped in Section 4.3. Choose all endpoint and resource values before editing the INI copies.\n"
+"- **Existing pool:** skip the new-pool exports, template copying, INI edits, and MetaService startup below. Use the existing pool's MetaService/ConfigStore endpoints and approved LocalService files in `MEMCACHE_CONFIG_DIR` (A2/A3: `mmc-local.conf`; 950DT products: `mmc-local-p.conf` and `mmc-local-d.conf`). Preserve its storage initialization policy; do not apply the new-pool `force_new_disk=true` example. Check the existing service's actual endpoints, then continue with the matching service environment and P/D commands."
+msgstr ""
+"- **新建资源池：** 按照对应硬件标签页中的 **准备新资源池** 操作，仅使用第 4.3 节中映射的设备。在编辑 INI 副本之前，确定所有端点和资源值。\n"
+"- **已有资源池：** 跳过下面的新资源池导出、模板复制、INI 编辑和 MetaService 启动步骤。使用已有资源池的 MetaService/ConfigStore 端点以及 `MEMCACHE_CONFIG_DIR` 中已批准的 LocalService 文件（A2/A3：`mmc-local.conf`；Ascend 950DT系列产品：`mmc-local-p.conf` 和 `mmc-local-d.conf`）。保留其存储初始化策略；不要应用新资源池的 `force_new_disk=true` 示例。检查已有服务的实际端点，然后继续执行对应的服务环境和 P/D 命令。"
+
+msgid ""
+"`dram.size` and `ubsio.mem.size_in_gb` apply per DRAM-enabled LocalService; "
+"budget their total alongside Engram, vLLM, and operating-system memory. "
+"`world_size` is pool capacity; `device_count` counts the host's DRAM-enabled"
+" LocalServices, not SSDs. LocalServices run inside P/D workers; the "
+"`ubsio.standalone.*` keys do not require a separate process."
+msgstr ""
+"`dram.size` 和 `ubsio.mem.size_in_gb` 按每个启用 DRAM 的 LocalService 计算；需将其总量与 "
+"Engram、vLLM 及操作系统内存一并纳入预算。`world_size` 是资源池容量；`device_count` 统计主机上启用 DRAM 的 "
+"LocalService 数量，而非 SSD 数量。LocalService 运行在 P/D worker "
+"内部；`ubsio.standalone.*` 键不需要单独的进程。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Keep the A2 model configuration from Section 5.2: TP4 × PP2 × DP1 for "
+"Prefill and TP2 × DP4 for Decode, on separate eight-device hosts."
+msgstr ""
+"沿用第 5.2 节中的 A2 模型配置：Prefill 使用 TP4 × PP2 × DP1，Decode 使用 TP2 × "
+"DP4，分别运行在独立的八设备主机上。"
+
+msgid "**Prepare a new pool:**"
+msgstr "**准备新资源池：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"Prepare LocalService files on both hosts and MetaService only on the prefill"
+" host. Set the same reachable MetaService/ConfigStore endpoints and pool "
+"`world_size` on both hosts; choose storage values for each host separately."
+msgstr ""
+"在两台主机上准备 LocalService 文件，仅在 prefill 主机上准备 MetaService。在两台主机上设置相同的可达 "
+"MetaService/ConfigStore 端点和资源池 `world_size`；分别为每台主机选择存储值。"
+
+msgid "On the prefill host only, prepare MetaService:"
+msgstr "仅在 prefill 主机上准备 MetaService："
+
+msgid ""
+"In the copied `${MEMCACHE_CONFIG_DIR}/mmc-meta.conf`, edit the following "
+"keys:"
+msgstr "在复制得到的 `${MEMCACHE_CONFIG_DIR}/mmc-meta.conf` 中，编辑以下键："
+
+msgid ""
+"Set each host's storage values from its deployment configuration and memory "
+"budget. Use the device paths mapped in Section 4.3, separated by `:` for "
+"multiple devices:"
+msgstr "根据各主机的部署配置和内存预算设置其存储值。使用第 4.3 节中映射的设备路径，多个设备之间用 `:` 分隔："
+
+msgid ""
+"In the copied `${MEMCACHE_CONFIG_DIR}/mmc-local.conf`, edit the following "
+"keys:"
+msgstr "在复制得到的 `${MEMCACHE_CONFIG_DIR}/mmc-local.conf` 中，编辑以下键："
+
+msgid "**Start MetaService:**"
+msgstr "**启动 MetaService：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"Start MetaService on the prefill host with the library exports above, unless"
+" the pool is already running:"
+msgstr "除非资源池已在运行，否则在 prefill 主机上使用上述库导出启动 MetaService："
+
+msgid ""
+"After its configured ports are listening (`ss -lntp`), initialize the model "
+"runtime from Section 4 and run the complete Prefill and Decode commands "
+"below in separate terminals. Set the library directories in each terminal as"
+" described above; `MEMCACHE_CONFIG_DIR` is the mounted personal "
+"configuration directory from Section 4.3."
+msgstr ""
+"在其配置的端口开始监听后（`ss -lntp`），按照第 4 节初始化模型运行时，并在单独的终端中运行下面完整的 Prefill 和 Decode "
+"命令。按上述说明在每个终端中设置库目录；`MEMCACHE_CONFIG_DIR` 是第 4.3 节中挂载的个人配置目录。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Complete the matching Section 5.2 API checks and start its Proxy, then "
+"perform the cache-reuse checks below."
+msgstr "完成对应的第 5.2 节 API 检查并启动其 Proxy，然后执行下面的缓存复用检查。"
+
+msgid "Keep the A3 model configuration from Section 5.2."
+msgstr "沿用第 5.2 节中的 A3 模型配置。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The following values come from the single-host A3 configuration: MetaService"
+" and P/D share the host network, with 16 DRAM-enabled LocalServices and two "
+"SSD-backed devices already mapped in Section 4.3. Select these values before"
+" editing either INI file below. For an existing pool, skip this preparation "
+"block as described above."
+msgstr ""
+"以下值来自单主机 A3 配置：MetaService 与 P/D 共享主机网络，包含 16 个启用 DRAM 的 LocalService，以及第 "
+"4.3 节中已映射的两个 SSD 设备。在编辑下面任一 INI 文件之前，先选定这些值。对于已有资源池，按上述说明跳过此准备步骤。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Replace `/dev/loop0:/dev/loop1` with the two device paths already mapped in "
+"Section 4.3. These new-pool values allocate `10GB` of DRAM and `10` GB for "
+"UBS IO per LocalService; `force_new_disk=true` reinitializes SSD cache "
