+msgstr ""
+"将 `/dev/loop0:/dev/loop1` 替换为第 4.3 节中已映射的两个设备路径。这些新资源池值为每个 LocalService 分配 "
+"`10GB` 的 DRAM 和 `10` GB 的 UBS IO；`force_new_disk=true` 会在启动时重新初始化 SSD 缓存存储。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Fill both INI files with the selected values; running `export` later does "
+"not update either file."
+msgstr "用选定的值填写两个 INI 文件；之后运行 `export` 不会更新这两个文件。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Start MetaService in the serving container with the library exports above, "
+"unless the pool is already running:"
+msgstr "除非资源池已在运行，否则在服务容器中使用上述库导出启动 MetaService："
+
+msgid ""
+"This single-host example uses TP2 × DP2 per role, with Prefill on devices "
+"0–3 and Decode on devices 4–7. Use the prepared runtime from Section 4.3 and"
+" the same W4A8-MXFP checkpoint for both roles."
+msgstr ""
+"此单主机示例中每个角色使用 TP2 × DP2，Prefill 运行在设备 0–3 上，Decode 运行在设备 4–7 上。使用第 4.3 "
+"节中准备好的运行时，并为两个角色使用相同的 W4A8-MXFP 检查点。"
+
+msgid ""
+"For a new pool, use the following values from the supplied 102-server "
+"configuration. Its MetaService and ConfigStore use `172.27.24.102`, and its "
+"dedicated 500 GiB SSD-backed device is `/dev/loop0`. Replace the address and"
+" device for the target deployment, keeping the device consistent with "
+"Section 4.3. For an existing pool, skip this preparation block and continue "
+"at **Set the service environment** with the existing configuration files."
+msgstr ""
+"对于新资源池，使用所提供的 102 服务器配置中的以下值。其 MetaService 和 ConfigStore 使用 "
+"`172.27.24.102`，其专用的 500 GiB SSD 设备为 `/dev/loop0`。请根据目标部署替换地址和设备，并确保设备与第 4.3"
+" 节一致。对于已有资源池，跳过此准备步骤，并使用现有配置文件继续执行 **设置服务环境**。"
+
+msgid "Set the resource values for both P/D LocalService copies:"
+msgstr "为两个 P/D LocalService 副本设置资源值："
+
+msgid ""
+"In the copied `${MEMCACHE_CONFIG_DIR}/mmc-local-p.conf` and "
+"`${MEMCACHE_CONFIG_DIR}/mmc-local-d.conf`, edit the following keys:"
+msgstr ""
+"在复制得到的 `${MEMCACHE_CONFIG_DIR}/mmc-local-p.conf` 和 "
+"`${MEMCACHE_CONFIG_DIR}/mmc-local-d.conf` 中，编辑以下键："
+
+msgid ""
+"The eight embedded LocalServices each contribute `10GB` of pool DRAM and "
+"reserve `10` GB for UBS IO; no separate storage process is needed. "
+"`force_new_disk=true` recreates the SSD cache at stack startup, so keep the "
+"stack running during cache-reuse tests."
+msgstr ""
+"八个内嵌的 LocalService 各贡献 `10GB` 的资源池 DRAM，并预留 `10` GB 用于 UBS "
+"IO；无需单独的存储进程。`force_new_disk=true` 会在栈启动时重建 SSD 缓存，因此在缓存复用测试期间请保持栈持续运行。"
+
+msgid "**Set the service environment:**"
+msgstr "**设置服务环境：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"Open separate P, D, and Proxy terminals in the same container, plus a "
+"MetaService terminal only when creating a new pool. Initialize the runtime "
+"as described in Section 4.3, apply the library exports at the beginning of "
+"this section, and run the following in each terminal."
+msgstr ""
+"在同一容器中分别打开 P、D 和 Proxy 终端，仅在创建新资源池时额外打开一个 MetaService 终端。按照第 4.3 "
+"节的说明初始化运行时，应用本节开头的库导出，并在每个终端中运行以下内容。"
+
+msgid ""
+"`local_ip` is the model service IP; `nic_name` is the socket network "
+"interface that owns that IP. MetaService/ConfigStore URLs are separate TCP "
+"control endpoints and need only be reachable from all clients; loopback is "
+"suitable when all processes share the host network. `device_urma` selects "
+"the UB data path and does not make the socket interface a UB interface. The "
+"supplied example uses the same host IP for both purposes, but this is not a "
+"general requirement."
+msgstr ""
+"`local_ip` 是模型服务 IP；`nic_name` 是拥有该 IP 的 socket 网络接口。MetaService/ConfigStore"
+" URL 是独立的 TCP 控制端点，只需所有客户端均可访问即可；当所有进程共享主机网络时，使用 loopback 即可。`device_urma` "
+"用于选择 UB 数据路径，并不会将 socket 接口变为 UB 接口。提供的示例对两者使用相同的主机 IP，但这并非通用要求。"
+
+msgid "**Start MetaService (new pool only):**"
+msgstr "**启动 MetaService（仅新建资源池时）：**"
+
+msgid "Skip this command when reusing a running pool."
+msgstr "复用正在运行的资源池时，请跳过此命令。"
+
+msgid ""
+"For a new pool, wait until the ports configured in `mmc-meta.conf` are "
+"listening (`ss -lntp`); the example uses `25250`, `25251`, and `25252`. For "
+"an existing pool, check its actual configured endpoints instead. Then start "
+"Prefill."
+msgstr ""
+"对于新建资源池，请等待 `mmc-meta.conf` 中配置的端口进入监听状态（`ss -lntp`）；示例使用 `25250`、`25251` 和 "
+"`25252`。对于已有资源池，请改为检查其实际配置的端点。然后启动 Prefill。"
+
+msgid ""
+"In the Prefill terminal, first apply the library exports at the beginning of"
+" Section 5.4 and the **Set the service environment** block above, then run "
+"the following commands."
+msgstr "在 Prefill 终端中，先应用第 5.4 节开头的库导出设置以及上文的 **设置服务环境** 代码块，然后运行以下命令。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Wait for the Prefill API on port `8247` to become ready, then start Decode "
+"in a new terminal."
+msgstr "等待端口 `8247` 上的 Prefill API 就绪，然后在新终端中启动 Decode。"
+
+msgid ""
+"In the Decode terminal, first apply the library exports at the beginning of "
+"Section 5.4 and the **Set the service environment** block above, then run "
+"the following commands."
+msgstr "在 Decode 终端中，先应用第 5.4 节开头的库导出设置以及上文的 **设置服务环境** 代码块，然后运行以下命令。"
+
+msgid ""
+"After the Decode API on port `8248` is ready, start Proxy from the vLLM-"
+"Ascend repository root in another terminal."
+msgstr "端口 `8248` 上的 Decode API 就绪后，在另一个终端中从 vLLM-Ascend 仓库根目录启动 Proxy。"
+
+msgid "**Service verification:**"
+msgstr "**服务验证：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"`load_async=false` keeps external cache loading synchronous. Decode-side "
+"pool loading and saving remain disabled."
+msgstr "`load_async=false` 使外部缓存加载保持同步。Decode 侧的资源池加载和保存仍保持禁用。"
+
+msgid "**Verify three-tier cache reuse:**"
+msgstr "**验证三级缓存复用：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"1. **Service:** Run the Section 5.2 chat-completion request for A2/A3, or the 950 DT request above, through the matching proxy and verify correct output and P-to-D transfer.\n"
+"2. **External cache:** Send requests with shared prefixes and different suffixes; check MemCache lookup, put, get, and hit activity. A local prefix-cache hit alone does not prove external cache reuse.\n"
+"3. **SSD restore:** Fill DRAM past the eviction watermark, confirm SSD eviction, then request an evicted prefix again and verify SSD read/restore activity and correct output. Keep MetaService and P/D running; SSD writes alone do not prove restoration."
+msgstr ""
+"1. **服务：** 通过匹配的 proxy 运行第 5.2 节中针对 A2/A3 的 chat-completion 请求，或上文中的 950 DT 请求，并验证输出正确且 P-to-D 传输正常。\n"
+"2. **外部缓存：** 发送具有共享前缀和不同后缀的请求；检查 MemCache 的查找、写入、读取和命中活动。仅本地前缀缓存命中并不能证明外部缓存复用。\n"
+"3. **SSD 恢复：** 将 DRAM 填充至超过驱逐水位线，确认发生 SSD 驱逐，然后再次请求已被驱逐的前缀，并验证 SSD 读取/恢复活动及输出正确。保持 MetaService 和 P/D 运行；仅 SSD 写入并不能证明恢复成功。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use the MemCache, MemFabric, and UBS IO logs or available metrics to check "
+"these results; counter names depend on the installed version."
+msgstr "使用 MemCache、MemFabric 和 UBS IO 日志或可用的指标来检查这些结果；计数器名称取决于所安装的版本。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Keep `PYTHONHASHSEED=0` consistent across workers. `lookup_rpc_port` identifies a local IPC endpoint with a DP-index suffix; use distinct P/D identifiers and avoid collisions with other pools.\n"
+"- Retain `use_layerwise=false`: Prefill performs external prefix lookup and cache writes, while Decode receives KV/state through the P-to-D connector."
+msgstr ""
+"- 在各 worker 之间保持 `PYTHONHASHSEED=0` 一致。`lookup_rpc_port` 用于标识带有 DP 索引后缀的本地 IPC 端点；请使用不同的 P/D 标识符，并避免与其他资源池冲突。\n"
+"- 保留 `use_layerwise=false`：Prefill 执行外部前缀查找和缓存写入，而 Decode 通过 P-to-D 连接器接收 KV/状态。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Verify generation through `/v1/chat/completions`, using the API address and "
+"model name for your deployment:"
+msgstr "通过 `/v1/chat/completions` 验证生成，使用与你的部署对应的 API 地址和模型名称："
+
+msgid "| Deployment | API address | Model name |"
+msgstr "| 部署方式 | API 地址 | 模型名称 |"

+msgid ""
+"| A2 series colocated | `http://127.0.0.1:8088` | `qwen3.8-flash-next` |"
+msgstr "| Atlas A2系列产品混部 | `http://127.0.0.1:8088` | `qwen3.8-flash-next` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| A3 series colocated | `http://127.0.0.1:8088` | `qwen3.8-flash-next` |"
+msgstr "| Atlas A3系列产品混部 | `http://127.0.0.1:8088` | `qwen3.8-flash-next` |"

+msgid ""

+"| Ascend 950DT系列产品混部 | `http://127.0.0.1:8087` | `qwen3.8-flash-next-950-dt`"

+msgid ""
+"| A2 series PD proxy | `http://127.0.0.1:25570` | `qwen38-flash-next-a2-pd` "

+msgstr ""
+"| Atlas A2系列产品 PD proxy | `http://127.0.0.1:25570` | `qwen38-flash-"

+
+msgid ""
+"| A3 series PD proxy | `http://127.0.0.1:25570` | `qwen38-flash-next-a3-pd` "
+"|"
+msgstr ""
+"| Atlas A3系列产品 PD proxy | `http://127.0.0.1:25570` | `qwen38-flash-"
+"next-a3-pd` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| 950DT products PD proxy | `http://<LOCAL_SERVICE_IP>:8087` | "
+"`qwen38-flash-next-950-dt-pd` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| Ascend 950DT系列产品 PD proxy | `http://<LOCAL_SERVICE_IP>:8087` | "
+"`qwen38-flash-next-950-dt-pd` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| 950DT products image-and-text 10K PD proxy | `http://127.0.0.1:8246` | "
+"`qwen38-megamoe-sp-pd` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| Ascend 950DT系列产品图文 10K PD proxy | `http://127.0.0.1:8246` | "
+"`qwen38-megamoe-sp-pd` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| 950DT products three-tier pooling PD proxy | `http://127.0.0.1:8249` | "
+"`qwen38-megamoe-sp-pd` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| Ascend 950DT系列产品三级池化 PD proxy | `http://127.0.0.1:8249` | `qwen38-megamoe-"
+"sp-pd` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"For PD, first complete the matching startup and proxy checks in Sections "
+"[5.2](#52-basic-pd-separation-deployment), [5.3](#53-image-and-text-10k-pd-"

+msgid ""
+"Expected result: the service returns HTTP 200 OK with a generated answer in "
+"`choices[0].message.content`."
+msgstr "预期结果：服务返回 HTTP 200 OK，并在 `choices[0].message.content` 中给出生成的回答。"

+msgid ""
+"Use a W4A8 checkpoint that includes the vision encoder to verify image-and-"

+msgstr "使用包含视觉编码器的 W4A8 权重来验证图文输入。将 `<IMAGE_URL>` 替换为服务环境可访问的图片 URL："

+msgid ""
+"The colocated examples and the optional Function Calling setup in [Section "

+msgstr ""
+"混部示例以及 [第 5.2 节](#52-basic-pd-separation-deployment) 中可选的 Function Calling "

+msgstr ""

+msgid ""
+"Reasoning parsing requires the following startup option, which is included "

+msgstr ""
+"推理内容解析需要以下启动选项，该选项已包含在第 5 节的混部示例中；对于 PD 分离，请参见 [第 5.2 节](#52-basic-pd-"
+"separation-deployment)："
+
+msgid ""
+"To disable thinking and request a direct answer, use the following request:"
+msgstr "如需禁用思考并请求直接回答，请使用以下请求："
+
+msgid ""
+"Follow [Using AISBench](../../developer_guide/evaluation/using_ais_bench.md)"
+" for evaluation. The results below are for reference. The A3 result is from "
+"the W8A8 TP8 × DP1 configuration; validate accuracy for the checkpoint and "
+"deployment configuration you use."
+msgstr ""
+"请按照 [使用 AISBench](../../developer_guide/evaluation/using_ais_bench.md) "
+"进行评测。以下结果仅供参考。A3 结果来自 W8A8 TP8 × DP1 配置；请针对你使用的权重和部署配置验证精度。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use the endpoint and served model name for the deployment under test. Record"
+" request throughput, output token throughput, time to first token (TTFT), "
+"and time per output token (TPOT). Compare configurations using the same "

+msgstr ""
+"使用被测部署的端点和已服务模型名称。记录请求吞吐量、输出 token 吞吐量、首 token 时延（TTFT）和每输出 token "

+"After the service is ready, run this basic text benchmark in a separate "

+"for another deployment, use its API address and served model name from "
+"[Section 6](#6-functional-verification) and its matching checkpoint for "
+"`--model`."
+msgstr ""
+"服务就绪后，在另一个终端中运行此基础文本基准测试。该示例针对第 5.1 节中的 A2/A3 混部服务；对于其他部署，请使用 [第 6 "
+"节](#6-functional-verification) 中的 API 地址和已服务模型名称，并为其 `--model` 使用匹配的权重文件。"

[Doc] Add 950DT long-context PD case for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (#21367)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

Add a 950DT products long-context PD example after the image-and-text
10K case. Both roles use TP4 × DP1, a maximum model length of 1,010,000
tokens, 16 sequences, 4096 batch tokens, and matching YaRN factor-4
overrides.

Retain the supplied role-specific settings: Prefill uses graph mode NONE
and MTP enforce_eager=true; Decode uses FULL_DECODE_ONLY, MTP
enforce_eager=false, static kernels, and recompute scheduling.
Engine-ready timeouts are 2400 seconds on Prefill and 4800 seconds on
Decode. Include the supplied proxy ports, ModelScope model ID,
long-request verification, and key parameter explanations.

Move the pooling section to 5.5 and update its references, the API
endpoint table, and the configuration summary. All 73 existing code
blocks are unchanged.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Documentation only; no runtime or API changes.

### How was this patch tested?

- Markdown lint and git diff --check passed.
- All 69 Bash blocks passed bash -n, with the documentation
image-version template substituted only in validation input.
- All 90 JSON configuration arguments parsed; internal anchors resolve.
- Compared the new P/D flags, role-specific environment values, YaRN
overrides, and connector topology with the supplied scripts.
- Confirmed the main/release tutorial content and local document copy
match.
- bash format.sh ci was attempted but cannot run because pre-commit is
not installed locally.
- No NPU execution or long-context accuracy/performance run was
performed for this documentation change. No unit tests added because
only a tutorial is changed.

[BugFix][Test] Fix D3 CPU reference loading without accelerate (#21410)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

Fix the D3 CPU reference test when ModelScope wraps Transformers model
loading. Normalize the CPU device map at Transformers' validation
boundary so the reference model loads without an `accelerate`
dependency.

Related to #21407 (D3 test failure).

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No. This only changes the E2E test helper.

### How was this patch tested?

- Ascend 950DT, one NPU, D3-edge, vLLM v0.33.0, BF16, eager mode,
without `accelerate`: both `test_d3_pooling_matches_checkpoint_runtime`
and `test_d3_systemone_endpoint` passed (2 passed). The checkpoint was
downloaded from ModelScope and the test fixture pointed to the verified
local copy.
- In the same image without `accelerate`, reproduced the original CPU
device-map failure with a small Transformers model and confirmed that
the adjusted helper loads it successfully.
- `bash format.sh ci`: passed on the server.

The nightly failure occurred on A2. A2 CI validation is still needed. 

### Checklist

#### Testing

- [x] **Regression test**: The existing D3 E2E reference test exercises
the failing path.
- [x] **Meaningful & reliable tests**: The reference test compares NPU
output against the checkpoint runtime.

[Doc] Add dependency version maintenance guide (#21136)

## Summary

Adds `docs/source/developer_guide/dependency_version_management.md`, a
maintenance guide for the pinned dependency stack (CANN,
torch/torch-npu, triton-ascend, FLA, flash-attention-npu, Mooncake,
memfabric/memcache hybrids, vLLM main pin).

The guide covers:

- **Where each pin lives**: `requirements.txt` / `pyproject.toml`
(mirror enforced by `test_dependency_metadata.py`), the four root
Dockerfiles (CANN image tag, pinned-deps `ARG` block,
flash-attention-npu commit), the PR E2E and main2main workflows,
`.github/vllm-main-verified.commit`, and the `mkdocs.yml` docs macros.
- **Available software sources**: PyPI, PyTorch CPU index, Ascend
stable/nightly PyPI mirrors, Aliyun mirror, Huawei OBS buckets, GitHub
Releases via gh-proxy, quay.io/ascend/cann images, pinned git source.
- **Update procedures** per pin kind, with a verification checklist and
known pitfalls (triton/triton-ascend shared directory, Mooncake
manylinux_2_35, FLA mirror-vs-dev-build numerics, flash_attn_npu build
requirements).

The page is registered in the mkdocs nav and the bilingual nav-title
mapping.

- vLLM main:
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/24420b7a341af37a9bc3186e6fc6062512e0aa58

[BugFix][KV Cache] Honor upstream prefix cache retention configuration (#21229)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

The Ascend hybrid HBM coordinator and AscendStore scheduler/worker still
read
`getattr(vllm.envs, "VLLM_PREFIX_CACHE_RETENTION_INTERVAL", None)`.
Upstream vLLM
removed that environment variable in
[vllm#55353](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/55353),
so these paths silently select `None` (dense retention) even when the
CLI selects
`0` or a positive interval.

Read `KVCacheConfig.prefix_cache_retention_interval` in the HBM
coordinator and
`VllmConfig.cache_config.prefix_cache_retention_interval` in
AscendStore. Reuse the
existing retention algorithms and validation. Migrate the stale
environment
variable in 12 E2E YAML files to the CLI option on the same instances,
and document
the configuration and upgrade behavior.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. The three affected paths now honor the upstream configuration:

| CLI setting | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Omitted | `None` (dense) | Upstream default `0` |
| `0` | `None` (dense) | `0` |
| Positive interval | `None` (dense) | Configured interval |
| `None` | `None` (dense) | `None` (dense) |

For sliding-window/Mamba groups, `0` retains the checkpoints needed for
prompt
replay, positive values additionally retain periodic checkpoints, and
`None`
retains reachable checkpoints densely. Full-attention groups retain
their dense
behavior. To preserve the previous effective behavior, explicitly pass
`--prefix-cache-retention-interval None`.

The migrated E2E cases explicitly select `4096`, restoring their
configured intent;
this changes their effective behavior from the previous silent `None`
fallback.
A release note fragment accompanies the configuration fix.

### How was this patch tested?

- **Existing tests:** 384 passed, 12 skipped, and 214 subtests passed
across
seven existing test files against each of vLLM `v0.32.0` and the
CI-pinned
main commit
[`24420b7a341af37a9bc3186e6fc6062512e0aa58`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/24420b7a341af37a9bc3186e6fc6062512e0aa58).
Files: `test_pool_scheduler.py`, `test_pool_worker.py`,
`test_coordinator.py`,
`test_glm53_store.py`, `test_mooncake_hybrid.py`, and
`test_request_lifecycle.py`
  under `tests/ut/distributed/ascend_store/`, plus
  `tests/ut/kv_transfer/test_ascend_store_layerwise_lifecycle.py`.
- **Existing fixture migration:** explicitly select `None` in the shared
scheduler/worker mocks and the two lifecycle cases that assert dense
prefix
hits. All assertions are preserved and no new test cases are added. All
84
tests that failed in the previous CI run pass locally against both
versions.
- **Local test setup:** isolated CPU tests reuse the repository's NPU
stubs,
real upstream cache implementations, and the relevant Ascend
cache/config
patches. Unrelated worker/platform patches are not loaded. Standard
pytest
  collection on local macOS is blocked by missing runtime dependencies,
  including `compressed_tensors`; the full CI suite remains necessary.
- **Configuration validation:** all 12 migrated YAML files parse;
resolved
configurations preserve other settings and the original per-instance
scope.
- **Lint:** `bash format.sh ci` passed Ruff, formatting, spelling,
Markdown,
workflow lint, and structural checks. The full command did not pass
because
Gitleaks could not run without a local binary/`wget`, and ShellCheck was
not
  installed. `git diff --check` passed.
- **Coverage limits:** no new unit tests are included; validation relies
on the
existing suites and focused configuration inspection. NPU execution, E2E
runs,
and performance benchmarks remain unverified and need CI/hardware
validation.

### Checklist

- [x] User-facing configuration changes and upgrade instructions are
documented.
- [x] Existing affected CPU tests and configuration checks were run.
- [ ] New regression tests are included (none added).
- [ ] Full repository checks pass (local tools missing as described
above).
- [ ] NPU/E2E and performance validation completed.

- vLLM main:
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/24420b7a341af37a9bc3186e6fc6062512e0aa58

@@ -62,6 +62,26 @@ For non-layerwise complete-block transfers, adjacent MLA components sharing one
 
 This bulk fast path uses physical-page-major object contents instead of the previous component-major segmented contents. A fresh namespace is required even when upgrading from the earlier segmented version of this fix. Writers and readers must agree on transfer mode and cache layout; do not share these objects with layerwise readers or workers using a different component layout.
 
+### Prefix Cache Retention
+
+Configure retention with the upstream vLLM argument `--prefix-cache-retention-interval`.
+The Ascend hybrid HBM coordinator and AscendStore scheduler/worker use the parsed
+configuration. The former `VLLM_PREFIX_CACHE_RETENTION_INTERVAL` environment variable
+was removed from vLLM and no longer configures retention.
+
+| Value | Sliding-window / Mamba checkpoint retention |
+| :--- | :--- |
+| `0` (upstream default) | Retain checkpoints required for prompt replay, without periodic checkpoints. |
+| Positive integer, e.g. `4096` | Also retain periodic checkpoints; the interval must be a multiple of the scheduler block size. |
+| `None` | Retain all reachable checkpoints densely. |
+
+Full-attention groups retain their dense prefix-cache behavior. The setting controls
+checkpoint retention, not the configured HBM or external pool capacity. To preserve
+dense retention when upgrading from the stale environment-variable reader, explicitly
+pass `--prefix-cache-retention-interval None`; omitting the argument selects `0`.
+To migrate an intended interval of `4096`, pass `--prefix-cache-retention-interval 4096`
+on the same instances that previously exported the environment variable.
+
